izzyondroid:com.kieronquinn.app.simnumbe.name: SIM Number Setter
izzyondroid:com.kieronquinn.app.simnumbe.summary: small Xposed module to set the SIM card's phone subscriber number
izzyondroid:com.kieronquinn.app.simnumbe.description:
SIM Number Setter is a small Xposed module that invokes normally unused Android System code to set the "subscriber number" on the device's SIM card. This is the number displayed in the system settings, and used in apps such as Google Messages, as well as being available to third party apps with sufficient permissions. The number is not always set by carriers (leaving "Unknown"), or can be lost or invalid after porting a number to a different SIM. This small app allows you to fix it, permanently, using a rooted device with Xposed.
 If you don't have a rooted device, or don't want to root your main device, you may wish to consider rooting an old device, and temporarily putting your SIM into that device, using this app, and then putting it back in your main device - the fixed number will travel with it. 
 Important Notice: Changing the SIM number is semi-permanent: the number change will survive reboots, uninstalling this app, even switching the SIM to a different device, but can be changed again at any time using this app.

izzyondroid:com.mirfatif.permissionmanag.name: Permission Manager X
izzyondroid:com.mirfatif.permissionmanag.summary: eXtended Permission Manager - a small app to manage permissions and AppOps
izzyondroid:com.mirfatif.permissionmanag.description:
Using e X tended Permission Manager , for each installed app, on single screen, you can:
 View, grant or revoke manifest permissions
 View AppOps permissions and choose one of multiple modes
 Set your desired reference value for every changeable permission
 Manifest permissions are those normally called permissions e.g. Storage, Camera etc. AppOps (app operations) is a robust framework Android uses at back end for access control. With every Android release manifest permissions are becoming more dependent on AppOps. So it's fun to control both simultaneously and see how they relate to each other.
 In short, AppOps provide a fine-grained control over many of the manifest permissions. Plus it provides additional controls like background execution, vibration, clipboard access etc. Just install the app to explore it yourself.
 When you reinstall an app, or change your device, or upgrade your ROM, it's a time-taking process to review all installed apps for granted permissions and revoke the unnecessary ones (after all privacy matters ). PMX provides you the solution. Set reference states of permissions, which can be quickly backed up and restored, and colored bars at left make it quite easy to review packages and permissions at a glance.
 Confused? We are here to explain. Please start with:
 What is PMX? 
 Why do I need to use PMX? 
 What are manifest permissions and AppOps? 
 What are Permission References? 
 Paid version (available as Play Store and Pro flavors) offers extra features including Permission Watcher , Scheduled Checks , Permission View and Batch Operations / Profiles .
 Beta builds are released in Telegram channel .
 Guide: https://mirfatif.github.io/PermissionManagerX/help

 Privacy & Security 
 No analytics, trackers, or background network traffic.
 Source code is publicly available for review.

Middor is a free and open-source Android application for mirroring apps on your device.

 Display apps on a HUD
 Project content onto a car windscreen (e.g. Google Maps navigation)

fdroid:com.mine.autoprofiles.name: Auto Profiles
fdroid:com.mine.autoprofiles.summary: Lightweight utility for LineageOS that switches System Profiles automatically
fdroid:com.mine.autoprofiles.description:
Auto Profiles 
Auto Profiles is a lightweight utility for LineageOS that switches System Profiles automatically, based on rules you define. It brings the functionality of Handy Profiles — a popular app for Nokia smartphones originally developed by SymbianWare — to Android.
Set up a rule once, and your phone changes its profile on its own: silent at the office, loud at home, offline at night.
 How it works 
The app relies on the System Profiles feature built into LineageOS. Tap the + button, select an existing system profile, and choose how it should be triggered:
 Location (GSM) — activates the profile when you are at a specific place (such as your office, gym, or home). Location is determined by nearby GSM/LTE cell towers rather than GPS, allowing it to work indoors without consuming extra battery. When creating the rule, the app scans and collects surrounding cells — walk around the location to capture all nearby towers, then tap Complete and name the rule. When any saved cell comes into range, the profile is applied and your previous profile is remembered. Leaving the coverage area automatically restores the previous profile.
 Schedule — activates the profile during a set time interval (for example, from midnight to 7 o'clock). At the start of the interval the profile is applied, and at the end the previous profile is restored.
All rules are listed in the main window, where each one can be edited, deleted, or toggled on and off individually. A master switch in the app bar disables the whole app at once, reverting any profile it applied. A foreground service monitors cell tower changes in the background and survives reboots.
 Requirements 
 LineageOS with the System Profiles feature (Settings → System → Profiles) enabled.
 Note: Android only reveals cell tower identities to apps while the system-wide Location toggle is on. Auto Profiles never uses GPS — the toggle is only the policy gate that makes cell information visible. If Location is off, the app will ask you to enable it.
 Permissions 
 Location (precise): required by Android to read cell tower identities, which are treated as location data. GPS is not used.
 Location (coarse): fallback location data used alongside precise location for cell tower identification.
 Location (background, Android 10+): lets the cell-monitoring service keep detecting towers right after your phone restarts, before you've had a chance to reopen the app. Asked separately from precise location, and only after it is granted.
 Phone: to read the cellular network state.
 Network state: to access network information.
 Run at startup: to restore rule monitoring and alarms after a reboot.
 Foreground service: to keep monitoring cell changes reliably in the background.
 Foreground service (location): specialized permission to run a foreground service that monitors location-based triggers (Android 14+).
 Alarms & reminders: to switch profiles at the exact scheduled time (Android 12+).
 Notifications: for the persistent monitoring notification (Android 13+).
 Ignore battery optimizations: exempts the app from Doze so the background monitor isn't throttled while the screen is off. Requested once via a single system dialog. Declining it is safe, but cell changes may then be detected with a delay while the phone is idle.
 Modify profiles (lineageos.permission.MODIFY_PROFILES): to switch LineageOS System Profiles.

fdroid:com.plum0.jabralibre.name: JabraLibre
fdroid:com.plum0.jabralibre.summary: Offline ANC / HearThrough switcher and battery monitor for Jabra Elite 10
fdroid:com.plum0.jabralibre.description:
A minimal, fully offline replacement for the Jabra Sound+ app, built around the
one feature that matters most: switching between Noise Cancelling, HearThrough
and Off.
The earbud button already cycles those modes — as long as you are wearing the
left bud. Listening with only the right one, in bed for instance, leaves no way
to switch. That is what this app is for, and why it ships a Quick Settings tile:
pull down the shade, one tap cycles the modes. It works on the lock screen, so
you never have to open the app at all.
 Features 
 Switch Noise Cancelling / HearThrough / Off, from the app or a Quick Settings tile
 Shows all three battery levels separately: left bud, right bud and charging case
 Picks up mode changes you make with the earbud button
 Reconnects on its own when you take the buds out of the case
 Says plainly when the buds are not reachable instead of pretending
 English and German
 Offline by design 
The app has no INTERNET permission at all — not an unused one, none. It cannot
phone home, there is no account, no tracking, no Google Play Services, and no
analytics. It talks to the earbuds over Bluetooth and to nothing else. That is
also why there is no firmware updater: even a passive update check would need
network access, and that would defeat the point.
 How it works 
The Elite 10 talks to Sound+ over Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM, using a protocol
that was reverse-engineered from a capture of the phone's own Bluetooth traffic.
The findings are documented in the project's README so anyone can check what the
app does, or build on it.
 Device support 
Everything here was developed and tested against one single pair of Jabra
Elite 10. It may work on other Jabra earbuds that speak the same protocol, and
it may equally well not: other generations use different transports and
different identifiers. If it does not work with yours, the app has a Diagnostics
section that exports a protocol log — open an issue with that log and the exact
model, and support can be added.
Not affiliated with Jabra or GN Audio.

flathub:net.sourceforge.uhexen2.uhexen2.summary: A modernized source port of Hexen II
flathub:net.sourceforge.uhexen2.uhexen2.description:
In 2000, Raven Software released the source code to their class based shooter game Hexen II
 and its multiplayer extension HexenWorld. Since then, there has been some source ports of this
 game, such as the now discontinued Anvil of Thyrion project, but nothing has been done for Linux
 since the beginning of 2002.
 The Hammer of Thyrion project is a cross-platform source port effort: We continue the development
 for Linux, BSD and Mac OS X people, with continued support for Windows users as well. Many bugs
 are fixed and even new features are added: New sound modes, improved mouse handling, improved video
 modes, OpenGL glows and more.
 Hexen II: Hammer of Thyrion requires a copy of the Hexen II game data to function. Simply copy
 the game data directory data1 from a regular copy of Hexen II into ~/.var/app/net.sourceforge.uhexen2.uhexen2/.hexen2/ 
 - if this is missing, you will be reminded when starting Hexen II: Hammer of Thyrion.

 High quality remakes of id Software's legendary Quake series deathmatch levels, as well as

fedora-packages:ghc-lukko/ghc-lukko.name: ghc-lukko
fedora-packages:ghc-lukko/ghc-lukko.description: This package provides access to platform dependent file locking APIs: * <https://www.gnu.org/software/libc/manual/html_node/Open-File-Description-Locks.html Open file descriptor locking> on Linux ("Lukko.OFD") * BSD-style 'flock(2)' locks on UNIX platforms ("Lukko.FLock") * Windows locking via <https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/fileapi/nf-fileapi-lockfilee LockFileEx> ("Lukko.Windows") * No-op locking, which throws exceptions ("Lukko.NoOp") * "Lukko" module exports the best option for the target platform with uniform API. There are alternative file locking packages: * "GHC.IO.Handle.Lock" in 'base >= 4.10' is good enough for most use cases. However, uses only 'Handle's so these locks cannot be used for intra-process locking. (You should use e.g. 'MVar' in addition). * <https://hackage.haskell.org/package/filelock filelock> doesn't support OFD locking. /Lukko/ means lock in Finnish.

firefox-addons:2969078.name: GhostLayer: AI Privacy & Burner Identity
firefox-addons:2969078.summary: Instantly mask your digital fingerprint, generate burner emails in 1-click, and protect your privacy with AI-driven data poisoning.
firefox-addons:2969078.description:
GhostLayer: AI Privacy & Burner Identity
GhostLayer is a cutting-edge browser extension meticulously designed to provide users with comprehensive privacy protection and anonymity during web browsing. Unlike traditional ad-blockers that merely block trackers and risk breaking website functionality, GhostLayer employs an innovative multi-layered approach that actively conceals your digital identity, rendering your presence on the web both invisible and unpredictable. By leveraging artificial intelligence and a series of sophisticated automated techniques, GhostLayer masks your digital fingerprint, blocks intrusive tracking scripts, poisons data collected by profiling algorithms with randomized noise, and offers an integrated burner email system to protect your real identity during online registrations.
The extension tackles three critical privacy challenges for users who demand advanced security online. First, it includes a robust tracker blocker module that identifies and disables a wide array of third-party scripts, pixels, and trackers designed to monitor your activities or build profiles based on your behavior. Second, GhostLayer implements intelligent data poisoning by generating fake browsing signals such as random search queries, decoy page visits, and spoofed device metrics—effectively confusing advertisers and analytics engines trying to profile you. Third, it incorporates a seamless burner email manager that instantly generates disposable, secure email addresses on demand, allowing users to sign up for services, newsletters, or websites without exposing their real email information.
GhostLayer's design philosophy balances powerful privacy tools with user-friendly operation. Its modern and intuitive popup dashboard grants quick access to essential features such as toggling fingerprint spoofing, activating tracker blocking, initiating data poisoning sequences, and generating burner emails. The extension operates through a modular, lightweight background service worker that coordinates its key functions unobtrusively: selecting and rotating realistic spoofed device profiles, launching background visits to decoy URLs, and managing real-time tracking statistics. The integrated privacy dashboard empowers users to visualize exactly how many trackers have been blocked, how much fake data has been injected, and the overall privacy score, providing informative feedback on the effectiveness of protections.
What sets GhostLayer apart from conventional privacy extensions is its active fingerprint masking technology. Websites encountering your browser receive continually changing, plausible device and network fingerprints that prevent reliable identification or cross-session tracking. Its data poisoning system introduces variability and noise in telemetry—randomizing referrer headers, user agents, screen resolutions, and other parameters—to further undermine profiling attempts. Meanwhile, the burner email system connects to multiple trusted providers to generate and manage disposable addresses, complete with an integrated inbox for real-time verification code retrieval. Unlike simplistic ad blockers or basic script blockers, GhostLayer blends proactive defenses into a seamless browsing experience, preserving website compatibility while maximizing privacy.
With GhostLayer installed, users no longer need to manually clear cookies, create throwaway email accounts, or preemptively avoid fingerprinting scripts. The extension continuously adapts to evolving tracking technologies and fosters a digital veil of anonymity that shields your data. GhostLayer is ideal for privacy-conscious individuals, users frequently signing up for online services, or anyone seeking a hassle-free yet sophisticated layer of defense against modern web surveillance.
Key Features:
- AI-powered fingerprint spoofing dynamically randomizes hardware, browser, OS, and network fingerprints every session, thwarting persistent identification attempts.
- Comprehensive tracker blocker prevents a broad spectrum of third-party scripts, tracking pixels, and behavioral profiling tools from collecting your data.
- Advanced data poisoning engine autonomously simulates browsing activities—including random searches, visits, and telemetry signals—to confuse ad networks and profiling algorithms.
- Integrated burner email manager enables instant disposable email generation with support for multiple secure providers, real-time inbox checking, and automated email disposal.
- Detailed privacy statistics dashboard visualizes blocked trackers, injected fake data, generated burner emails, and your overall privacy rating for transparent feedback.
- Efficient, lightweight architecture built on Manifest V3 ensures minimal impact on browsing speed using modular background service workers.
- User-friendly popup interface offers one-click toggling of protections, instant burner email generation, privacy metrics review, and easy access to support resources.
How It Works:
1. Install GhostLayer from your preferred browser extension store.
2. Click the GhostLayer icon to open the intuitive popup dashboard.
3. Activate fingerprint masking, tracker blocking, and data poisoning through simple toggle switches tailored for effortless control.
4. Generate burner emails instantly by clicking the Ghost icon on any email input field during sign-ups; verify accounts directly within the extension’s built-in inbox.
5. Monitor real-time statistics showcasing the number of trackers blocked, fake data injected, and your evolving privacy score.
6. GhostLayer’s background service worker automatically rotates spoofed device profiles and initiates decoy page visits for continuous data poisoning without user intervention.
7. Customize advanced settings by selecting preferred burner email providers, adjusting data poisoning frequency, and fine-tuning tracker blocking levels to your privacy preferences.
Privacy: - No personal data collected. GhostLayer operates fully on-device, with all email generation, fingerprint spoofing, and data poisoning processes conducted anonymously. All privacy statistics are stored locally unless explicitly exported by the user. Your browsing history and real identity remain fully confidential, never shared or sold to third parties.

firefox-addons:10822.name: Clear Cache
firefox-addons:10822.summary: Clear Firefox cache and selected browsing data from the toolbar, context menu, or F9 shortcut. Choose what to clear, pick a time range, and optionally reload the active tab.
firefox-addons:10822.description:
Clear Cache adds a toolbar button for clearing Firefox cache and selected browsing data.
Use it with one click, from the context menu, or with the F9 shortcut. You can choose what to clear, select a time range, and reload the active tab after clearing.
You can clear:
• Cache
• Cookies
• History
• Downloads
• Form data
• Passwords
• Plugin data
• Local Storage
• IndexedDB
• Service Workers
Time ranges:
• Last 15 minutes
• Last hour
• Last 24 hours
• Last week
• All time
Site data only:
Clear cookies and storage for the current site only. This works for cookies, Local Storage, IndexedDB, and Service Workers.
Firefox does not allow extensions to clear cache for only one site. Cache clearing is always global.
Other options:
• Reload the active tab after clearing
• Show notifications only for warnings and failures
• Clear and reload from the context menu when available
Privacy:
• No data collection
• Preferences are stored locally
• Open source

firefox-addons:3098399.name: NZB Passwords
firefox-addons:3098399.summary: Local, encrypted password manager. Passwords are shown only on the exactly matching site; they never leak to subdomains.
firefox-addons:3098399.description:
NZB Passwords, parolalarınızı yalnızca bilgisayarınızda, ana parolanızla şifrelenmiş olarak saklayan sade bir parola yöneticisidir. İnternete bağlanmaz, hesap istemez, veri toplamaz.
Neden farklı?
Çoğu parola yöneticisi alan adına göre çalışır: ornek.com için kaydettiğiniz parola, ornek.com ’un bütün alt alanlarında görünür. NZB Passwords varsayılan olarak tam host eşleşmesi yapar: www.ornek.com için kaydettiğiniz parola ali.ornek.com ’da gösterilmez ve doldurulmaz. İsterseniz kayıt bazında “alan adı + alt alanlar” ya da “bu adresle başlayanlar” seçersiniz.
Özellikler
AES-256-GCM şifreleme, PBKDF2 (600.000 tur) ile ana paroladan anahtar türetme
Giriş alanına tıklayınca o sayfanın kayıtları alanın altında; tek tıkla doldurma
Giriş yakalama: yeni bir siteye girdiğinizde “kaydedelim mi?” penceresi (isteğe bağlı, tek seferlik izin)
Parola üretici ve parola sağlığı raporu (zayıf / tekrar eden)
Şifreli JSON yedek; geri yüklemede akıllı birleştirme (aynı kayıt için daha yeni olan kazanır)
Bitwarden ve Firefox CSV’den içe aktarma
Otomatik kilit, pano temizleme, Ctrl+Shift+L kısayolu
Türkçe, İngilizce, Fransızca, Almanca, Rusça, Çince
Gizlilik
Eklenti hiçbir ağ isteği yapmaz. Kasa yalnızca Firefox profilinizde, şifreli olarak durur. “Tüm siteler” izni yalnızca giriş yakalama ve satır içi menü için kullanılır; karşılama sayfasında açıklanır, istediğiniz zaman kapatabilirsiniz. Kaynak kodu açıktır.
Kurtarma
Ana parolanızı unutursanız kurtarma yolu yoktur; bu bilinçli bir tasarımdır. Düzenli şifreli yedek almanızı öneririz.

firefox-addons:868241.name: Tab List Board
firefox-addons:868241.summary: Enables you to classify opened tabs freely and switch tab easily by tab lists displayed on a board.
firefox-addons:868241.description:
The Tab List Board opens by add-on icon or F1 key (configurable), and it shows you a list of all opened tabs in the window. You can create a tab list and classify tabs, or can sort tabs and tab lists easily on this board. If you click a tab, you can switch to the tab. A green tab is a tab you were browsing just before, and F1 key (configurable) lets you back to the tab. 
A sidebar will open by Ctrl+F1 (configurable) and it shows a list of tabs which belong to the same tab list as the current tab. This helps you to switch tabs more.
I made this add-on for people who think it is difficult to switch tabs by tabbar because of many flooded tabs.
Please visit the following page for more details.
 https://azisava.sakura.ne.jp/tablistboard/en.html (English)

firefox-addons:796065.name: Popup Tab
firefox-addons:796065.summary: Convert a tab into a popup and vice versa
firefox-addons:796065.description:
Features 
 Convert a tab into a popup window.
 Convert the popup window back to a tab, and insert back to original window.
 The tab is actually "moved" between the normal window and the popup window, so you don't have to reload the page.
 The popup window size is maintained based on the domain. You can also right-click in the popup window and make it remember the window size for the entire URL.
 Usage 
 Right-click the tab bar, select "Popup this tab". (Firefox 53+)
 Right-click on the page, select "Popup this tab". (Firefox < 53)
 In popup window, right-click on the page, select "Merge popup".
 From Firefox >= 66, you can set a hotkey that will popup/merge the current tab.
 Learn more 
For more information including full changelog, visit https://github.com/eight04/popup-tab

bluejetty:00183627:ios.description:
Select Seven Credit Union is a not for profit financial institution, established to serve the financial needs of our members. For over 67 years, SSCU has strived to provide exceptional customer service to every member. The security of our members is derived from our goals of safety and soundness. Driving these goals is our commitment to our mission:
Since 1949, SSCU has been serving the financial needs of our members. What was once started by seven employees at a small milk plant; has grown into a premier financial institution serving over 8,200 members. Our availability of products and services match institutions triple our size. We are proud to be a “not-for-profit” financial cooperative, where our members are not customers, but they are member owners. Member owners are people who have come together for the mutual benefit of pooling their savings and lending their money to those in need of a loan.
If you live, work, worship, or attend school in Washington, Carter, Unicoi, Hawkins, or Sullivan Counties, Tennessee, or Scott or Washington Counties, Virginia or have a family member who is already a member of SSCU, you can take advantage of the many services and exceptional customer service that SSCU has to offer. Come and visit one of our four convenient locations!
There has never been an easier way to access Select Seven Credit Union!  Our mobile app delivers fast and secure access to all of your accounts anytime, anywhere.  
Select Seven Mobile App Features:
• Check Account Balances
• View Transaction History
• Transfer Money
• Deposit Checks
• Make SSCU Loan Payments
• Pay Bills (with SSCU Bill Pay service)
• Find Credit Union Locations and ATMs
Note:  To use Select Seven Credit Union’s mobile app, you will first need to enroll in SSCU CU@Home.  Contact a member service representative at 800-228-4738 or 423-282-0671 to gain access.  
Federally insured by the NCUA.
**Mobiliti™ is a trademark of Fiserv, Inc. or its affiliates.

bluejetty:00126789:ios.name: OptiFlight
bluejetty:00126789:ios.summary: Step into the world of airline route planning, where your goal is to create a flight network to guide passengers to their destinations in a limited amount of time. You get to call the shots on which routes to draw and which cities to design
bluejetty:00126789:ios.description:
Step into the world of airline route planning, where your goal is to create a flight network to guide passengers to their destinations in a limited amount of time. You get to call the shots on which routes to draw and which cities to designate as hubs that best serve each scenario. The flight maps you design will also need to be efficient and flexible to accommodate for events that may occur, like airport rushes and closures, as its effects ripple throughout your network. With over 350 geographically and historically themed levels to play, each map you make will be put to the test.
MAIN FEATURES
- Take a step back in time and create flight maps for past historical scenarios, like the 1849 California Gold Rush and the 2012 London Olympic Games
- Prepare for the future and create flight maps in realistic inclement weather simulation, including Hurricanes and Blizzards
- Understand the present and create flight maps using actual cities, like New York City and Tokyo, to reflect real flight patterns
FAN-FAVORITE LEVELS
Vote for your favorite level in the Preferences page
 ① Big Game (Level 36, Contiguous US)
 ② Silk Road (Level 17, Asia)
 ③ Big Apple (Level 18, Contiguous US)
 ④ Sustain (Level 38, Contiguous US)
 ⑤ Sustain (Level 38, Europe)
 ⑥ Tourism Capital (Level 20, Oceania)
OTHER FEATURES
- Play 350+ levels across multiple maps like America, Europe, and Asia
- Analyze in-game statistics to help fine-tune your flight map
- Speed up or slow down the game to your comfort
- Compete for the top spot on worldwide leaderboards
- Simplistic interface and experience
- No ads
FUTURE FEATURES
- More maps!
- More levels!
- More cities!

bluejetty:00171170:ios.description:
BECOME THE WORLDS TOP SOCCER MANAGER!
Build a team with new stars and league legends to make your way to the top!Champion management of your top eleven & build a world class online soccer franchise in World Football Manager 2026. Download the game today to get a free Starter Pack!
FACE YOUR FRIENDS ONLINE!
In World Football Manager, you can play online, either together with your friends, or against them!Take them to town in the weekend social league, or team up and beat the world 's top soccer manager groups!
REACH THE DREAM LEAGUE OF SOCCER
The WFM 2026 top league is called the Allstar Division.A true dream league of star soccer managers and champions,
where only a handful of the top coaches will ever set their foot. Prove that you can make it!
UNIQUE LIVE SIMULATOR
In World Football Manager, you are in control of your teams tactics in each game.Swap players, add special tactics and set star formations on the fly!Counter your opponents tactics to show your true colors as a top manager!Use special match tactics such as Brick Wall or Tiki - Taka to make turnaround performances on the pitch!
FEATURES
BUILD YOUR TOP ELEVEN
Build your champion eleven by scouting & developing youth footballers as well as trading
for seasoned stars!If they don 't give you top performances, send them to the transfer list!
UNIQUE LIVE GAMES
Manage all aspects of the game!In WFM, you are in control of the live tactics of your team!
COMPETITIVE SOCIAL LEAGUE
In the weekend is where the hardest battles are fought! Choose to either join an existing Group or create your own football powerhouse with your friends!
IN GAME CHAT
Psyche your opponents in matches!
MANAGE THE TALENT
Train and analyze your players to unlock special skills. You never know who might be a late bloomer...
BUILD YOUR SOCCER FRANCHISE
Expand your stadiums facilities to ensure a steady stream of income for your soccer manager empire.
GET REWARDED
The Season Pass gives you increasingly good rewards throughout the season!The bigger the wins on the football pitch, the mightier the rewards!All managers also receive daily sponsorship packs, as well as many more types of rewards.
LANGUAGES
WFM supports more than 10 languages!
OUR COMMUNITY SUPPORT
We are always ready to listen to your input. Please feel free to write to us at support[at]goldtowngames.com
For more information, please visit www.goldtowngames.com/en/wfm/

bluejetty:00159749:ios.description:
Find apartments in buildings you can actually trust.
The Openigloo app helps renters research buildings, landlords, and apartments before they sign a lease. Browse millions of US addresses, read anonymous reviews from real renters, and discover listings in buildings with strong reputations.
Avoid bad landlords, hidden issues, and problem buildings - and find your next home with confidence.
Search Apartments in Trusted Buildings
Browse thousands of apartment listings while researching the buildings behind them.
• Explore exclusive apartment listings in select cities
• Schedule apartment tours instantly with our AI bot across thousands of listings
• Filter by neighborhood, amenities, and stabilized apartments
• Focus on buildings with strong renter ratings
Research Any Building
Search millions of building profiles and see what renters actually think.
• Read anonymous reviews from verified renters
• Discover building scores for:
Maintenance
Cleanliness
Heat & water pressure
Garbage Management
Pest control
Landlord responsiveness
• Check city data including:
Building violations
Bedbug complaints
Eviction filings
Litigation history
Unlock Deep Building Reports (Paid)
App users can pay to get access to powerful insights to evaluate buildings before signing a lease.
• Construction permits and renovation history
• Median rent trends and historical pricing
• Lease renewal expectations and tenant turnover signals
• Stabilization insights and deeper building analytics
• Advanced building intelligence powered by city data
Know what’s happening behind the walls before you move in.
Research Landlords
Understand who manages your future home.
• View a landlord’s entire building portfolio
• See aggregated ratings across all their properties
• Learn how many buildings they own
• Check property tax status
• Identify tenant litigation history
Share Your Rental Experience
Help other renters make smarter housing decisions.
• Write anonymous rental reviews
• Upload photos, videos, and documents
• Share insights you wish you knew before moving in
• Contribute to a transparent rental community
Data + Real Renter Experiences
Openigloo combines crowdsourced tenant reviews with public city data to give renters the full picture of any building or landlord.
Research smarter. Rent safer.
Have feedback? We'd love to hear from you: info@openigloo.com

Free offline survival FPS! Play the zombie game now!
Master dozens of weapons and become a highly-skilled zombie killer!
KILL TONS OF ZOMBIES!
Zombeast is an innovative OFFLINE survival shooter with one purpose: kill them all!
You were left to survive in a city full of mad zombies.
In order to fend off an army of dead you have to become a high-skilled zombie killer!
Exciting campaign offers you to survive in the cruel world of the zombie apocalypse. Each day can be your last day, so you must use all of your skills in order to stay alive, hunt down each dead target in a bloody gore action of this FPS zombie game. Don’t hesitate to pull the trigger and remember - the dead men forgive no mistakes!
STORY DRIVEN SURVIVAL SHOOTER
• Intense gameplay with atmospheric visuals and sound depicting a sinister zombie apocalypse
• Campaign missions and mini goals provide constant challenges to overcome mad zombies
OFFLINE FPS ACTION
• Unlock an arsenal of zombie killer weapons and other gear to overpower hordes of zombies
• Kill zombies with pistols, sniper rifles, miniguns, shotguns, assault rifles, explosives and even batt!

bluejetty:00177102:ios.description:
Attendance Management - Employee Management: AtWork is the number one free intelligent attendance tracking application in Vietnam for many consecutive years. AtWork is suitable for individuals, teams, groups, organizations, businesses... with just a few steps, you can complete attendance tracking for the day.
From individual attendance tracking to employee attendance tracking, tracking for cafes, restaurants, construction sites, grocery stores, shops, eateries... the application can fully meet your needs.
With over 1 million jobs being tracked every day, what are you waiting for? Download and start experiencing it now!
Key Features:
* Daily/hourly attendance tracking:
Allows you to be more flexible in attendance tracking, simply enter the corresponding amounts for the day/shift/hour, and let AtWork handle the rest.
* Employee attendance management:
AtWork will help you monitor the attendance of all employees: clock-in and clock-out times will be recorded for checking, reconciliation, and payroll generation.
* Management: Overtime, Leave, Salary Advances, Allowances, Bonuses, Deductions:
Essential features in salary management, from now on, all financial transactions will be recorded and combined with attendance records to create detailed payrolls for you.
* WiFi-based attendance tracking:
Helps you know where employees are clocking in, whether they are arriving at the workplace or not.
* Location-based attendance tracking:
Helps you know where employees are clocking in, whether they are arriving at the workplace or not.
* QR Code attendance tracking:
Simply place this code at the workplace for employees to scan and clock in. You can create/delete multiple clock-in codes at once.
* Export payroll to Excel, PDF, PNG:
Helps you easily reconcile, review, and view attendance, salary advances, overtime history... supports multiple formats for easy sharing with employees.
* Profit and Loss Management - Revenue and Expenses:
Helps you manage Revenue (contracts, advances, commissions...) and subtract Expenses (salaries, supplies, equipment...) to provide you with accurate profit figures.
* Data security:
AtWork understands that this is very important data, so we take data protection very seriously. All your data will be securely encrypted and backed up daily on our servers.
Other Features:
- Shift scheduling, smart shift allocation
- Statistical reports: quarterly/yearly
- View pay stubs on mobile phones
- Lunar calendar attendance tracking
- Daily attendance reminder notifications
- Weather utility
Upcoming Features:
- FaceID recognition attendance tracking
We hope with this solution, you will find managing payroll easier, helping you save more time. AtWork always listens to you for feedback to improve the application, please contact us via email or Facebook page to discuss further.
---
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION (AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTION):
• Subscription name: Employee Management
• Duration: 1 month / 6 months / 1 year (depending on plan)
• Price: Displayed in the app based on your region
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

https://atwork.bizfast.com.vn/atwork-terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00136916:ios.description:
Get the app used by hundreds of thousands of marchers, directors, and teachers around the world.  
Features for Students
• Watch the drill animation while listening to the music from any perspective (performer or director). 
• View your individual coordinate sheet for sets in a song or counts in a set. 
• Follow your drill count by count with live updating coordinates. 
• UDB view shows curved and straight-line path information for previous and next sets. 
• Student leadership can access everyone’s drill information. 
• Learn and clean drill in seconds after it's been exported from Pyware by the designer. 
Features for Directors and Staff 
• Tap any performer to view coordinate and UDB view information. 
• Change field perspective (performer/director). 
• Easily add/delete/edit drill files in your ensemble's account directly from your app. 
• Learn and clean drill in seconds after it's been exported from Pyware by the designer. 
Sheet Music Integration
• One tap access to Beam
 • Import music and scores from cloud services like Dropbox and Google Drive or take a picture. 
• Sync the drill and music with drill tabs. • Annotate music with integrated icons and helpful tools. 
Differentiators 
• Phone layout designed for one handed use 
• Easily find your midway points and yard line crossing counts 
• Easily switch between custom views 
Tap ID
• Tap ID allows directors to see the performer labels that your students have selected. Simply tap on a performer's dot while viewing the drill to see their name and photo. Multiple students can select a single performer label so directors can easily see and manage alternates, shadows, and primary performers. 
Calendar + Attendance 
• See your full rehearsal and performance schedule, check-in to events, and track attendance throughout the season.
• Use Live Attendance to get a real-time view of who is at rehearsal and who is not.
Offline Mode
• Offline mode allows a director to restrict access to Ultimate Drill Book if selected users are connected to the internet. If not activated, all users will be able to access Ultimate Drill Book even if connected to a WiFi or cellular connection.

bluejetty:00075538:ios.summary: The sequel to the smash hit pocket bunny’s adventure has arrived! Embark on a new journey out from the Japanese forests and countryside vistas of Mushroom Village and into the unknown! In this new episode of the beloved rabbit’s tale, follo
bluejetty:00075538:ios.description:
The sequel to the smash hit pocket bunny’s adventure has arrived! Embark on a new journey out from the Japanese forests and countryside vistas of Mushroom Village and into the unknown! In this new episode of the beloved rabbit’s tale, follow Tsuki along the winding path as he explores the enchanting groves of the kawaii world. Immerse yourself in the charming aesthetic of a kinder world, where furry friends, thrilling mysteries, and fulfilling choices await.
Uncover the Secrets of the World
- Journey through lush groves and discover the hidden wonders that await.
- This new episode brings new discoveries and exciting adventures.
- Let Tsuki's story unfold in unexpected ways as you travel to different countries!
Build and Upgrade Your Cozy Home
- Create your own cozy home with adorable furniture and decorations.
- Upgrade your establishment and unlock new areas.
Experience the Joy of Animal Friendship
- Tons of furry friends to meet, from playful pets to wise elders
- Explore heartwarming relationships and cherish moments by the beach or during a peaceful picnic.
- Bond with animal people from around the world, discover their stories, and create long-lasting memories!
Escape to a Pocket-Sized Paradise
- Indulge in the serene beauty of Tsuki's pocket world, originally inspired by the peaceful charm of Japan, and now with vistas from around the world.
- Relax on the sandy beach, take leisurely strolls through bamboo forests, feel the wind on a biplane ride, and find solace in the simple pleasures of Tsuki's enchanting realm.
- A bustling, living world continues to move in your pocket, even when you’re not playing!
Re-Connect with Old Friendships
- Dive into heartwarming found-family dynamics as Tsuki rekindles connections with beloved characters like Chi, the giraffe, and Moca, the tea-loving turtle!
- Experience the joy of friendship, love, and support as Tsuki's furry family grow.
Welcome to Tsuki Adventure 2, where the path forward will always lead to new places, charming animal interactions, and the cozy joys of Tsuki’s relaxed lifestyle await.Tsuki is back in an all new adventure! Travel to cities all over the globe and meet new characters as you observe your favorite rabbit experiencing all the ordinary, yet wonderful things that life has to offer.

bluejetty:00018612:ios.description:
Enjoy our cookbook app with >1000 slow cooker recipes that are easy, delicious, and FREE. Easy to understand and create an ingredient shopping list with one click. Our cookbook features recipes for use in crockpots, instapots, and slow cookers. 
Slow cooker recipes have huge benefits. Food gets cooked at very low temperature to retain more minerals and nutrients. There's a reason why slow cooker recipes are wildly popular. The slow cooker delivers healthy food, conveniently, working hard for us while we're hard at work.
Our slow cooker cookbook offers recipes in the following categories: low carb, low sugar, grain-free, gluten-free, nutrient-dense, primal or whole food – all with delicious recipes using fresh ingredients.
Our massive cookbook offers recipes for breakfasts, sauces, soup, stew, chili, main dishes, casserole, vegetarian, Italian cuisine, Asian cuisine, beef, turkey, chicken, pork, and even delicious desserts.
The diet benefits of wholesome slow cooker recipes is enormous: 
● Weight loss 
● More energy that doesn't vary wildly throughout the day
● Improved sleep 
● Clearer skin
● Better digestion 
● Improved fitness 
● Reduced allergies
Features of our FREE cookbook & recipe app:
1) Easy to follow crockpot & slow cooker recipes
2) Offline access and sync new recipes 
3) Browse recipe by categories
4) Get featured recipe and categories based on seasonal trends and most viewed recipe and categories
5) Mark recipe as favorite to cook later or find easily
6) Share the recipe card with your friends on Facebook, Twitter, Whatsapp or any other social media
7) Prepare shopping list based for item you are going to cook
We will continually be updating our app with more recipes and features. You can reach us for support or any Feedback at team.themangauniverse@gmail.com or https://recipeworldsblog.wordpress.com
If you like the app, we would really appreciate it, if you left us a review and rating on the App Store.

bluejetty:00030954:ios.description:
Your Go-To Sneaker Source At Your Fingertips
The Hibbett mobile app is the go-to app for sneakerheads and sneakHERheads for copping the season’s hottest sneaker releases, must-have launch shoes – both fashion and running shoes – and access to exclusive sneaker colorways and silhouettes for men, women, and kids from top brands like Nike, Adidas, Jordan, New Balance and more. The official app of casual fashion, activewear, and sneaker retailer Hibbett, connects you to exclusive details and first looks at the sneakers and styles you want most this season.
The Hibbett app experience allows users to browse our full catalog of retro sneaker styles, basketball sneakers from your favorite players, casual sneakers, and running shoes, in addition to our collections of active apparel, athletic clothing, streetwear fashion essentials, and more.
The Hibbett app helps keep you up-to-date on launch product details, drop times, and most importantly, Hibbett's exclusive Launch Raffle program, too.
Follow our in-app launch calendar for information on upcoming sneaker releases and how to enter our Launch Raffles for some of the most hype sneaker launches of the year. Launch Raffles can ONLY be entered through the Hibbett app, and you can choose up to 3 participating stores near you to increase your chances of winning an opportunity to cop that pair of kicks you've been waiting for, giving you a leg up in the sneaker collecting game! If a launch shoe isn't being raffled, the app will also tell you which Hibbett location to visit on launch day.
Our app features go beyond the footwear and fashion scenes, too. The Hibbett app is an extension of Hibbett.com, making for a seamless shopping experience, whatever the device, wherever you go. Browse our full catalog of fan gear, fitness, and sports equipment, cleats, and accessories in addition to our extensive catalog of sports-style inspired shoes and clothing. Plus, sign up for our Rewards Program, earn Points for your in-app purchases, manage your launch alert notifications, and receive promotional offer messaging all in one convenient place. 
Download the official sneaker and streetwear staples app of Hibbett today!
Features:
- Upcoming and Recently Released Sneakers Launch Calendar
- Entry into Hibbett’s exclusive Launch Raffles 
- Manage your Rewards account
- Earn Points and get Awards for in-app purchases
- Get the latest offers and limited-time deals
- Browse the entire catalog: clothing, sneakers, shoes, gear & more

bluejetty:00013826:ios.summary:
Augin is the augmented reality platform for construction. View, check and present BIM projects at 1:1 scale, right on the job site or at the office — exactly as they will be built.
HOW IT WORKS
Upload your model through Augin Web (web.augi
bluejetty:00013826:ios.description:
Augin is the augmented reality platform for construction. View, check and present BIM projects at 1:1 scale, right on the job site or at the office — exactly as they will be built.
HOW IT WORKS
Upload your model through Augin Web (web.augin.app) or the plugins for Revit, ArchiCAD, Tekla and SketchUp (via IFC). In Augin Web you federate the disciplines and create a Reference Tracker with a crop of the area you need; in the app, just open it, point the camera and see the project on top of the real world, at real scale.
FEATURES
• Reference Tracker: print the reference sheet and place it on site — the model appears aligned to the environment, at the exact spot and height where it will be built.
• Partial view: projects too big for a phone now open — the app loads only the crop that matters, light and fast, with no external tools needed to cut the model.
• Federated models: architecture, structure and MEP brought together in a single project, so you can check disciplines side by side right on site.
• BIM information: tap an element to see its properties instantly; resolve questions with filters, section cuts and measurements without going back to the office.
• Collaboration: walk through the project with avatars and present to clients and your team.
• AR and 3D mode: visit the job site in augmented reality or explore the model anywhere.
WHO IT'S FOR
Architects, engineers, contractors and developers who want to take BIM off the screen: design review, site tracking, client presentations and sales.
Create your free account and upload your first project in minutes. Tutorials on Augin's YouTube channel.

bluejetty:00171992:ios.description:
Rithmm: Find Your Edge
Smarter analysis. Faster research. Less guesswork.
Rithmm is the AI sports prediction app built for fans who want model-backed answers for every game and every player, covering NFL, NBA, MLB, college football, college basketball, and more.
Decide with information instead of instinct, and never go into a slate alone.
MEET SCOUT: YOUR AI SPORTS ANALYST (NEW)
You have a question about tonight's games. Scout has the data.
Ask Scout about any game, player, or matchup, and get the projection, the Edge, and the why. It's like having the sharpest analyst you know sitting next to you, except this one actually has the numbers.
ASK: Tonight's strongest projections, a matchup you're eyeing, a player stat line you're not sure about, a multi-game read that needs a second opinion.
UNDERSTAND: The projection, the Edge, and the reasoning behind it, in plain language.
DECIDE: You make the call. Scout will tell you when the numbers aren't there. It never oversells.
And Scout doesn't guess, it asks the models. Every answer comes from Rithmm's own predictive models, not the open internet.
Before you decide, ask Scout.
Scout is included with Rithmm Pro and Premium.
WHY MEMBERS CHOOSE RITHMM
> Game & Player Predictions See a projection for every player and every game, backed by predictive models that analyze player and team performance, injuries, and conditions, personalized to the factors you care about.
> The Trends and Hit Rates You Rely On, Plus AI Predictions The trend data, hit rates across the last 5, 10, and 20 games, and matchup stats serious fans check before every slate, Rithmm has all of it. The difference: on top of the research, you get an actual prediction at the end. Same homework, with an answer.
> Combination Analyzer Stack multiple projections and see how they hold up together. If you've ever wanted a multi-leg calculator that actually tells you something, this is it.
> Your Model, Your Edge Use Rithmm's expert models or build your own, pick the factors that matter to you and follow your strategy, not someone else's.
> Know How You're Actually Doing Track every decision, see your hit rate by sport or market, and figure out where your models perform best, so you can do more of it.
SPORTS COVERED
NFL • NBA • MLB • CFB • CBB • WNBA • Golf
TRY FREE FOR 7 DAYS
Join thousands of members who never go into a slate alone. Start your free 7-day trial today.
7-day free trial is limited to first-time Rithmm users, one free trial per user.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
Core: $29.99/mo or $239.99/yr
The complete toolkit for model-backed projections and analysis. Scout not included.
Pro: $49.99/mo or $449.99/yr
Everything in Core, plus Scout, your AI sports analyst.
Premium: $99.99/mo or $999.99/yr
Everything in Pro, with 4× more Scout and advanced tools for deeper modeling and analysis.
Scout usage is subject to monthly limits that vary by plan; you can view your usage anytime in Settings.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Rithmm is an independent sports analytics and prediction service. It does not accept, place, or process any real-money transactions, and it is not affiliated with any operator. All content is provided for informational and entertainment purposes only. Model outputs are projections, not guarantees, and past performance does not predict future results. Must be 21+. If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, call 1-800-GAMBLER.

bluejetty:00013706:ios.name: Shrimad Bhagavad Gita in Hindi
bluejetty:00013706:ios.summary: Bhagavad Gita is knowledge of five basic truths and the relationship of each truth to the other: These five truths are Krishna, or God, the individual soul, the material world, action in this world, and time. The Gita lucidly explains the n
bluejetty:00013706:ios.description:
Bhagavad Gita is knowledge of five basic truths and the relationship of each truth to the other: These five truths are Krishna, or God, the individual soul, the material world, action in this world, and time. The Gita lucidly explains the nature of consciousness, the self, and the universe. It is the essence of India's spiritual wisdom.
Bhagavad Gita, is a part of the 5th Veda (written by Vedavyasa - ancient Indian saint) and Indian Epic - Mahabharata. It was narrated for the first time in the battle of Kurukshetra, by Lord Krishna to Arjun.
The Bhagavad Gita also referred to as Gita, is a 700–verse Dharmic scripture that is part of the ancient Sanskrit epic Mahabharata. This scripture contains a conversation between Pandava prince Arjuna and his guide Krishna on a variety of philosophical issues.
Faced with a fratricidal war, a despondent Arjuna turns to his charioteer Krishna for counsel on the battlefield. Krishna, through the course of the Bhagavad Gita, imparts to Arjuna wisdom, the path to devotion, and the doctrine of selfless action. The Bhagavad Gita upholds the essence and the philosophical tradition of the Upanishads. However, unlike the rigorous monism of the Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita also integrates dualism and theism.
Numerous commentaries have been written on the Bhagavad Gita with widely differing views on the essentials, beginning with Adi Sankara's commentary on the Bhagavad Gita in the eighth century CE. Commentators see the setting of the Bhagavad Gita in a battlefield as an allegory for the ethical and moral struggles of the human life. The Bhagavad Gita's call for selfless action inspired many leaders of the Indian independence movement including Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, who referred to the Bhagavad Gita as his "spiritual dictionary".
•All 700 Sanskrit Shlokas with Hindi translation and description
• Bookmark your favorite Bhagavad Gita shlokas/verses
• Fast and responsive user interface
• Share feature to easily send your favorite Bhagavad Gita shloka/verse to your friends
• App fully functional without internet
Jai Shri Krishna!!!

Take the WISN 12 News app with you everywhere you go and be the first to know of breaking news happening in Milwaukee and the surrounding area. Always stay up to date with the latest local news, national, sports, traffic, political, entertainment stories and much more. Download the WISN 12 News app for free today.
Our Local News, Weather and Sports App Features Include:
- Milwaukee breaking news alerts with push notifications
- Live streaming breaking news updates from our WISN 12 News reporters when it happens, where it happens
- Local news submission area for breaking news, news tips and the ability to email your news photos and videos right to our newsroom to be featured on air
- Share stories via email or your social media pages

- An interactive radar that lets you zoom in and out to street level and watch storms as they approach. Move the map around to see major weather activity

Life is noisy. Fast. Overwhelming. Even when you’re trying to stay close to God, it’s easy to feel spiritually disconnected.
Bible Chat is the ultimate all-in-one Christian app designed to make Bible reading, prayer, and Christian community a part of your everyday life. It is for Christians who want peace - real peace - anchored in Scripture.
Whether you're a lifelong Christian or just starting your journey, Bible Chat gives you everything you need to:
• Understand the Bible Better - Learn what the Bible really means with helpful guides and simple explanations that make God's Word easier to follow and apply.
• Grow Your Prayer Habit - Build a consistent prayer routine supported by daily inspiration and the power of a praying community.
• Make Faith Part of Your Day - Improve your daily routine with spiritual prompts, Christian calendar reminders, and faith tools designed for the whole family.
• Support Your Mental Health - Find peace and calm in moments of stress with simple tools that help you refocus on God’s strength.
• Make Faith Fun and Interactive - Enjoy fun and easy ways to learn, think, and talk about how faith fits into your everyday life.
Key Features to Explore:
• Daily Plan: Stay on track with your faith. Follow a simple daily plan that helps you grow closer to God, one step at a time.
• Structured Bible Study Plans: Follow simple Bible reading plans made for real life. Some of the topics include: healing, wisdom, leadership, grief, and more.
• Holy Calendar: See important Christian days in a monthly view. Never miss a feast, saint day, or holy event again.
• Panic Button: Struggling with stress or temptation? Tap the Panic Button for guided deep breathing exercises that calm the mind and provide anxiety relief.
• Live Prayer: Share your prayer intentions, and let's pray together to grow closer to God.
• Send a Blessing: Send a Bible verse with a kind message straight to a friend’s phone. Add a heart or doodle to make it personal and uplifting.
• Bible Stories for Kids: Turn screen time into faith time! Show fun, Bible-based stories and videos to your kids.
• Multiple Bible Versions: Read the Bible the way you like best. Choose from NKJV, KJV, WMB, FBV, World English Bible, Amplified, and NASB.
• Bible Verse Widget: See a new Bible verse every day, right on your lock screen or home screen.
• Bible Trivia: Challenge and enhance your biblical knowledge through interactive trivia games.
• Verse Locator: Looking for a verse? Search and find it fast, along with what it means.
• Personalized Devotionals & Prayers: Start your day with custom devotionals and write your own prayers to stay closer to God.
• Biblical Character Profiles: Learn about the people in the Bible: their stories, struggles, and how God worked in their lives.
• Let's Discuss Faith: Join honest chats about how faith connects to your real life - like work, family, and relationships.
Experience More with Premium:
Unlock unlimited conversations, full access to every feature, and exclusive designs for your Daily Prayer Widgets. Start with a FREE 7-day trial, then choose our weekly plan at $4.99 or opt for extended plans for greater savings.
Privacy Policy & Terms and Conditions:
https://thebiblechat.com/privacy-policy/
https://thebiblechat.com/terms-and-conditions/
Join Our Thriving Community:
Join a friendly community of people who love God or are just starting to learn. With Bible Chat and the new Send a Blessing Widget, you can make Bible verses and prayer part of your everyday conversations.

bluejetty:00070472:ios.name: Simple Transfer Pro - Photos
bluejetty:00070472:ios.summary:
With over 7 million downloads, Simple Transfer is the easiest way of transferring your photos and large videos to computer using WiFi or USB. It can also convert HEIC photos to JPG, HEVC videos to MOV/MP4 and Live Photos to videos.
Reviews
bluejetty:00070472:ios.description:
With over 7 million downloads, Simple Transfer is the easiest way of transferring your photos and large videos to computer using WiFi or USB. It can also convert HEIC photos to JPG, HEVC videos to MOV/MP4 and Live Photos to videos.
Reviews:
●●●●● "Have never looked back since finding this app! Couldn't live without it now."
●●●●● "Works beautifully: I wish this was easier to find. It’s amazing how much time you can waste trying to transfer things from iPhone/iPad to PC, and all along this app was here, making it so easy."
Main Features:
◉ View all your photo albums and videos on your computer and download them by a single click via WiFi or USB cable.
◉ Save photos and videos from your computer to your iPhone/iPad
◉ Export photos as JPG (Windows compatible) or HEIC 
◉ Convert videos as MOV or MP4 (Windows compatible H.264 format)
◉ Export Live Photos to video or photo+video
◉ Photo Cleaner: clear space on your device by deleting large or duplicate photos and videos (premium feature).
◉ Photo Organizer: easily select and filter photos to delete, favorite or unfavorite them
◉ Free up space by automatically deleting transferred photos/videos (optional)
◉ Support for the new Apple's ProRaw and other RAW formats
◉ Safest way to transfer your photos and videos in your local WiFi network. They never go on the Internet or stored on any external server.
◉ Transfer photos and videos between iOS devices (iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch), select an album and tap on "Select All" to transfer all your photos/videos*
◉ Photos are transferred with full resolution including metadata and videos transferred with the highest quality available
◉ Works on Windows, Mac and Linux and it's fast!
Simple Transfer does not use or transfer your files to any external server. It provides a completely private website to be accessed by only computers that are directly connected to your local WiFi network. Your photos and videos cannot be accessed from the Internet.
Please contact our support directly at support@rambax.com or send an email from inside the app regarding any questions, suggestions or concerns.

bluejetty:00171455:ios.description:
In today’s digital world, passwords alone aren’t enough to keep your online accounts safe. That’s where Authenticator: Mobile 2FA, MFA comes in. This app adds an extra layer of security to your accounts by generating secure, time-based one-time passwords (TOTP), ensuring only you can access your data.
Whether you're logging into your email, social media, banking apps, or work accounts, our two-factor authentication (2FA) and multi-factor authentication (MFA) solution makes account protection easier and more reliable than ever.
Protect your data with our powerful authenticator app. This password app enhances security using two factor authentication codes that refresh every 30 secs. Store all accounts in one password app, backed by two factor authentication and offline access. The authenticator app is your go-to password app for secure two factor authentication. Download our authenticator app now for total peace of mind.
Why Choose Our Authenticator App?
Fast & Easy Setup
Securing your accounts takes just a few seconds. Simply scan a QR code or enter your account details manually, and the app will instantly generate secure 6-digit codes for login authentication. No complicated setup—just instant protection.
Secure Time-Based One-Time Passwords (TOTP)
With 2FA and MFA, the app generates TOTP codes that refresh every 30 seconds, keeping your logins safe from hackers. Even if someone gets your password, they can’t access your account without the verification code.
Store & Manage All Your Accounts in One Place
Tired of juggling multiple authentication apps? Keep all your 2FA-protected accounts securely stored in one app—whether it’s email, social media, cryptocurrency wallets, or online banking.
Works Completely Offline
Unlike SMS-based authentication, our app doesn’t require an internet connection. Your one-time passwords are generated directly on your device, so you can log in securely anytime, anywhere.
Secure Cloud Backup & Device Sync
Never lose access to your 2FA codes again. With cloud backup and device syncing, you can restore your authentication data when switching to a new phone.
Advanced Security Features
Biometric & PIN protection – Lock the app using a fingerprint, Face ID, or a PIN for extra security.
Auto-fill & Copy to Clipboard – Quickly enter your 2FA codes without hassle.
Multiple device support – Access your authentication codes from different devices without losing security.
How Does It Work?
Install Authenticator: Mobile 2FA, MFA on your device.
Scan a QR code or enter the secret key manually.
Use the generated 6-digit codes to log in securely.
That’s it. Your accounts are now protected with an extra security layer.
Stay One Step Ahead of Hackers
Cyber threats are increasing every day—don’t wait until it’s too late. Download Authenticator: Mobile 2FA, MFA now and take control of your online security.

bluejetty:00135666:ios.name: RCam - Manual Camera & RAW
bluejetty:00135666:ios.summary: RCam is a professional video recording and photo shooting application designed for iOS devices. It provides professional tools including focus peaking, false color, Histogram and support for PRORAW / RAW shooting --DNG export photos. It g
bluejetty:00135666:ios.description:
RCam is a professional video recording and photo shooting application designed for iOS devices. It provides professional tools including focus peaking, false color, Histogram and support for PRORAW / RAW shooting --DNG export photos. It gives you audio metering, custom resolutions, and framerates. To build eight kinds of professional model, and its manual mode has extremely fast response speed, allowing you to control the shooting parameters freely.
Camera eight modes:
1. Slow motion --- Support 24fps , 30fps , 48fps , 50fps , 60fps different frame rates
2. Time-lapse ---- Support 24~60 different frame rate settings, adjust the shutter interval and set the automatic shooting time
3. Video --- Support 1080P, 3k, 4K, and dolby vision video shooting, 24~60 different frame rate settings, up to 100 Mb/s encoding rate, self-timer, beauty filter
4. Photo -- Support PRORAW, RAW, HDR, AEB ,self-timer, beauty filter , and aspect ratio (4:3 / 3:2 / 16:9 / 1:1)
5. Night mode-- Supports 1s, 2s, 4s and other slow shutter speed settings
6. Motion Blur - Easily generate personalized special effects photos such as water fog effects
7. Light painting -- support sensitivity adjustment
8. Light field - easy to take pictures first, focus, every detail is retained
Camera function:
• Focus peaking and expanded focus for manual focus assist
• False Color exposure assist
• Manual exposure and focus control - select individual focus and exposure, drag to adjust
• Manual control: exposure, shutter speed, focus, zoom, ISO
• Focus, exposure, and white balance (WB) lock
• Support freely settable delay photography
• Anti-shake - Active video anti-shake eliminates sloshing during shooting
• Support HEVC and H.264 video encoding
• Support JPEG、TIFF、HEIF and RAW format photos
• Support RAW、HDR、AEB
• Support setting aspect ratio of photo: 1:1 / 4:3 / 3:2 / 16:9
• Support multiple resolution settings for video: 720P, 1080P, 1440P, 3k, 4k
• Support Video frame rate : 24fps , 25fps , 30fps , 48fps , 50fps , 60fps 
• Mobile space and mobile phone battery display
• Slow motion video mode, 6 playback speeds (60 fps / 50 fps / 48fps / 30fps / 25fps / 24fps)
• 6x digital zoom
• Volume meter
• Location
• Snap to the grid
• Flash settings (Auto / On / Off)
Video sharing:
• Support for exporting videos to photo albums
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
• You can subscribe for RCam VIP Subscriptions to all features and content offered for purchase within the app.
• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan. RCam offers four auto-renewing subscription options:
(i) $3.99 / Year ($3.99 billed once a year after the 3 days free trial expires)
(ii) $0.99 / week
(iii) $2.49 / Month
(iiii) $3.99 / Year
• You can subscribe to a yearly plan ($3.99 billed once a year), a monthly plan ($2.49 billed once a month), a weekly plan ($0.99 billed once a week) or a yearly plan that comes with a free 3 days trial ($3.99 billed once a year after the free trial expires). The prices are in US dollars. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- Privacy policy: https://appsdevelopinfo.web.app/2018/08/18/RCamPrivacyPolicy
- Terms of use : https://appsdevelopinfo.web.app/2018/08/18/RCamTerms

bluejetty:00031532:ios.name: Firetruck Games For Kids 2-5
bluejetty:00031532:ios.summary: Get ready for an amazing firefighting adventure with Timpy Kids Firefighter Games for kids! It's like being a real hero, saving the day! When you hear a 911 call for help, it's time to jump into action. Put on your cool firesuit and rush to
bluejetty:00031532:ios.description:
Get ready for an amazing firefighting adventure with Timpy Kids Firefighter Games for kids! It's like being a real hero, saving the day! When you hear a 911 call for help, it's time to jump into action. Put on your cool firesuit and rush to where someone needs your help!
In this awesome game, you'll face challenges that will test your skills and make your brain work. First, there are shadow-matching games that will make you think and observe. You have to match the shapes of firefighting tools with their shadows. It's not just fun; it teaches you about the important tools firefighters use to fight fires.
But wait, there's more! Get ready for some super fun drag-and-drop games. You'll have to help the firefighters put the right equipment in the right places. It's like solving puzzles and using your hand-eye coordination at the same time. These games will keep you entertained for hours and also help you become better at solving problems.
Once you're done with the challenges, it's time to jump into the fire engine and hit the road. But watch out for obstacles on the streets! You need to clear the way for your team by removing these obstacles. The streets are so colorful and vibrant that it feels like you're there, driving the fire engine to the rescue.
When you arrive at the burning building, you'll see cute characters that need your help. It's your mission to rescue them! Use your quick thinking and bravery to guide your firefighter through the dangerous flames and obstacles. Every successful rescue will make you feel amazing!
Now comes the exciting part. You must connect the hose to the fire hydrant and extinguish the flames. Aim carefully and control the water flow to put out the fire completely. It's like a real firefighting mission, and it's so thrilling to see the flames disappear, knowing you saved the day!
Features of Timpy Kids Firefighter Games:
Rich, vibrant graphics:
The game is designed with beautiful and colorful graphics that make playing enjoyable and engaging. You'll feel like you're part of an exciting firefighting adventure!
Shadow matching games:
These games help kids and toddlers improve their observation skills. By matching the shapes of firefighting tools with their shadows, you'll become better at noticing details and making connections.
Drag and drop games:
These fun games have lots of benefits for kids and toddlers. They help improve problem-solving abilities and hand-eye coordination. You'll have to think and use your hands to place the right equipment in the right spots, just like real firefighters!
Keeps kids engaged and occupied:
 With different challenges and missions, you'll never get bored. It's a great way to have fun and learn at the same time.
Suitable for kids of all ages:
Whether you're a little kid or a bit older, this game is perfect. The gameplay is designed to be fun and engaging for kids of all ages. It doesn't matter if you're a beginner or a pro, you'll enjoy playing and improving your skills.
Subscription Details:
-Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Subscriptions in your App Store Settings.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.timpygames.com/privacypolicy.php 
Terms of Service: https://www.idzdigital.com/terms_of_service.php
So, what are you waiting for? Download Timpy Kids Firefighter Games now and prepare for the adventure of a lifetime! Become a hero, save lives, and experience the joy of being a true firefighter. It's time to answer the call and show the world how brave you are!

It is intended for beginners who
bluejetty:00120310:ios.description:
Loecsen – Learn to use a language in daily life
This app gives access to the introductory learning content from Loecsen.
It is designed to help learners reach the A1 level (CEFR) in more than 50 languages.
It is intended for beginners who want to understand and use a language with common words, clear pronunciation, and simple sentences.
On the Loecsen website, learning progress is saved and the learning path is personalized.
With this app, the content can be downloaded and used offline.
Key features
• Structured introductory content from Loecsen
• Designed to reach A1 CEFR
• Available in 50+ languages
• Audio recordings with native speakers
• Quizzes to support understanding and memorization
• Works offline after download
• Free access
What you will learn
The app teaches essential words and phrases, organized by common situations, such as:
Essentials, Conversation, Looking for someone, Time, Parting, Bar, Restaurant, Taxi, Transportation, Hotel, Beach, Family, Feelings, Learning, Colours, Numbers, In case of trouble.
The expressions are not literal translations.
They correspond to expressions commonly used in each language, based on professional linguistic work.
This app can be used as a first step before continuing learning on Loecsen.com, where progress is tracked and adapted to the learner.
Offline learning
After download, the app can be used without an internet connection.
If the device has very little available storage, the app may close after launch.
Freeing up storage space may solve this issue.
User feedback helps improve the content and the app.

bluejetty:00060772:ios.description:
Wattpad. Stories to obsess over.
Discover the world's most-loved social storytelling platform. Wattpad connects a global community of millions of readers and writers through the power of story. Download it today to start reading or writing original stories.
Get your story discovered
Have your own story to tell? Get it discovered through the power of community and technology on Wattpad. Share an original story on Wattpad and share it with our community who are there to cheer you on throughout your writing journey. Think your story could be the next blockbuster? Wattpad Studios discovers untapped, unsigned, and talented writers on Wattpad and connects them to global multi-media entertainment companies.
Read original stories
Discover stories in over 25 languages from writers around the world! Whatever you’re into reading—romance, science fiction, mystery, comedy, action adventure, fantasy, young adult fiction, or fanfiction—it’s all on Wattpad. So whether you’re looking for more LGBT meet-cutes, cyberpunk fairy tales, or new technothrillers to devour, you’ll find it all, and so much more, on Wattpad.
Connect with a community of story-lovers
When you join Wattpad, you become a member of an international community of story-lovers. Connect with other passionate readers & writers, comment directly in stories as you read them, and support writers as they create and share their original stories. You can even read together and share your library or create reading lists so your friends always know what you’re reading.
Start your own free library
Save your favorite stories to keep them with you wherever you go. Hooked on a story? Simply sync your account to easily pick up where you left off, whether you’re on your laptop, tablet, Kindle or iPhone.
Read the stories that inspired blockbusters
If you’ve streamed Light as a Feather on Hulu or read New York Times best-seller Anna Todd’s series After, you may not know—these stories were first discovered on Wattpad. Join the platform the entertainment industry scours to find its next big hit, and start reading tomorrow’s box-office sensation today.
Wattpad Premium:
- Subscribe to Wattpad Premium for uninterrupted ads-free reading and first access to new features
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the cost of the chosen package
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- For full terms of service, visit https://www.wattpad.com/terms
- For our privacy policy, visit https://www.wattpad.com/privacy
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Already a Wattpad fan? Follow us on Instagram, Facebook and Twitter to stay up-to-date on your favorite writers, stories, contests, and more!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wattpad/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@wattpad
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/wattpad/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/wattpad
