bluejetty:00016173:ios.name: Chess-Studio
bluejetty:00016173:ios.summary:
Chess Studio is the first and only application for iPhone and iPad able to manage chess databases and games in PGN format in a complete and efficient way.
Chess Studio is an application designed and built for those players who really want
bluejetty:00016173:ios.description:
Chess Studio is the first and only application for iPhone and iPad able to manage chess databases and games in PGN format in a complete and efficient way.
Chess Studio is an application designed and built for those players who really want to deepen their knowledge in the field of chess, studying chess regularly and participate in tournaments.
Chess Studio allows you to:
• Read database and games in PGN format (also with extended notation of moves).
• Create, delete and modify folders and databases.
• View games with annotations and textual comments and keep track of the displayed games.
• Use a double chessboard on the same screen for better game analysis. 
• Visualize moves and variants in compact mode or indented mode.
• Modify existing games with move annotation and textual comments.
• Insert new games and positions.
• Insert, replay and analyze games in Chess 960 mode.
• Insert moves with annotations and textual comments.
• Insert variation, subvariations etc.
• Insert and visualize graphical annotation (colored arrows and highlighted squares).
• Share Databases and Games through Airdrop.
• Download chess database from internet.
• Download chess database directly from PGN Mentor site.
• Import games, database and Opening Books from other applications.
• Merge two or more databases.
• Copy/Paste games and positions.
• Analyze games with Stockfish 19 Engine with the support of the Neural Networks (up to 5 lines of analysis simultaneously) with the support of the Engine Evaluation Bar.
• Replay games automatically.
• Visualize Pawn structure.
• Manage Variations and sub-variatons: delete and promote variations.
• Read the weekly Magazine The New In Chess (TWIC) and download the games.
• Uploading and Downloading PGN Database to/from Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive.
• Three different modes for moving pieces.
• Analyze endgames with Endgame Tablebases.
• Analyze and study Chess Openings in the Chess Openings Section.
• Create and manage Opening Books in Polyglot format.
• Import and manage ChessBase Opening Books (ctg format).
• Automatically classify a database according to ECO code.
• Replay, enter and analyze Chess 960 games (Fischer Random Chess).
• Play against the engine both in standard mode and in Chess 960 mode.
• Play online through the LiChess platform
• Train by solving Puzzles
• ChessBase Database support.
• Diagram Recognition: this feature allows the user to take and/or upload photos of chess diagrams and convert them into PGN format positions.
Other features and technical details:
• Modify the board size.
• Professional chess fonts and figurines for moves notation and annotation.
• Preview of the game in the board tapping the Info button.
• Quick search feature.
• Advanced search feature.
• Complete management of Null Moves with Tutorial.
• Visualization of ECO code and Opening during game replay or game insertion. 
• Visualization of Book Openings during game replay or game insertion. 
• Portrait/Landscape mode for all devices.
• Support of Slide Over and Split View mode.
• Function to move up within variants and subvariants. 
• iOS 26 compatible and optimized for all the devices.
• Sharing of databases across devices via iCloud Drive (also with Chess Studio for Mac OS).
• Sound option.
• Support for iPad Pro Keyboard or bluetooth keyboard.
• VoiceOver/Accessibility support.
• Direct contact via email with the developer to report problems, ask for explanation and suggestions (very quick answer!).
• Languages: English, Italian, Spanish and German.
Complete description at: https://chessstudio.wordpress.com/chess-studio/
To view the privacy policy and Terms of Use (EULA) visit https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
The application is continuously updated with new features and improvements.
No registration!
No advertising!
No sharing of personal data!

Save with LogiConnect

Dive into a curated, ad-free collection of swoon-worthy roma
bluejetty:00086976:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Explore a world of sweet and spicy romance. You're the main character in these interactive stories, and your choices shape how each chapter unfolds.
Dive into a curated, ad-free collection of swoon-worthy romantic stories — tailored to mature audiences — from the creators of "Episode," a choice-driven storytelling game and platform with millions of players around the world. Netflix members can enjoy brand-new exclusive stories alongside extra-steamy retellings of "Episode" favorites.
Star in your own romantic drama as you step into the shoes of compelling new characters: a high school grad exploring Europe with a surprisingly sexy chaperone ("Wherever We Go"); a dog lover fighting to save a shelter while resisting an inconvenient crush ("Don't You Dare"); a young dancer falling for a boxer who faces dangerous rivals ("The Knockout") — and many more.
YOUR CHOICES, YOUR STORY 
The decisions you make, from what you say to who you date, influence how each story plays out. Have a change of heart? Replay stories with new choices to unlock unique interactions and alternate endings.
SERVED EXTRA SPICY
Anyone can appreciate a great love story — but these interactive romances are designed for players age 17 and up, who are comfortable with plenty of sexy and steamy moments.
BE WHOEVER YOU DREAM OF
Customize both your character and your love interest for each story, from gender and body type to facial features and hairstyle. You can also choose new outfits for key story moments.
FREE TO CHOOSE
Immerse yourself in every story, with no interruptions from in-game ads. Balanced choice options give you the freedom to experience the story that's right for you.
- Created by Episode Interactive.

bluejetty:00092571:ios.description:
The Airties Vision app allows you to setup, monitor and control your Airties powered home Wi-Fi network. In a few simple steps, the app helps you install your Airties Wi-Fi mesh extenders and view your home network map, devices and connections in real-time. You will be able to run a speed test, manage who has Wi-Fi access – and when – through parental controls and guest network options. 
The Airties Vision app is designed to work with recent Airties Wi-Fi products and does not support legacy Airties modems or repeaters. Currently supported products are Air 4960, Air 4960R, Air 4930 and Air 4920. These products are provided to you by your internet service provider.
New features recently introduced:
• Carry out a speed test directly through the app
• Enhanced security with anti-hacking and threat deflection features with reporting on blocked devices and websites
• Easier identification of connected devices through listing of model / make instead of just MAC address 
App highlights:
• Get step by step guidance for installing Airties Wi-Fi mesh extenders 
• Display your network map along with real-time connection indicators
• List all connected devices, rename them and prioritize the top 3
• Define profiles for family members with tailored access rules, or create a temporary guest connection
• Check your network data usage
• Configure your Wi-Fi network name and password
The Airties Vision app is regularly updated with new features and capabilities, stay tuned for upcoming releases!

bluejetty:00116576:ios.description:

Generate professional invoices and estimates in just seconds. Accept card payments instantly, track expenses effortlessly, and keep all your data securely synced across devices.
NEW: Estimate your federal and state tax refund right inside the app.
CREATING AN INVOICE IS EASY
1. Tap "Create Invoice"
2. Select your client from contacts
3. Add items and prices
4. Save and send — done!
ESTIMATE GENERATOR
• Send professional estimates to win more jobs
• Get approved to kickstart new projects
INVOICE GENERATOR
• Send professional invoices in seconds
• Add your logo, client info, and payment details
• Clear, detailed invoices help you get paid faster
TAX REFUND CALCULATOR
• Estimate your federal & state income tax refund in minutes
• Enter W-2 wages, deductions, and credits

• Standard & itemized deductions
• Tax credits: Child Tax Credit, EITC, Education Credits
• Invoice income auto-included for self-employment calculation
ONLINE CLIENT PORTAL
• Centralized hub for managing client information
• Manage, sort, and tag clients
• Track each client's revenue
• All data organized in one place
EXPORT YOUR DATA
• Export invoices, expenses, and reports
• Supports Google Sheets, PDF, Excel, Zip
• Make data-driven business decisions
GET PAID FASTER
• Accept cards with simple, low-rate fee structure

• Scan and store receipts instantly
• Smart recognition of receipt details
• Effortless expense tracking
REPORTING
• Detailed financial reports at your fingertips
• Comprehensive analytics and expense tracking
• Clear, easy-to-understand insights
STAY ORGANIZED
• Track invoice status — see when viewed, who hasn't paid

• Track receipts and time for accurate billing

PERFECT FOR GROWING BUSINESSES
• Create estimates, invoices, and receipts fast

•Earn nobility ranks and climb the ladder of power.
•Trade resources with merchants and other players.

“Do all humans smell this intoxicating? I want to devour you.”
The werewolves press their nose against my neck, inhaling my scent.
Amidst these werewolves, survival becomes a challenge as they refuse to leave me alone.
Will ‘I’ be able to survive?
[Moonlight Crush’s Storyline]
“Beware the golden eyes. They will persistently pursue you.”
With the sudden death of my grandmother and her cryptic last words, I found ‘myself’ alone and soon after, caught in an accident that led me to a mysterious place. The world of wolves? Werewolves?
“You have to return quickly. The moment they find out there’s a human here…”
However, as time passed, an inexplicable attraction grew, driving us to desire each other.
“Here you are!”
And then, mysterious forces began to pressure us…
Embark on a heart-pounding and dangerous romance with the werewolves under the captivating moonlit sky!
[About Moonlight Crush]
Moonlight Crush: Fantasy Otome by Storytaco invites you into a captivating world of mature romance and fantasy. Dive into a choice-based story game where your decisions shape your destiny. Craft your unique romance with enigmatic werewolves in a world full of stunning twists and turns of Moonlight Crush!
(WARNING!) Every choice you make alters your fate with the werewolves!
[Moonlight Crush’s Main Points]
① A thrilling romance story for mature users!
② A variety of character costumes that lead to your desired ending!
③ Increase your character's favorability and collect various high-quality romantic mood illustrations!
[Moonlight Crush is recommended for]
- Those who want to enjoy a realistic female-oriented dating simulation.
- Those drawn to sexy and compelling characters within a role-playing experience.
- Those intrigued in trying a female-oriented visual novel game
- Those who want to see immersive, high-quality date illustrations
- Those eager to explore various story endings shaped by your strategic choices.
- Those who enjoy making decisions at pivotal moments, influencing the narrative’s direction.
- Those who seek the excitement of balancing danger with the charm of otome and dating simulations.
Discover more games and news from Storytaco!

bluejetty:00124093:ios.description:
Uphill offroad bus simulator 2025 is an outstanding game that lets you to be an extreme tourist bus driver. Wonderful 3D mountain and uphill environment, real bus engine physics, and movement of passengers and tourists will make you feel like an real bus driver. Driving bus coach full of tourists is really a challenging task. Your duty is to pick up the tourists and drop them off safe and sound to their endpoints or destinations. 
Uphill offroad bus driving and Bus parking is a game for all those who are crazy for bus driving simulation games. Take on the life-threatening hill driving adventure in this extreme off-road bus driving game and show your precise driving and parking skills by transporting tourists to their destination by passing through beautiful mountains, rocks and water. There are no pet driving rules, so drive as fast as you can but be cautious about the safety and security of the tourists. 
Start the life taking offroad tour and feel the excitement and adventure of driving heavy vehicle transportation bus in this mountain tourist bus driving game. Drive different buses for hours and drop the passengers to their destinations. Tourists and other passengers want to reach their destinations on time so make use of your expert driving skills to take them but avoid roadside accidents as the traffic vehicles are flowing from both sides. You have to be very careful at some turns because these turns are very sharp and curvy. Your one mistake can lead to dangerous situations, so be careful and drive & park the bus coach by using all your senses. You can test your driving skills by playing free mode of dr driving bus game. Once you master the offroad driving skills then you can go for carrier mode for different challenging missions.
Earn as much as you can by carrying tourists in this marvelous us uphill bus simulation game. You can unlock other buses by investing the cash which you would earn by transporting the passengers and other tourists, these buses are differ in their engine power, speed and look n feel.
Features of Uphill offroad bus driving simulator 2025:
• Adventurous & exciting multiple challenging levels.
• Extreme off road stunts
• Character Animations
• Free and carrier mode
• Door open/close animations
• HD and Amazing 3D Graphics
• Day Mode fun gameplay
• Realistic controls over the offroad environment
• Easy and free to use
• Offline Game Play
• Amazing camera view to deliver you realistic bus driving experience
• Explore the beautiful open world hilly and mountainous environment
So!! What are you waiting for? Download it now for extreme offroad driving experience, and master the skills of driving long vehicles over the curvy roads of hilly areas. 
Leave your valuable feedback for our appreciation and improvement.

bluejetty:00085720:ios.summary:
The Hospiten App has been designed to provide an intuitive, accessible, and seamless experience, allowing you to manage your healthcare easily from your smartphone, wherever you are.
Quickly and securely access Hospiten's digital services
bluejetty:00085720:ios.description:
The Hospiten App has been designed to provide an intuitive, accessible, and seamless experience, allowing you to manage your healthcare easily from your smartphone, wherever you are.
Quickly and securely access Hospiten's digital services and manage all your healthcare needs from a single app. Schedule and manage medical appointments, view medical reports and test results, download documents, and much more through a redesigned interface created to make your experience as a patient simpler and more convenient.
The latest version also includes faster and more secure access with biometric authentication.
If you already have an account for Hospiten Online Appointments, simply sign in using your existing credentials—no need to register again.
With the Hospiten App, you can:
Schedule appointments with our specialists.
Manage, reschedule, or cancel appointments.
Search for Hospiten physicians and medical centers.
View your upcoming and completed diagnostic tests.
Review your appointment history and upcoming visits.
Access laboratory results and other diagnostic test results.
View and download medical reports.
Download invoices.
Check your pending diagnostic tests.
Request proof of attendance for your medical appointments.
Hospiten offers a comprehensive range of medical specialties, diagnostic services, and healthcare solutions provided by a team of professionals committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care. The Hospiten App is your primary digital companion, giving you greater convenience, accessibility, and control over your healthcare.
Download the Hospiten App and manage your healthcare—all in one place.
App Permissions
To provide the best possible experience, the app may request access to:
Location: to estimate your travel time to the medical center when you have a scheduled appointment.
Files and Storage: to download medical reports, test results, invoices, and other documents.
Calendar: to add your Hospiten appointments to your device's calendar and send reminders.
Other required permissions: necessary to ensure the proper operation of the app.

Stop switching between crypto exchange terminals and getting red eyes from monitoring the market's ever-fluctuating prices before making moves. 3Commas has
bluejetty:00077321:ios.description:
Introducing the New 3Commas App: Your Complete Crypto Portfolio Management Solution
Stop switching between crypto exchange terminals and getting red eyes from monitoring the market's ever-fluctuating prices before making moves. 3Commas has a better-automated solution. 
Your One-Stop Crypto Hub
3Commas is not just another Bitcoin app; it's a non-custodial all-in-one crypto management software. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned professional, we provide the essential tools for you to nurture and expand your crypto holdings.
The new AI Assistant: Get a smart trading assistant to turn your strategy idea into bot settings, run backtests and refine your bot in minutes.
Streamline Your Trading
• Manage Multiple Exchanges, One Interface: Simplify your crypto strategy by connecting your favorite exchange and orchestrating moves across various exchanges from a unified, user-friendly interface. Get real-time updates on your portfolio's performance effortlessly. It's tough to find another crypto app or exchange terminal that can match 3Commas' comprehensive capabilities. We support Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, and many other exchanges. 
Minimize Risk, Maximize Opportunities
• Automated Triggers: When the markets go wild, you can remain calm. 3Commas allows you to set up alerts and automatically trigger actions to safeguard or enhance your assets on any exchange account.
• Empower Your Investments with Crypto Bots: 3Commas provides highly customizable bots with advanced features for professionals while also offering ready-made bot templates created by other users that you can select and customize for your specific needs.
Effortless Portfolio Management
• Monitor Your Holdings with Ease: Set up a portfolio tracker to monitor crypto-asset performance with real-time coin market prices using a customizable chart interface with a visually intuitive experience.
Stay Informed, Stay Ahead
• Real-Time Notifications: You don't need to obsessively watch your portfolio. Customize your notifications, and 3Commas can send you push notifications for significant events so you can take action.
A Supportive Community and Dedicated Team
• You're Not Alone: Join the vast 3Commas crypto community for insights and tips. Plus, our responsive support team is available through in-app chat or email if you need assistance with 3Commas services.
Upgrade to the all-new 3Commas, the ultimate crypto management software. Embrace the future of crypto management today!

bluejetty:00126924:ios.name: Miko - Play, Learn, & Connect
bluejetty:00126924:ios.summary: The Miko App allows you to connect with the Miko 3 and Miko Mini robots, opening the door to endless fun, learning, and entertainment. Powered by advanced AI and GPT, Miko isn’t just a robot—it’s a friend that helps kids learn and grow thro
bluejetty:00126924:ios.description:
The Miko App allows you to connect with the Miko 3 and Miko Mini robots, opening the door to endless fun, learning, and entertainment. Powered by advanced AI and GPT, Miko isn’t just a robot—it’s a friend that helps kids learn and grow through interactive play.
From gamified educational activities to lively dance sessions and heartfelt conversations, Miko is here to entertain, educate, and be your child's ultimate social companion.
Features of Miko 3 and Miko Mini:
Talk to Miko: Ignite kids’ curiosity. Encourage them to ask Miko about science, animals, space, architecture or plants and watch Miko respond in its signature witty and playful style.
Apps: Kids can explore a world of puzzles, games, stories, dance, and music curated by educators and child development experts. Miko 3 and Mini have a different set of apps.
Open-ended Conversations: This is an advanced AI feature that allows your kid to have fun, educational, and age-appropriate conversations with Miko 3 on topics such as Space, Wildlife, History, and Geography, as well as jokes, Dinosaurs, and riddles.
Video Call: Unlimited video calls from the Miko app to Miko 3 and Miko Mini. 
Miko Max: A one-stop destination for premium content from award-winning, beloved children’s brands. Your kid gets to explore 1000+ stories, games, shows and music.
Profile Settings: Modify the timezone and language, voice sensitivity for your Miko 3 and Mini
Parental Controls: Set a bedtime, limit screen time and lock apps to guide your kid’s usage.
Blogs: Read about Miko’s talents, latest features, and troubleshooting.
Customer Support: Contact Team Miko over chat if you want help or face any issues.
Miko has a world of learning disguised as activities, STEM shows and games, the ability to have the most fun conversations and a knack for engaging children with varied interests. Get to know Miko, your child’s new companion.
Miko Max Subscription
Miko Max is an auto-renewable subscription that unlocks unlimited access to premium content, advanced AI features, and exclusive experiences on the Miko App and Miko robots.
Plans Available: We have two plans available, 1) Monthly at $15 per month and 2) Yearly at $99 per year.
Subscription Details:
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase confirmation.
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Renewal is charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.miko.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://storage.googleapis.com/miko3-parental/termsandcondition/Miko-Max-Terms-of-Use.pdf

bluejetty:00174980:ios.summary: Embark on a lifelong journey to wellness with Glo. Glo is your premier digital gateway to feeling more connected, grounded, and vibrant whether you are at home or on the move. Our mission is to bring the best yoga, meditation, Pilates, and
bluejetty:00174980:ios.description:
Embark on a lifelong journey to wellness with Glo. Glo is your premier digital gateway to feeling more connected, grounded, and vibrant whether you are at home or on the move. Our mission is to bring the best yoga, meditation, Pilates, and fitness classes directly to you, led by the world's top instructors. Tailored to fit your unique life stages, Glo supports you from the moment you roll out your mat to the final restorative savasana.
Experience the richness of 25+ styles of yoga, Pilates, meditation, and fitness workouts designed to meet you at every experience level. From soothing Yin and Restorative yoga to energizing Vinyasa flows and strength building Pilates, every class is an opportunity to nurture your body and mind. Explore specialized styles including Hatha, Ashtanga, Iyengar, Kundalini, Power Yoga, Qigong, Tao Yin, and Yoga Conditioning. Push your limits with Barre, HIIT, Cardio, and Strength classes. Calm your mind with guided Meditation, Breathwork, Visualization, Yoga Nidra, and Mindfulness sessions. Our library features thousands of sessions ranging from 5 minute morning stretches to 90 minute advanced workshops.
Dive into our extensive on demand library to fit wellness into your busy schedule. Glo's advanced personalization features let you curate your own wellness path by saving your favorite classes, building collections, and tracking your activity.
Learn from globally recognized teachers who provide compassionate instruction and expert support. Whether you are seeking to start a meditation habit, explore the foundations of Pilates, or deepen your yoga practice, our instructors are here to guide you. Discover mindful movement and specialized programs for every life stage, including prenatal, postnatal, and midlife wellness.
Glo is more than an app; it is a supportive community of like minded individuals working toward personal growth and longevity. Start your 7 day free trial today and experience why millions trust Glo for their at home fitness and healthy aging journey.
Whatever you are working toward, Glo has a program designed to get you there. Choose from over 90 expert-led programs spanning sleep, core strength, flexibility, back care, energy, emotional health and recovery, physical rehabilitation, focus and productivity, and more. Each program is a curated multi class series that builds progressively so you see real results week over week.
At Glo, we believe movement is the key to longevity. Our programs support healthy aging with dedicated paths for functional mobility, balance, joint health, and bone strength. From gentle chair yoga for seniors to dynamic stretching for athletes, Glo helps you move with ease. Explore Wall Pilates, core strengthening, and targeted routines for the hips, back, and shoulders to stay active and injury free at every age.
Navigate the transitions of perimenopause and menopause with specialized classes that address hot flashes, sleep disruptions, and mood shifts through cooling breathwork, restorative poses, and weight bearing exercises. Glo also offers comprehensive prenatal and postnatal programs to support you through every stage of motherhood.
Build lean muscle and support skeletal health with our Pilates, Yoga Conditioning, and fitness classes. Using body weight, resistance bands, or light weights, follow guided sessions that prioritize safe alignment and effective results.

bluejetty:00063534:ios.name: Inkpad - Graphic Design
bluejetty:00063534:ios.summary:
Create beautiful vector artwork on your iPad with Inkpad.
Draw with accuracy and speed.
Quickly align new or existing objects either to a grid, points, or path edges. Alternatively draw freehand bezier paths using the brush tool. Select
bluejetty:00063534:ios.description:
Create beautiful vector artwork on your iPad with Inkpad.
Draw with accuracy and speed.
Quickly align new or existing objects either to a grid, points, or path edges. Alternatively draw freehand bezier paths using the brush tool. Select, scale and rotate hundreds of objects with high performance in real time. Cutout elements of artwork, photographs or patterns with masks.
Flexible typography effects.
Position text at any angle or to follow along paths. Apply multiple effects to text, with stroke, fill, shadow and opacity all dynamically adjustable. If the over seventy built in fonts don’t quite fit your design, you can import any of the millions of OpenType and TrueType fonts available.
Take control with unlimited layers.
Feel free to add as many or as few elements in each layer to organise your drawings. Rename, rearrange, delete, hide and lock layers as you draw. Isolate the active layer for easy editing. Adjust each layers transparency independently to get your ideal composition.
Powerful editing at your fingertips.
Easily manipulate single or multiple elements with powerful scale and rotate tools. Associate individual elements into groups. Interactively edit gradient fills on the canvas. Perform a range of Boolean operations on paths, including Unite, Intersect, Exclude and Subtract Front.
Colors to match your imagination.
Picking the perfect color is easy with the freedom of the expressive color wheel. Or modify colors using RGB and HSB sliders. Enter the hexadecimal value to precisely match existing artwork colors. Sample colors using the dropper. Store and recall colors from the swatch library.
Import, export and sharing.
Import drawings from desktop vector applications as SVG and include photos directly from your camera roll, or import PNG and JPEG images from cloud services. Export your drawings for sharing or importing into other apps as SVG, PDF, PNG and JPEG to all cloud storage services. Send drawings as photos directly to your camera roll.
Light & dark modes.
Light and dark mode system appearances with the option to override the system setting to light or dark mode for Inkpad.
Apple Pencil.
If you’ve got an iPad Pro or the 2018 iPad, Inkpad works great with the Apple Pencil.
Praise for Inkpad.
Some of the kind feedback received in emails and App Store reviews:
“Works perfect on latest iPad Pro, Apple Pencil.”
“It’s really beautiful to use with an iPad Pro.”
“Inkpad is one of the killer apps for the iPad.”
“Inkpad is my favorite graphics app on any platform. Inkpad is just the right balance of enough power without being too complicated.”
“If you’ve worked with Illustrator or Inkscape, this is the vector drawing app to download for your iPad. Especially nice with the iPad Pro with Apple Pencil.”
“I love this vector drawing app for its easy-to-use interface and pared-down tool bar. It covers the essentials perfectly and the developers are very responsive to questions.”
“Inkpad is my main vector design tool for mobile. This is the app that Adobe Draw should be.”
“Thank you guys, I use this app all the time.”
“If you used to work with Inkpad in the past you should get this app to continue working with it.”
Acknowledgements.
Thank you to Martin Coffey, Rita Flores, Yve Müller, Armin Popp, David Rivera, Nicolas Saez, Erick Villagomez, Felipe Villela and Jason Wray for contributing artwork to the ‘Designed with Inkpad’ app preview video and screenshots. Please visit our website to see more of their artwork and for links to their portfolios.
History.
Inkpad was originally created by Steve Sprang in 2011, but it disappeared from the App Store in 2015. I took over development because my wife Lindsay uses Inkpad and I wanted to ensure the continued development and support of a product we and others enjoy so much.
Terms and Conditions: http://inkpad.art/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: http://inkpad.art/privacy/

bluejetty:00128116:ios.description:
STAR WARS™ PINBALL
- Star Wars™ Pinball arrives to Apple Arcade with thrilling tables: Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back, Boba Fett, The Force Awakens and The Clone Wars
- Experience the excitement of Star Wars in pinball form with original music and characters from a galaxy far, far away
Zen Pinball Party delivers the ultimate pinball experience with carefully crafted tables that are inspired by some of the biggest brands from DreamWorks Animation and Hasbro, as well as popular pinball classic themes. Players will challenge their friends and family for the highest score on fun and unique tables featuring DreamWork Animation’s Trolls, Kung Fu Panda, How to Train Your Dragon, Hasbro's My Little Pony, Williams' Theatre of Magic, Attack from Mars, and much more. Players can also jump into the competition with real-time online matches that pit their pinball skills against opponents all around the world. 
DREAMWORKS ANIMATION, HASBRO & PINBALL CLASSICS
- Earn jackpots on tables inspired by hot brands from DreamWorks Animation’s Trolls, Kung Fu Panda, How to Train Your Dragon, and Hasbro's My Little Pony
- Dive into the golden age of pinball with classic real-life Bally/Williams tables: Theatre of Magic, Medieval Madness, and Attack from Mars
- Explore unique settings with Wild West Rampage, CastleStorm, and Adventure Land
- More on the way! 
THE CLASSIC GAME OF PINBALL, ENHANCED
- Enjoy the best physics simulation in digital pinball, and onward to the biggest score
- Compete with friends and family by taking turns in Hotseat mode, or take on the world in Tournaments
- Earn rewards in limited-time events and customize the experience
PLAY RIVALS AND FRIENDS IN FUNKO PINBALL PARTY ARENA MODE
- Be the last one standing as players battle in 4-player online pinball matches
- Score the highest while players mess with their opponents
- Attack with bombs and unleash asteroids, UFOs, and...chickens?!
It’s a Zen Pinball Party -- and everyone’s invited!
Full list of tables:
- Star Wars™ Pinball: Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back
- Star Wars™ Pinball: The Clone Wars
- Black Rose
- The Champion Pub
- Biolab
- Garfield Pinball
- Funko Pinball Party Arena
- Peanuts' Snoopy Pinball
- DreamWorks Animation’s Trolls Pinball
- DreamWorks Animation’s Kung Fu Panda Pinball
- DreamWorks Animation’s How to Train Your Dragon Pinball
- MY LITTLE PONY Pinball
- Theatre of Magic
- Attack from Mars
- Medieval Madness
- The Getaway: High Speed II
- Wild West Rampage
- CastleStorm
- Adventure Land
- Son of Zeus
- More to come

Will you be able to avoid the traps you meet on the way? The furt
bluejetty:00022313:ios.description:
Whether you're big or small, at home or on the road, Long Neck Run is the perfect obstacle racing game to have fun and show your reflexes. Reach peaks in just a few minutes.
Will you be able to avoid the traps you meet on the way? The further you go, the taller you get, and the harder the levels become. It's up to you to be as nimble as possible to discover the secrets we have in store for you.
Playing is easy, just control your character with your finger. Get as many rings as you can from your colors to make your neck grow, reach more bonuses and unlock many wonders. But beware! Each ring of the wrong color will make you lose part of your neck and you might not make it through the pitfalls like the zip lines or the swimming pools. Keep your head up. 
As you play, win keys and gemstones in order to open and unlock new skins. Become a rabbit, a ninja, or a king by spending your gems in the shop. Remember, the longer your neck, the higher the winnings. Our skins can't be bought with money and can only be obtained by playing.
Our game only exists thanks to advertisements. Ads will be present throughout the game, and some will allow you to increase your rewards! However, you can support us by buying our paid version (without advertisements) directly from the game. That comes with a lot of gems to unlock more content.

bluejetty:00015895:ios.name: Muscle & Motion: Yoga
bluejetty:00015895:ios.summary:
Understand every yoga pose from the inside out
The Yoga app by Muscle & Motion turns your device into a powerful 3D learning platform for yoga anatomy, posture alignment, joint mechanics, and safe movement. Explore asanas in stunning detai
bluejetty:00015895:ios.description:
Understand every yoga pose from the inside out
The Yoga app by Muscle & Motion turns your device into a powerful 3D learning platform for yoga anatomy, posture alignment, joint mechanics, and safe movement. Explore asanas in stunning detail, see the muscles activated in each pose, and deepen your understanding of how to teach and practice yoga safely and effectively.
Whether you’re a yoga teacher, movement educator, physical therapist, student, or dedicated practitioner, this app helps you visualize alignment and anatomy in a way traditional images and textbooks cannot.
Why teachers, practitioners & movement professionals love it
- Makes complex yoga anatomy easy to understand through clear, accurate 3D animations
- Shows exactly how muscles, joints, and connective tissues behave in each pose
- Helps explain alignment and modification concepts to students far better than static images
- Improves teaching and personal practice by revealing compensation patterns, muscle imbalances, and safe adjustments
Key Features
• 3D Yoga Pose Breakdown Library
Explore essential yoga poses with full 3D anatomical animations showing which muscles are active, what’s stretching, and how joints align.
• Alignment, Modifications & Common Mistakes
Learn the safest way to guide a pose. See common alignment errors, understand why they occur, and discover visual cues and modifications to help students practice safely.
• Functional Yoga Anatomy
Understand how posture, stability, mobility, and muscular balance contribute to each asana. Visualize the interplay between muscle groups during forward folds, backbends, twists, balances, and inversions.
• Strength-Building Exercises
Access corrective exercises and pose-specific preparation drills to help students build the strength, mobility, and awareness needed to progress safely.
Who is this app for?
The Yoga app is built for anyone who wants to deepen their understanding of yoga and movement, including:
- Yoga teachers & teacher trainees
- Movement educators & Pilates instructors
- Physical therapists, chiropractors & rehab specialists
- Anatomy, kinesiology & movement-science students
- Yoga practitioners of all levels
- University and college instructors
- Anyone who wants to understand yoga through the lens of anatomy
Use it to teach, study, prepare classes, learn alignment concepts, support injury prevention, or enrich your personal practice.
Free Access & Subscriptions
You can download the app and explore content for free, including sample asanas and 3D anatomy views.
To access the full library of yoga poses, 3D animations, functional anatomy lessons, and alignment videos, you can upgrade with an in-app subscription:
- Subscriptions give you full access to all videos, 3D models, pose breakdowns, and educational content for the duration of your plan.
- Subscriptions auto-renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple ID account settings.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions on your device.
For full details:
Privacy Policy: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/terms-of-use/
Support
Have a question, feature request or need help with your subscription?
Our team is happy to help at info@muscleandmotion.com.

Inoltre, le dirette dei canali Rai e il servizio di Guida Tv/Replay.
Dalla sezione CATALOGO potrai scoprire tutta l’offerta disponibile per tipologie, generi e sottogeneri, scoprire le novità e i contenuti da non perdere.
Dalla sezione DIRETTE avrai accesso al live streaming di tutti i canali Rai (Rai 1, Rai 2, Rai 3, Rai 4, Rai 5, Rai Movie, Rai Premium, Rai Gulp, Rai Yoyo, Rai Storia, Rai News24, Rai Sport, Rai Scuola e Rai Radio2), ai contenuti esclusivi in live streaming sui canali RaiPlay e al servizio di Guida Tv/Replay per rivedere on demand i programmi andati in onda negli ultimi 7 giorni e scoprire cosa offre la programmazione futura delle reti Rai.
Dalla sezione ALTRO potrai effettuare l’accesso/registrazione nonché associare un dispositivo tv e accedere alle funzionalità avanzate di personalizzazione disponibili per l’utente registrato come il servizio Continua a guardare o Le mie liste (Salvati, Download, Valutati, Ultimi visti in app per fruizione in assenza di connessione).
Le dirette dei canali in streaming sono fruibili senza registrazione; creare un account gratuito Rai ed effettuare l’accesso alla piattaforma (login) è invece necessario per accedere ai contenuti on demand integrali e per utilizzare i servizi di personalizzazione disponibili per l’utente registrato. 
La registrazione a RaiPlay – disponibile su app mobile e web - è gratuita, sicura e Rai proteggerà i tuoi dati senza cederli a nessuno.
RaiPlay è anche su Apple Tv. Dopo aver installato l’app RaiPlay sulla tua Apple tv, per effettuare l’accesso hai ben tre opzioni: effettuare l’associazione del dispositivo tv inquadrando il QR code apparso sullo schermo tv con l’iPhone o l’iPad in cui già utilizzi l’app RaiPlay oppure effettuare l’associazione immettendo il codice numerico apparso sullo schermo nella sezione “Associa TV” di RaiPlay (raggiungibile su app mobile dalla sezione Altro> Impostazioni > Smart tv e su RaiPlay browsing dal menu Supporto > Associa TV); puoi anche optare per il processo standard di accesso e dunque inserire su tv le credenziali (email e password) del tuo account Rai.
La funzionalità è disponibile in modalità multiutente, per un utilizzo in famiglia e con gli amici.
Dall’estero, potrai accedere solo a una parte dei contenuti disponibili su RaiPlay: la diretta del canale Rai News24 e il catalogo on demand delle opere per le quali Rai detiene il correlato diritto di distribuzione via IP.
CONTATTACI 
Per avere informazioni e ricevere assistenza, visita la pagina rai.it/centroassistenza
Privacy policy: https://www.rai.it/privacy 
Sulla base di quanto previsto dalla legge 9 gennaio 2004, n.4 abbiamo pubblicato la dichiarazione di accessibilità dell’App RaiPlay alla seguente pagina web: https://www.rai.it/corporate/disclaimer/dichiarazione-di-accessibilita

bluejetty:00024328:ios.summary:
Sketch your idea!
You can write freely and quickly because it is handwritten.
You can concentrate on writing because it is the minimum function that can write only white lines on the blue canvas.
Functions List:
- Can be used as a noteboo
bluejetty:00024328:ios.description:
Sketch your idea!
You can write freely and quickly because it is handwritten.
You can concentrate on writing because it is the minimum function that can write only white lines on the blue canvas.
Functions List:
- Can be used as a notebook or notepad
- Pen tool: draw a line
- Straight line tool
- Rectangle and Ellipse Tools
- Switch between solid/dotted lines
- Can change the size of the pen
- Undo / Redo
- Can change the page size
- Can scale the page
- Image sharing: Share an image as PNG, JPG, or PDF format. Also, you can share monochrome converted images.
- List documents
- List recently opened documents
- Organize: Document folders
- Sort documents and folders
- Title documents and folders
- Delete the document then put it into the trash box.
- Restore the deleted document from the trash box.
- Delete the document entirely in the trash box.
- Copy documents: You can duplicate the document. Tap the copy button at the bottom right of the note screen to duplicate it.
- Read-only mode: While in read-only mode, you can disable writing and prevent erroneous operations. You can change the settings by tapping the title on the note screen.
- Option to use only Apple Pencil: Only available for iPad compatible with Apple Pencil.
- Double-tap the Apple Pencil to switch between tools in sequence.
- Apple Pencil Pro is also supported.
- Can turn off/on the function the app puts the device into a sleep state if you don't touch the screen for a certain period while the page is displayed.
About In-App Purchase:
The first 20 pages can be used free of charge. After that, adding pages will be paid content.
Please support the developer.

Want to learn Spanish by reading or improve another language through graded readers? Choose a book, read or listen for 10-15 minutes, tap unfamiliar words for instant translations, and learn vocabulary naturally in context.
Learn the language you want, whether it’s Spanish, English, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Dutch, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Turkish, Greek, Czech, or Polish. Spanish is available in both European and Latin American variants.
Join a growing community of 15,000+ learners who use Eppika to make reading part of their language-learning routine. With a 4.8 App Store rating based on 700+ ratings, Eppika offers an engaging alternative to repetitive exercises, helping learners stay motivated through stories, native audio, instant translations, and level-adapted books.
Graded readers for language learners
Eppika offers graded readers based on familiar books, classics, stories, and practical nonfiction. Every text is adapted for levels A1–B2, with vocabulary and grammar matched to the right difficulty.
Beginners can start reading without feeling lost, while more experienced learners can progress to richer, more complex texts. Each book is challenging enough to help you improve but clear enough to enjoy.
Audiobooks for language learning
Use Eppika to read and listen in Spanish, English, French, German, or another available language. Native audio helps improve listening comprehension and pronunciation while developing a better sense of the language’s natural rhythm.
Switch to Audiobook Mode when you want to learn during a walk, commute, workout, or before bed.
Instant word translation
Tap any unfamiliar word for an instant translation without leaving the story. Understand new vocabulary exactly when you need it and keep reading without switching to an external dictionary or translating every sentence.
Vocabulary in context
Build vocabulary in context by learning words and phrases inside memorable stories. Seeing how words are used makes their meaning easier to understand and remember.
Vocabulary tracking helps you follow your progress without relying on isolated flashcards or endless vocabulary lists.
Adapted books and stories by level
Explore 120+ adapted books and stories in more than 1,800 level-based versions. Start with familiar global titles, then discover classics, literature, practical nonfiction, biography, psychology, productivity, and more.
Make reading a daily language habit
Eppika fits into short breaks and busy schedules. A focused 10-15-minute session can combine reading, listening, translation, and meaningful progress without points, streaks, or cartoon-style gamification.
Who is Eppika for?
• Beginners looking for graded readers that do not feel overwhelming
• Intermediate learners who want to improve fluency and overcome a plateau
• Upper-intermediate learners who want to strengthen comprehension and expand vocabulary
• Busy professionals and travelers looking for meaningful daily practice
• Book lovers who prefer learning languages through stories instead of traditional lessons
How it works
1. Choose the language you want to learn.
2. Select a graded book or story.
3. Set your reading level from A1 to B2.
4. Read or listen, translate unfamiliar words, and build vocabulary in context.
Whether you are learning for travel, work, study, culture, or the joy of reading, Eppika helps you turn books into daily language practice.
Download Eppika and start learning languages through stories today.

There are criminals behind the ghosts. Ms. Holmes is ready to prove it!
Solve puzzles and riddles in this mysterious game! Find the hidden objects!
_________________________________________________________________________
Can you uncover the mysteries of Ms. Holmes: The Adventure of the McKirk Ritual? Immerse yourself in the thrilling hidden object puzzles, explore mystic locations and solve the mystery of ghost appearance in Mrs. Lewis’s mansion! Immerse into the unforgettable world of Ms. Holmes!
A noble lady comes to Ms Holmes with a request to investigate the strange mystical events that took place in her mansion. The strangest thing about this story is that no one but Mrs. Lewis herself sees or hears the ghost. Ms Holmes has to find out what secrets this place hides.
THE GHOST OF A BRIDE HAS APPEARED IN THE MANSION
Determine who is behind the mystic events at Mrs. Lewis mansion and how the ghost of the bride is associated with the owner of the house.
LEARN WHAT ONE CAN DO FOR LOVE
Uncover the truth by solving engaging puzzles and mysterious mini-games.
FIND OUT WHAT THE SERVANTS’ DEVOTION CAN DESTROY
Complete hidden object scenes and enjoy spectacular fantasy locations.
SOLVE THE PUZZLES OF THE BOARDING HOUSE YOU’VE ALREADY VISITED
Discover what the owner of the boarding house hides and enjoy the bonuses of the Collector's Edition! 
Ms. Holmes: The Adventure of the McKirk Ritual is a hidden objects game where you need to seek and find missing objects like Sherlock. Learn all the secrets Mrs. Lewis' mansion and solve the unsolved mysteries and puzzles.
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help find the hidden objects, and use clues if you get stuck.

bluejetty:00133669:ios.name: Woopi Connect
bluejetty:00133669:ios.summary:
Woopi Connect, an On Demand public transport service that is convenient, reliable & affordable. 
Servicing the areas of Woolgoolga, Safety Beach, Mullaway, Arrawarra and Corindi, Woopi Connect provides a new experience for customers who
bluejetty:00133669:ios.description:
Woopi Connect, an On Demand public transport service that is convenient, reliable & affordable. 
Servicing the areas of Woolgoolga, Safety Beach, Mullaway, Arrawarra and Corindi, Woopi Connect provides a new experience for customers who can book transport from or near their home to a local transport hub or other local locations at a time that suits them.
1. Book your ride using the Woopi Connect app
2. A vehicle will pick you up from a convenient and safe location nearby.
3. You will be taken to your nominated destination.
How long will I wait? 
You can choose from a few different times, but we’ll always aim to pick you up within 20 minutes. You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick up time before booking and track your vehicle.
How many other people are on the bus?
Our mini buses carry up to 7 people. Just like on other forms of public transport, the number of passengers you will share your journey with will vary. Sometimes this may be as few as 1 or 2, other times the vehicle may be full.
Why should I use the service?
Our technology matches people heading in the same direction, giving you the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
You’re also bringing down our carbon footprint by sharing a ride, reducing the number of vehicles on the road. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make our local area a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Love our app? Please rate us!

Awake on the first beep!
Completely active mind after that little brain game.
End falling back asleep!
Extremely loud and annoying ringtones to wake you up for sure.
Memory game to get you fully awake.
Tons of free features!
***ABOUT MEMORY ALARM CLOCK***
Memory Alarm Clock is specifically designed to get you up and running in no time - even if you usually can't get out of bed in the morning. The ringtones are designed to get you out of even the deepest sleep. The memory game after waking up stimulates your higher brain functions - making it almost impossible to fall back asleep.
***ALARM***
- Memory game to stop the alarm
- Multiple alarms
- Repeating alarms
- Ringtones designed to wake you up
- Impossible to mute (preset volume)
- Randomizable ringtone playlists
- Wake up to your music
- Mix in ringtones to your music
- Wake up to the alarm talking
- Optional: Super short snooze
***FEATURES***
- Bedside Clock (Highly customizable)
- Bedtime Reminder
- Bedtime Enforcerer
- Morning Routine
- Battery Saving Mode
***CUSTOMIZE***
- Dark Mode
- Dark Theme (optional)
- Always bright alarms (optional)
- Color Themes
- Alternative App Icon colors
***BEDSIDE CLOCK***
- Fullscreen clock
- Highly customizable
- Analog clocks
- Digital clocks
- Hourglass clock
- Landscape and portrait
- Clock wallpaper
- Your photos as clock wallpaper
- Color customizable
- Complications
***LET YOUR SPOUSE SLEEP***
Do you like to get up early in the morning but your spouse doesn't?
Now you can use the "Don't Wake my Spouse Button"! It's a super short time snooze (optional). Your spouse will thank you later.
***GET THE SLEEP YOU DESERVE***
Would you love to get the sleep you deserve but still fall back into bad habits at night that keep you awake?
Sometimes all it needs is a little reminder at the right time: Try the "Bedtime Reminder" packaged with this App (optional).
Still doesn't do the trick? Than it's time to introduce the "Bedtime Enforcerer" (optional). It won't shut up until you eventually are in bed.
***START YOUR DAY YOUR WAY***
Do you like the idea of morning routines? Create and track your individual morning routine inside the App. Improve your morning routine's consistency and reduce willpower depletion early in the morning. Experience the magic of a consistent morning routine!
***END OVERSLEEPING***
Imagine how your life would change for the better if instead of oversleeping and feeling regret and frustration the rest of the day, YOU were in control? Think of how much more you could get done, and even how healthier your body and mind would be! With Memory Alarm Clock, you won’t just change how you wake up... you’ll change your life!

bluejetty:00029818:ios.description:
Welcome to the iTOUCH Wearables App 
Your world. Your wellness. Your way. 
The iTOUCH Wearables App brings together your favorite iTOUCH smartwatches, fitness trackers, and AURA Smart Glasses in one seamless experience designed to help you stay connected, active, and inspired every day. 
Whether you're tracking your fitness goals, staying on top of notifications, capturing life's moments, or exploring the power of Aura AI, the iTOUCH Wearables App keeps everything you need right at your fingertips. 
Stay Active & Feel Your Best 
Take control of your health and wellness with easy-to-use tools designed to help you move more, sleep better, and stay motivated. 
Track your daily steps, calories burned, distance traveled, heart rate, sleep patterns, and more. Set personalized goals, monitor your progress, and celebrate your achievements every step of the way. 
Friendly reminders help you stay hydrated, stretch, and keep moving throughout the day. 
Stay Connected Wherever Life Takes You 
Never miss what matters most. 
Receive calls, text messages, emails, calendar reminders, and app notifications directly on your connected device. Customize which alerts you want to see and enjoy the convenience of staying informed without constantly checking your phone. 
Express Your Style 
Personalize your smartwatch with a growing library of watch faces designed to match your mood, lifestyle, and personality. 
From sleek and professional to bold and colorful, there's a look for every moment. 
Introducing AURA Smart Glasses 
Experience a new way to stay connected with iTOUCH AURA Smart Glasses. 
Listen to music, take calls, capture photos and videos, record voice notes, and manage your content directly through the iTOUCH Wearables App. 
Transfer media wirelessly, customize device settings, and keep your glasses up to date with the latest features and improvements. 
Meet Aura AI 
Aura is your intelligent companion designed to help you stay informed, organized, and productive throughout your day. 
Ask questions, discover new information, organize voice notes, summarize meetings, recognize objects around you, and explore AI-powered experiences designed to help simplify everyday life. 
We're just getting started. New AI features and experiences will continue to roll out through future updates. 
Coming Soon 
Real-Time Translation 
Two-Way Conversation Translation 
Expanded Language Support 
Enhanced Productivity Tools 
More AI-Powered Experiences 
One App. Multiple Devices. 
The iTOUCH Wearables App supports compatible iTOUCH smartwatches, fitness trackers, and AURA Smart Glasses. 
Connect one compatible smartwatch or fitness tracker and one pair of AURA Smart Glasses simultaneously under the same account and enjoy a connected wearable experience. 
Always Getting Better 
We're continuously improving the iTOUCH Wearables experience through regular app updates, firmware enhancements, new features, and performance improvements. 
With Over-The-Air (OTA) updates, your devices can receive the latest innovations without missing a beat. 
Privacy & Security 
Your privacy matters. 
The iTOUCH Wearables App is designed with security in mind and uses secure systems to help protect your account information and connected device data. 
Some features may require Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Camera, Microphone, Notifications, Photos, Media, or Location permissions to function properly. 
Download Today 
Whether you're focused on fitness, productivity, staying connected, or exploring the latest AI-powered technology, the iTOUCH Wearables App is designed to help you get more out of every day. 
Download the iTOUCH Wearables App and discover a smarter way to connect, track, create, and explore. 
Keywords 
iTOUCH, Smartwatch, Fitness Tracker, Smart Glasses, AI, Wearables, Health, Wellness, Activity Tracking, Heart Rate, Sleep Tracking, Notifications, Voice Assistant, Audio Glasses, Camera, Productivity, Translation, Connected Devices

bluejetty:00096607:ios.summary:

Aqua is a creative app for kids 5–12 (and their parents) that turns drawing, painting, and designing into hands-on learning. Bring your ideas to life, desi
bluejetty:00096607:ios.description:
Imagination starts here! Made with love by parents at Adobe for our kids and yours.
Aqua is a creative app for kids 5–12 (and their parents) that turns drawing, painting, and designing into hands-on learning. Bring your ideas to life, design in 3D, and celebrate every creation in your own digital museum.
BUILD CREATIVE SKILLS THROUGH PLAY
- Coloring: Explore thousands of kid-friendly coloring pages
- Art Games: Pass drawings back and forth to co-create with friends and family
- Tracing: Take a photo or choose from classic artworks to trace and make your own
- Fashion and Design: Sketch outfits, mix patterns, see your collection come to life
- Drawing Lessons: Follow step-by-step tutorials from real children’s book illustrators
- 3D and AR: Transform flat sketches into 3D creations and see them in your room
- Comics: Create characters, build comic scenes, design graphic novels
- Art Museum: Save paper and digital art in a gallery that can be shared with loved ones
EDUCATIONAL BENEFITS
- Teaches artistic fundamentals: color theory, composition, art history, design thinking
- Encourages focus, persistence, and problem-solving
- Grows with your child: younger kids start with coloring, older kids unlock advanced tools
WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE AQUA
- Made by Adobe parents with safety and responsibility in mind
- No distracting in-app ads or upsells
- Magic effects and 3D powered by Adobe’s Firefly AI
- Inclusive by design: accessibility features support kids with diverse needs
- Works offline: perfect for road trips, cafés, and classrooms
- From Adobe — creators of Photoshop and Illustrator
Terms & Conditions
Your use of this application is governed by the Adobe General Terms of Use https://www.adobe.com/go/terms_linkfree_en and the Adobe Privacy Policy https://www.adobe.com/go/privacy_policy_linkfree_en.
For information about how Adobe collects, uses, and protects children’s personal information, please see the Project Aqua Children’s Privacy Notice at https://www.adobe.com/go/project-aqua-notice-linkfree.
Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information: https://www.adobe.com/go/ca-rights-linkfree

bluejetty:00184136:ios.summary:
Our automatic savings app helps you save money, build emergency savings, and reach your savings goals. Whether you’re saving or borrowing, our finance app is here to help you stay in control. Never money alone™.
PUT YOUR SAVINGS ON AUTOPIL
bluejetty:00184136:ios.description:
Our automatic savings app helps you save money, build emergency savings, and reach your savings goals. Whether you’re saving or borrowing, our finance app is here to help you stay in control. Never money alone™.
PUT YOUR SAVINGS ON AUTOPILOT
Reach your savings goals big or small with a money saving app built to save automatically. Set & Save™ learns your income and spending patterns to find the right moments to automatically set aside money toward your goals. Little by little it adds up faster than you think. Our members save over $1,800 per year on average.*
> Achieve your goals
Turn your plans into real savings with our goal savings app. We’ve helped people save over $13 billion using Set & Save for over 15 million goals, from building an emergency fund to a well-earned vacation and even a first home. We save based on what you can afford, helping you make steady progress without you needing to think about it. We look at when your bills are due, when you get paid, and your goals to personalize your savings.
> Stay in control
Set limits and guidelines on how we save. Pause saves with the push of a button. Transfer your money back to your bank. Move money from one goal to another. It’s your money and you’re the boss.
> Track your spending
See your recent spending and bills and create savings goals for ongoing bills in just a few taps. Your built-in savings tracker helps you see progress, adjust goals, and move money when plans change. Get better about your money with the Oportun savings app.
> Set, save, repeat
Set Smart Bills goals that save, withdraw, and repeat—all automatically! Use it as a sinking funds app to save for bills and other recurring expenses without the stress.
> Safe and secure
Your money is protected every step of the way. Savings held through Oportun are FDIC-insured** up to $250,000 through our partner banks. We use multi-factor authentication, and trusted technology partners to keep your information safe.
> It’s easy to start:
1. Get set up in minutes: Link your bank account to our savings app and set your goals
2. We find smart times to save for you
3. Save automatically: We’ll move money into the savings app toward your goals. Withdraw anytime
> Get a 30 day free trial
See how much you can save with a 30 day trial of our money saving app. Then it’s just $5.99/mo or $3.99/mo with a yearly plan. Cancel anytime.
LOAN MEMBERS, WE’RE HERE FOR YOU
Are you an Oportun member with a personal loan? It’s easier to manage it in the app.
Check your balance, make payments, set up autopay, and refer friends all in one place. The Oportun app is free for members to use for the purpose of monitoring and paying their loan.
Looking to apply for a loan? Please visit Oportun.com or call (866) 488-6090 for money borrowing.
MORE ABOUT US
- Oportun is certified by the US Treasury Department as a CDFI
- Oportun has an A+ rating by the Better Business Bureau (BBB)
- Awarded by USA Today as one of America’s Best Customer Service in Financial Services of 2026
- Formerly known as Digit, our finance app helps you save, budget, and manage your loan.
- - - - - - -
Personal loans in NM and WI originated by Oportun, Inc. In other operating states loans through Oportun are originated by one or both of Pathward®, N.A and Column N.A. Member FDIC.
Standard data charges may apply when downloading the app.
*Based on average saves of all paying app members in the prior 12 months. Not a guarantee; results will vary based on your income and spending.
**Oportun is not a bank. Your savings funds are FDIC insured, subject to applicable limitations and restrictions. Go to oportun.com/savings-banks to learn more about FDIC coverage.

bluejetty:00064160:ios.description:
A funny 2D infinite runner is coming, meet ‘Steve’, your new friend that lives in your notification center. A special dinosaur in a desert world, jump with the perfect timing for your freedom and avoid all cactus obstacles. Unlock new scenarios and characters for play in this endless running game. How far can you run and jump in this ARCADE GAME?
Feel like a true runner in this awesome endless jumping game! With a simple click on the screen you will dodge all obstacles in the way. Download this special adventure now on your smartphone or tablet completely FREE!
Play with ‘Steve’ anytime, anywhere, by just dragging down from the top on your screen to reveal the notification center and your new dino-friend will be there waiting for you! Thanks to an intuitive and easy touch control anyone will enjoy with our unique characters in this AMAZING WIDGET! Jump and jump with only ONE FINGER. Our challenging environments have been designed like the old school arcade games, do you accept the CHALLENGE?
‘Steve’ is thinking for real runner games lovers. There are a multitude of skins and scenarios waiting for you, are you ready? Compare your mark with your friends and see who is the BEST PLAYER in the online ranking! You have never seen before such a jumper game like this! START THIS CRAZY ADVENTURE!
“Steve offers a mindless time-waster of a game requiring little commitment on the user’s part. You don’t even have to launch an app.” - TechChrunch
“When I am watching a video I can play this while it buffers,” - Recode
-GAME FEATURES-
AMAZING RUNNING WIDGET
Welcome to the new action game at top speed, are you addicted to JUMP and DODGE? You will need a real OLD SCHOOL reflexes to overcome the challenge! 
Enjoy with this wild race, the best run and jump game!
PLAY VERY EASY
Simple and intuitive control system, all the jumps with ONE FINGER!
Dragging down from the top on your screen to reveal the notification center and PLAY! Can you dodge all OBSTACLES?
CLICK ON THE SCREEN and fly over the blocks while collect coins in the air in this ENDLESS RUNNER!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLAYER
You will find a lot of available skins to customize your character. What do you prefer? A WILD LION, a SLOW ZOMBIE, a SWEET DONUT, an ADORABLE PANDA, a FAST ANIME CHARACTER, a DANGEROUS DRAGON or a INFINITE NYAN CAT? Can you collect all of them ?
Each one of them have SPECIAL MOVEMENTS that you will have to discover while play this running simulator. NON STOP ACTION in this never ending jumping game!
COMPETE WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Synchronize with your Facebook and challenge all your friends and reach the top of the ranking. Enter in the competitive mode and run past your high scores in the game and become the TOP RUNNER! Show them who is THE BEST in this INFINITE RUNNING GAME! 
Very EASY to play and totally FREE, with its simple and intuitive interface, run and dodge with only one finger! You'll love this challenge running action game at full speed!
Do you like the PIXEL ART? Check out this gameplay video. There are thousands of surprises in this endless jumper game:
https://youtu.be/N86LVPrRDDI
Start this entertainment jumping game, you won't stop running, dodging and clicked! Free download ‘Steve - The Jumping Dinosaur Widget Arcade Game’ and start this wild race NOW! GET ALL CHARACTERS!
VISIT US: 
https://www.facebook.com/SteveWidgetGame
PLEASE NOTE: 'Steve - The Jumping Dinosaur Widget Arcade Game' is a completely free game. However, you can also purchase some items within the game for real money. Just disable in-app purchases on your device if you don’t want to use this feature in the game.
'Steve - The Jumping Dinosaur Widget Arcade Game' was developed as a tribute to Chrome easter egg game without intention of plagiarism or attribution of authorship. Images created by great artist Sebastien Gabriel.
Legal

bluejetty:00014745:ios.summary: Com o aplicativo Pluxee Brasil você tem acesso fácil às informações dos seus cartões de benefícios de alimentação, refeição e outros. Você tem acesso ao saldo e extrato de seus cartões de benefícios, rede de estabelecimentos e promoções exc
bluejetty:00014745:ios.description:
Com o aplicativo Pluxee Brasil você tem acesso fácil às informações dos seus cartões de benefícios de alimentação, refeição e outros. Você tem acesso ao saldo e extrato de seus cartões de benefícios, rede de estabelecimentos e promoções exclusivas.
Aqui, você também pode recuperar ou trocar as senhas de seu cartão, bloquear em caso de perda ou roubo ou fazer o desbloqueio de novos cartões. É mais agilidade para você aproveitar a vida com o que realmente importa!
Se você possui mais de um cartão, você conseguirá ter acesso ao saldo de todos inserindo apenas a informação de um deles!
Veja como é simples usar o app Pluxee Brasil:
1. Preencha apenas uma vez o cadastro. É rapidinho! Será para ajudar a preservar a segurança das suas informações.
2. Valide um de seus cartões de benefícios - esse processo também precisará ser realizado apenas uma vez.

bluejetty:00137145:ios.description:
Step into the enthralling episodes of "Perfect Life," a visual novel teeming with romance and the power of choice — each decision you make weaves directly into the tapestry of this intricate love story.
Matt is the lead designer at the company where Olivia works. Matt always tries to keep a cool head so his attention will be drawn to an intellectually developed person who can converse with him on equal terms.
Eilif is a guardian of the boundary of worlds, living for over 1000 years. He has had many challenges, but this helped him learn to treat people with compassion. If you have developed empathy, Eilif will open up and perhaps tell you his secret...
Leo is a courageous warrior with a hot temperament. With him, you won't be afraid to go through all the adventures that lie ahead. Develop your impulsiveness to win the favor of this emotional young man.
Victoria is a seductive, mysterious girl who can charm you with her sharp humor. At the same time, Victoria is romantic and can give you many unforgettable memories. If you like to enjoy all the shades of human feelings, Victoria will be able to show you what your sensuality is capable of.
As you navigate this visual novel, your choices will unlock new episodes filled with romance and discovery. Will you follow the path of sensuality or empathy? Will your impulsiveness lead to romance or heartache? The choices in this visual novel shape your unique love story, punctuated by poignant episodes that resonate with your decisions.
In this visual novel, every choice leads to a new episode, a new twist in your love story. From romantic encounters to heartfelt conversations, your decisions will foster or foil connections with Matt, Eilif, Leo, and Victoria. Each episode is a step closer to the climax of your personalized romance tale.
"Perfect Life" offers episodes of choices and consequences, where every interaction is a thread in the fabric of your love story. This visual novel challenges you to choose wisely, as each episode carries the potential to alter the course of Olivia's destiny. Your love story awaits; what choices will you make?

bluejetty:00175209:ios.description:
Be part of the movement! Alight Motion is the first professional motion design app for your smartphone for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, bringing you professional-quality animation, motion graphics, visual effects, video editing, video compositing, and more!
• Multiple layers of graphics, video, and audio
• Vector and bitmap support (edit vector graphics right on your phone!)

• Bookmarks for ease of editing

Alight Motion is free to use with basic features and a watermark on videos you create. After purchasing, subscriptions can be managed in your Apple ID settings. You can find more information about subscriptions at https://alightcreative.com/support

bluejetty:00161887:ios.name: Glooko - Track Diabetes Data
bluejetty:00161887:ios.summary: Glooko is a comprehensive diabetes management platform that helps people with diabetes quickly and easily understand and control their blood glucose levels and well-being. People with diabetes looking to take the next step with their diabet
bluejetty:00161887:ios.description:
Glooko is a comprehensive diabetes management platform that helps people with diabetes quickly and easily understand and control their blood glucose levels and well-being. People with diabetes looking to take the next step with their diabetes management can track their blood glucose, insulin, weight, exercise, food, and medications in one place to make more informed decisions around their health. Designed to enhance the relationship between people with diabetes and their healthcare providers, the free and secure Glooko Mobile App helps users stay connected and collaborate remotely with their care teams between visits, identify trends, share reports, and keep their diabetes and related health data in a single app. 
The clinically proven Glooko platform syncs data from more than 200 diabetes and health monitoring devices, including blood glucose meters (BGM), insulin pump, continuous glucose monitors (CGM), smart scales, fitness apps, and activity trackers. Health data can be synced from compatible connected devices and third party diabetes and health monitoring apps, or manually inputted. For a complete list of compatible devices and apps, visit www.glooko.com/compatibility.
POPULAR FEATURES:
• Automatically share health data with care teams through unique ProConnect codes.
• View glucose trends in multiple ways, using the same easy-to-understand reports and charts as care teams.
• Use a digital logbook to automatically track activities and events in one place.
• Sync data from BGMs, insulin pumps and pens, and CGMs.
• Integrate data from popular activity trackers, including Apple Health, Fitbit, and Strava.
• Add food and nutrition intake using the built-in barcode scanner, search functionality, or voice activated database. 
Glooko does not measure, interpret,or make decisions on the data it conveys nor is it intended to provide automated treatment decisions or be used as a substitute for professional judgment. All medical diagnosis and treatment are to be performed under the supervision and oversight of an appropriate healthcare provider. Not all product features are available in all countries. 
If you have concerns with your current diabetes diagnosis and treatment, please contact your healthcare provider.

bluejetty:00122256:ios.description:
UNO!™ is now mobile! Take the classic card game from the kitchen table anywhere! Now with new rules, world series tournaments, modes of play, and much more. Whether you’re at home, on the go, an UNO!™ veteran or completely new, UNO!™ has something for everyone in the family. UNO!™ is a fun and memorable family-friendly card game wherever and whenever.
Ready. Set. UNO!™
- Play the classic card game, UNO!™, or select from a variety of house rules to play in real-time matches
- Compete in tournaments and events to win free rewards and top the leaderboards
- Partner up with friends or family, play in 2v2 mode, and collaborate to win
- Connect anytime, anywhere with family and friends from around the world.
FEATURES
The Classic Game at your Fingertips
New to UNO!™ or wanting to play your favorite card game? Tap Quick Play and start up a new game with classic UNO!™ rules. Get ready for new monthly rewards and events!
Play with Friends
Play with friends or family! Set up your own house rules and play your way. UNO!™ is a family-friendly party that makes it free and easy for anyone to join!
Buddy Up
Find a friend or family and partner up to battle in 2 player teams. Help each other reduce your hand (or your partner’s) to zero as quickly as possible to beat the other team!
Connect, Chat, Shout UNO!™
Connect with your buddies in UNO!™ with clubs and send each other gifts. Make a strategy and remember to shout UNO before anyone else.
New Challenges at Every Level
Compete in World Series tournaments and special events to win free rewards. Top the leaderboards and show off to your friends and family! Then spin the wheel and try your fortune to get free rewards every day!
Go Wild – No, Really
This no-holds-barred mode is as wacky as UNO!™ gets. Forget the classic mode - house rules on, two-deck play, and free winnings up to 600 times what you put in to make you the coin master! But beware, in this wild game mode, you win big or go home empty-handed! Are you up for the challenge?
UNO Championship Series
Claim your daily tournament invitation to the official UCS Digital Qualifiers!
Players who master all three Digital Qualifier Tournaments will earn their spot as a UCS Finalist and a chance at the title of UNO World Champion!
Compete with the best of the best in Classic UNO—with a new Special Rules twist!
NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. Open to legal residents of the 50 US/DC, age 18+. Qualification Rounds end at 4:59 pm PT on 9/26/26. See Official Rules for details: https://championship.matteluno.com
Visit our official site at www.letsplayuno.com
Follow us on Facebook for more updates: www.facebook.com/UNOnow

bluejetty:00082786:ios.description:
All-In-One photo editor that combines stylish photo effects and amazing auto retouching tool for your selfies.
UNIQUE FILTERS AND STYLISH PHOTO EFFECTS
Camly lets you use various effects including unique filters that can easily make your photo special.
Filter packs were created by a team of professional photographers and compile their long photo editing experience. Use the results of their work to give a desirable look to your photo: make the best selfie or add vintage effect to your photo 
STYLISH STICKERS AND CAPTIONS
Camly has a set of stickers that can turn your photo into an exciting story. You’ll be pleasantly surprised by our stickers. We have everything from hipster moustache to hearts and flowers and even fairy tale characters.
Camly lets you add beautiful captions so that you could express all your emotions on the photo.
PROFESSIONAL EDITING
Camly has a set of professional editing tools especially for the delicate adjustment fans. With Camly you can edit brightness, contrast, optical exposure, light and shadows, hue, colour temperature(warmth), saturation, acutance. You can also use vignette, cutting and rotating tools including straightening the horizon, Fisheye, Anaglyph 3D, barrel and pincushion distortion, keystone distortion, blur, tilt-shift and other useful settings.
DOZENS OF COLLAGES
When one photo is not enough to express all your ideas use collages. We’ve created a huge number of collages for every life situation.
MORE THAN 50 BACKGROUND IMAGE FRAMES
Add new colours to your photo by putting it in a frame. You can choose the most suitable background picture and add bright creative hues to your photo.
FAST POSTING OF THE RESULT IN SOCIAL NETWORKS
You can save the edited photo on your phone or share it with friends by posting in your favourite social networks.
Use #Camly when posting photos. We’ll find your photos and post the best ones in our popular accounts with thousands of followers mentioning you as an author. 
Moreover, using #Camly you help spreading the application through your friends who will thank you for a great recommendation.

Finish drawing challenges and enhance your art skills, and share your masterpieces. Experience our coloring game for joyful art and deep coloring ASMR relaxation.

Discover hundreds of famous characters with coloring ASMR each week. This coloring game provides endless hours of enjoyable color game fun, making it a top coloring game for true ASMR coloring enthusiasts.

Relax and immerse yourself in the fun of drawing and painting games, enjoying the soothing color ASMR effects without any mess. This coloring ASMR experience is a fantastic anti-stress tool that can literally help you unwind with its clean images. Drop into these coloring games anytime to soothe your nerves with therapeutic levels of coloring ASMR. This is a true ASMR coloring delight.
