bluejetty:00024851:ios.description:
Password Manager Vault is a convenient, all-in-one password management and secret folder app that allows you to store login details, photos, videos and notes securely.
Password Manager Vault and Secret Folder is the only app that lets you safeguard and store your data with complete privacy across all of your iOS devices. Login information is protected by AES 256-bit encryption. That means only you can access them, not your neighbor, not us, not even your best friend! Keep your files, passwords and photos safe with Secure!
Password Management
- Store passwords for your most frequently visited sites. Log in with a single tap, and then get back to browsing!
- Automatic form filling with just one tap. Never fill in another sign-up form again!
- Detects new logins and saves information so you don’t have to memorize anything.
- Powerful password generator to create un-guessable passwords.
- Secure protects everything with a master password that encrypts and decrypts your data on command.
Secret Folder Feature
- Move images and videos into the photo vault to keep them private and secure.
- Hide your media from prying eyes. Only you can see your photos!
Browsing
- Secure web surfing with a built-in browser
- Multitab browsing keeps you more productive
- Connect Secure to Safari to quickly use stored passwords while you browse
- Autofill passwords on iOS 12
Media Storage
- Organize photos, videos and notes into albums for easy viewing.
- Powerful search and sort features let you find what you're looking for in an instant.
- Import and export from your camera, photo library or cloud storage service such as Dropbox or Google Drive.
- Innovative filters and effects to add a personal touch to your photos.
Privacy
- Your data, photos and files are accessible only by you!
- Change open applications by flipping the device. Instant privacy!
- Dummy screen to protect your privacy even when friends use your phone.
- Secure snaps photos and saves location information to log break-in attempts.
- Backup and restore device data via iTunes and iCloud.
- Compatible with Touch ID and Face ID.
New Features
- Use Picture-In-Picture to watch a video while using your iPad for other tasks.
- Use Spotlight Search to find things quickly on your iOS device.
Password Manager Vault and Secret Folder is built exclusively for iOS 10 and above.
VIP Subscription:
Password Manager Vault VIP subscription which is available on a weekly, monthly and yearly tier, auto-renewable. The yearly subscription is priced at 3.99 USD/week, 6.99 USD/month and 24.99 USD/year (or local equivalent). You will be able to use more cloud storage, photo filter effects and more for the duration of the subscription. 
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period. Unused portions of free trials, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchase of a subscription.
Links to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service:
Privacy Policy: http://www.rvappstudios.com/app-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: http://www.rvappstudios.com/app-privacy-policy.html#terms/

bluejetty:00130150:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of adorable cats and cute kittens. In this relaxing cat game, all the cats are shuffled and on the wrong branches. Your task is to help them get back to the right branch with their friends so that they can jump away.
This Cute Cat Game is packed with a lot of stunning and unique features, which promise to take away all your stress after a tough day, or simply bring you a relaxing time. You can play with your cats like a cat game for cats.
HOW TO PLAY
This color puzzle is very simple to play, suitable for all ages
- Simply tap on one cat, then tap on another branch with an available spot to make the cat jump to that branch. Keep in mind that only cats of the same color can be stacked on each other
- Try to arrange the kittens until all the colored cats of the same color are on one branch, and then jump away
- After sorting all cute kittens, you will win that level and move to another challenging one
- Do your best to pass the level with the fewest moves. If you get stuck at some points, you can use useful boosters to help you win more easily
- When you get the hang of this game, you can effortlessly overcome every level without the help of any boosters
FEATURES
- Simple and easy to play. This Kitten Sorting Puzzle is suitable for all ages
- One-finger control
- Cute and adorable cat to please your vision
- ASMR sounds that help you relax and free all your stress away
- Multiple cat skins and themes for you to discover
- 1000+ levels, with different gameplay and challenges
- No time limit. You can play at any time, anywhere you want
- Unique design and gameplay. An updated version of sort puzzle
What you're waiting for? Let's join the world of cute kittens and have a fun time

bluejetty:00078049:ios.description:
Swiftie Lover: The Ultimate Taylor Swift Fan Experience
Calling all Swifties! Build your friendship bracelet, earn charms, and play with every era in the most fan-flavored Taylor Swift app on the App Store. Whether you're a casual listener or a die-hard Swiftie, Swiftie Lover has something for every era of your fandom.
MAKE YOUR FRIENDSHIP BRACELET
Pick your era — from Debut all the way to The Tortured Poets Department — and choose your vibe (Cardigan and tea, Glitter and gold, Daydreamer, Disco ball energy, or Rep ride or die). Watch your name bead onto a personalized friendship bracelet that becomes your identity in the app and a stunning image you can share.
EARN CHARMS IN YOUR TROPHY CASE
Every game you play unlocks charms for your personal Trophy Case. Build Swordle streaks, win Lyrics Challenges, hit the Trivia leaderboard, solve sliding puzzles in record time — and watch your charm collection grow, with live progress on every locked achievement.
PLAY EVERY GAME
Swiftie Trivia — Three modes: Leaderboard Challenge, Songs and Lyrics, and Personal Life. Test your knowledge and compete with Swifties worldwide.
Swiftie Lyrics — Complete Taylor's most beloved lyrics in the Lyrics Challenge, or browse Popular Lyrics to share with friends.
Swordle of the Day — A fresh Taylor-themed 5-letter word puzzle every day. Build your streak. Share your results.
Lucky 13 — Match tiles to Taylor's favorite number in this fast-paced puzzle. Race the clock to clear the board and chase a new high score.
Sliding Puzzle — Solve sliding puzzles built from actual album covers spanning every era.
Swiftie Pictures — Create AI-powered, Polaroid-style artwork inspired by Taylor's aesthetic. Browse your personal collage of Swiftie memories.
Tay Tay Track Talk — Explore the full discography, vote on your Top 10 favorite tracks, and see what other Swifties love.
Quotes, Magic 8 Ball, and Mood Ring — Inspirational quotes from Taylor, ask the Swiftie Magic 8 Ball for advice, and share your mood Swiftie-style with shareable mood cards.
SHARE THE MAGIC
Every win is beautifully shareable. Branded image cards for Swordle results, Trivia scores, Lyrics high scores, Lucky 13 victories, and your friendship bracelet itself — perfect for Instagram Stories, iMessage, and TikTok.

bluejetty:00070497:ios.description:
Blood Sugar Tracker & Logbook helps you log blood sugar, blood pressure, weight, and estimated A1C in one simple app.
Track your daily health readings, view trends with charts, set reminders, and export reports whenever you need them. Whether you want a blood sugar logbook, a diabetes tracker, or a simple way to monitor BP and weight, this app keeps everything organized in one place.
Track important health metrics
• Blood Sugar / Glucose
• Blood Pressure (BP)
• Weight
• Estimated A1C
Key Features
Blood Sugar Logbook
Log blood sugar readings with time-based tags such as fasting, before breakfast, after breakfast, before lunch, after lunch, before dinner, and after dinner.
Blood Pressure & Pulse Tracker
Record systolic and diastolic blood pressure values along with pulse rate to maintain a complete BP log.
Weight & BMI Tracking
Track body weight over time and monitor BMI based on your entered details.
Estimated A1C Overview
View an estimated A1C based on your logged glucose readings for general tracking purposes.
Charts & Trends
See your blood sugar, BP, and weight history in easy-to-read charts to better understand changes over time.
Daily Reminders
Set reminders to log readings consistently throughout the day.
Export Reports
Export your records in PDF or CSV format for personal use or to share during doctor visits.
Flexible Units
Supports blood glucose units in mg/dL and mmol/L, plus weight units in lbs and kg.
Quick Logging
Add entries quickly from the home screen dashboard for faster daily use.
Subscription Options
Monthly – $4.99/month
Unlock full app access with an ad-free experience. Auto-renews monthly.
Yearly – $49.99/year
Unlock full app access with an ad-free experience. Auto-renews yearly.
Payment & Renewal
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.
For more details on managing subscriptions, visit:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/118428
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/bloodglucosetrackerdiarytos/home
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/bloodglucosetrackerdiary/home
Disclaimer
This app does not measure blood sugar, blood pressure, or weight. It is a personal health logbook for recording values entered by the user. The app is intended for tracking and informational purposes only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical guidance.
Thank you for choosing us.
For feedback, suggestions, or support, contact: developer@identiqinfotech.com

bluejetty:00185626:ios.description:
The world's #1 dog camera app, featured as App of the Day by Apple in over 140 countries.
Scan you dog and predict their breed! Over 150 dog breeds supported. Save your scans and collect breeds as you scan more dogs. 
Play sounds from the camera and get your dog's attention every time! Try over 100+ sounds and capture their head tilts as a photo or video. 
*** DOG SCANNER *** 
Our scanner lets you scan any dog and predict its breed.
Learn about each breed:
- Personality traits
- Coat length, thickness and feel 
- Bark-o-meter 
*** CAMERA SOUNDS *** 
Our camera app is packed with over 100 sounds including dog whistles, cats, animals, and squeaky toys. Play the sounds directly from the camera and watch your dog's head tilt. You'll get the perfect shot every time.
Why you’ll love DogCam:
- Engage & Tease Your Dog: Use our unique whistle, animal, bark, and toy sounds to make your dog react and look at the camera.
- Flexible Shooting: Switch seamlessly between selfie and standard camera modes to capture your pet's best angles.
- Apple Watch Sounds: Play sounds directly from our free Apple Watch app without needing your phone at hand.
- Advanced Camera Controls: Enjoy customizable settings like live photos, flash, zoom, auto-focus, and a countdown timer for the ideal setup.
- Effortless Sharing: Snap, then share your favorite moments directly to social media with ease.
- In-app Photo Library: The in-app photo library keeps your favorite photos in one place.
- Accessibility: Voice-over support ensures everyone can capture great pet photos.
DogCam has been celebrated globally and featured by Apple in over 140 countries. Praised for its simplicity and fun, it's your go-to for capturing dog moments, making every shot TikTok-worthy. Elevate your dog photography game and make every photo count with DogCam!  
*** FROM THE APP STORE EDITORS *** 
"The app is incredibly easy to use: just point, make some noise and shoot. When you've got a picture or video you're thrilled with, then you can share it straight from the app onto your favourite social feeds. Did somebody say #pupfluencer?"

"Amazing app - I got some amazing pics with this app and also my dogs seem to love the sound."
"Absolutely brilliant! - This app is genius! My dog would never look at the camera for me to take a picture and now in all my pictures of her she is looking at the camera! I LOVE this app!"

DeerCast is the most advanced whitetail hunting app, built for deer hunters, by deer hunters. DeerCast predicts whitetail movement down to the hour based on weather variables in your area. Install now to see today’s whitetail forecast for free! 
Whitetail deer behavior is driven by their environment. Become a better whitetail hunter with the DeerCast hunting app. Get data-driven deer movement predictions, advanced weather forecasts, and mapping features all specifically formulated with the whitetail deer hunter in mind. DeerCast delivers all the information you need to get your buck.

Designed by renowned whitetail experts Mark and Terry Drury of Drury Outdoors, DeerCast pulls weather and moon data for your locations and delivers a custom, deer-movement prediction, just for you.

Plan your whitetail hunts with multiple GPS maps and tools built specifically for the whitetail hunter. Find property lines, hunting land, and more.

◆ Custom Waypoints 
◆ Wind Check 
◆ Food Plots 
◆ Live Doppler Radar 
◆ Virtual Rain Gauges

Select your hit on an anatomical whitetail model, then get expert advice to track and recover your deer. 
▶ COMMUNITY ▶ 
Get thousands of hunting articles and share your successes in the field. Learn from the Drury Outdoors team and watch their hunts as they happen. 
▶ FEEDBACK ▶ 
We want to know about your experience with DeerCast. Shoot us an email at support@deercast.com.

bluejetty:00187438:ios.description:
The My Loja Store is the sales tracking app for you that sells your products or has a small store. It has a very user friendly interface for everyone to use.
No more wasting your time on complex and unsupported systems for your business. Use our application completely without computers and internet, all control will be in the palm of your hand.
We have the following free features:
- Grid or simple inventory control
- Product Registration
- Sales Control
- Catalog of your products in PDF
- Barcode reader
- Product Type and Category Registration
- Expense Tracking
- Customer Registration
- Customer Debt Control in installments
- Proof of sale
- Receipt of Values
- Reports
- Whatsapp Support
- Product Suppliers
- Grid or simple inventory control: If you sell a product type that requires special inventory control such as clothing, you can have your inventory control by size or the attribute you want.
- Product Registration: We have complete product registration with photos. In it you can even control the purchase or production costs of your product and know exactly your profits.
- Catalog of your products in PDF: You can generate a PDF catalog of your products to send to your customers. The catalog has photos for them to see and already order for you without having to go to your store.
- Barcode reader: The app has a barcode reader that can be used by the phone's own camera.

bluejetty:00042419:ios.description:
Fearless Wallet is a self-custodial, multi-chain, and open-source mobile wallet for Polkadot, Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, TON and SORA, with the best UX, performance, and, most importantly, security!
Users own their tokens and interact directly with their favorite blockchain networks - Fearless Wallet takes ZERO fees!
With Fearless Wallet, you can:
CREATE OR IMPORT A WALLET
Fearless Wallet allows you to create a new wallet or import an existing one.
MANAGE MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS VIA A SINGLE APP
Fearless Wallet offers users a convenient way to manage multiple accounts within a single app.
Account names can be modified, rearranged, removed, or exported in mnemonic, seed, or JSON formats.
ACCESS MAJOR NETWORKS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Fearless Wallet supports the major networks of the Polkadot, Kusama and Ethereum ecosystems, Substrate based standalone networks, Bitcoin, Solana and TON.
SEND AND RECEIVE TOKENS
Send and receive tokens via an account address or QR code. Adjust your transfer parameters with convenience and freedom.
STAKE AND EARN REWARDS
Stake on supported networks directly from your wallet.
USE IT ON IPHONE AND IPAD
Fearless Wallet runs natively on iPad, with balances and history side by side.
ACCESS 24/7 COMMUNITY SUPPORT
The Fearless Wallet community is always here to help, whether you’re a longtime user or just getting started. Connect with us on our telegram channel https://t.me/fearlesshappiness.
Fearless Wallet is built with focusing on providing an exceptional user experience and with user safety in mind, offering:
TRANSPARENCY OVER YOUR ASSETS
View your total, available, and frozen (bonded, unbonded, locked, redeemable, and reserved) token balances in real time via WebSocket connections to the selected Kusama and Polkadot nodes.
USER-FRIENDLY UI/UX
Fearless Wallet‘s awesome UI enables any user (even newbies) to perform complex actions in 1-2 taps while advanced users still retain access to all of the key features available on the network!
ENHANCED SECURITY
Our unique feature alerts users about security risks during the fund transfer process. If a recipient address has been flagged as a scammer or belongs to CEX, users receive a warning to prevent potential loss of funds.
Fearless Wallet aims to radically expand access to decentralized finance (DeFi) by making complex functions easier to use and understand.
Download Fearless Wallet and embark on your DeFi journey today! Stay Fearless!

bluejetty:00076309:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00076309:ios.description:
OpPreds publishes options predictions for U.S. stocks on market days: the contract, a buy target, two sell targets and a stop loss. Then it follows every prediction until it closes, and shows each result in the app.
ON MARKET DAYS
New predictions come at the open, on calls and puts of actively traded U.S. stocks. Each one names the strike, the expiry, a buy target, a 1st and a 2nd sell target, and a stop loss. When the market gives no setup that meets the criteria, no prediction is published.
THE OPTIONS CHAIN
Search any U.S. stock by ticker or company name and see its options chain: price, volume, open interest, implied volatility and delta for every strike and expiry. One tap opens the chain from any prediction.
UNUSUAL OPTIONS FLOW
See the contracts trading far above their open interest, with the money behind them, scanned every 5 minutes while the market is open.
PROFIT, LOSS AND POSITION SIZE
For every prediction, the profit or loss of one contract at the stop and at each target. Enter the most you want to lose, and OpPreds works out how many contracts fit the stop loss. Each prediction also shows how its targets work as order prices at a broker.
ALERTS ON THE TICKERS YOU FOLLOW
Follow a ticker and hear when it has a new prediction, when a sell target or the stop loss is reached, and when it has unusual flow.
EVERY RESULT, OPEN AND CLOSED
Closed predictions stay in the app with how each one ended, the ones that reached a target and the ones that reached the stop. The Performance tab follows the predictions in a portfolio simulation and shows the result, profit or loss, from each prediction's own targets and before fees and other trading costs. Real trades can turn out differently.
RESEARCH THE UNDERLYING STOCK
Charts, technical indicators and the latest news for the stock behind every prediction. Export the open predictions as a CSV file.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
OpPreds is for information and education. Nothing in the app is financial, investment or trading advice. Predictions can be wrong, and past results do not guarantee future results. Options trading involves substantial risk: an option can expire worthless and lose all that was paid for it.

Looking for a brand-new way to sharpen your mind, expand your vocabulary, and melt away daily stress? Welcome to Wordful—the ultimate mind-sharpening word puzzle game beautifully blended with stunning, soothing nature aesthetics!
Say goodb
bluejetty:00026994:ios.description:
Looking for a brand-new way to sharpen your mind, expand your vocabulary, and melt away daily stress? Welcome to Wordful—the ultimate mind-sharpening word puzzle game beautifully blended with stunning, soothing nature aesthetics!
Say goodbye to rigid, traditional word search constraints and chaotic, falling blocks. Wordful introduces a smart, intuitive 8-directional snaking mechanism with static grid elimination. Every single letter block can branch out in any of the 8 directions—up, down, left, right, and diagonally—allowing words to bend, twist, and turn across the grid in creative paths.
Unlike other games where blocks collapse and constantly ruin your strategy, cleared blocks in Wordful simply disappear without dropping the ones above. This unique design keeps the board layout predictable and easy to pick up, letting you relax, visualize your paths, and enjoy a perfectly balanced, stress-free challenge without the overwhelming difficulty of traditional falling puzzles.
Immerse yourself in a sanctuary of tranquility. Every level features a breathtaking, premium photograph of serene nature close-ups—vibrant green leaves with morning dew, delicate flower petals, pinecones, stones, and soft feathers. It’s not just a brain trainer; it’s a visual retreat for your soul.
With infinite levels ranging from cozy and relaxing to mind-bendingly rewarding, you will never run out of fun. Think outside the box, decode the clever clues, trace the twisting paths, and clear the board at your own peaceful pace!
Why You’ll Love Wordful:
8-Directional Twisting Paths: Break free from straight lines! Snake and bend through adjacent letter blocks in any direction to discover hidden words.
Smart Static Elimination: Cleared blocks disappear without dropping the letters above. Enjoy a predictable, perfectly balanced challenge that is accessible yet engaging.
Infinite Healing Levels: Endless well-curated levels that grow with your skills. Perfect to kickstart your morning or unwind before bed.
Soothing Nature Visuals: Play against a backdrop of gorgeous, healing nature still lifes. A true zen experience for your eyes and mind.
Brain-Sharpening Hints: Put your vocabulary and spelling to the test with fun, contextual clues that keep your brain sharp and alert.
Powerful Boosters: Stuck on a tricky board? Use fun boosters like Rockets, Magnifiers, Lightbulbs, and Flashlights to clear the way!
Play Anytime, Anywhere: No WiFi? No problem! Access the full game offline and kill boredom wherever you are.
Escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Start your peaceful word-hunting journey, master the twisting paths, and become the ultimate word genius!
Download Wordful today and let nature restore your mind!

bluejetty:00060785:ios.summary:
checkfelix durchsucht Hunderte von Reise-Websites und zeigt dir Optionen an. So kannst du wählen, was am besten zu deinem Trip passt. Beobachte Preise, lege ein Budget fest, stelle deinen Reiseplan zusammen und mehr.
DAS BIETET UNSERE APP.
bluejetty:00060785:ios.description:
checkfelix durchsucht Hunderte von Reise-Websites und zeigt dir Optionen an. So kannst du wählen, was am besten zu deinem Trip passt. Beobachte Preise, lege ein Budget fest, stelle deinen Reiseplan zusammen und mehr.
DAS BIETET UNSERE APP.
• Sichere dir den gewünschten Flug: Vergleiche Flugoptionen von Hunderten Websites und grenze sie mithilfe unserer Filter auf die für dich passendsten ein.
• Hotelpreise nur in der App. Finde Mobile Deals für ausgewählte Hotels.
• Car -Sharing: Suche neben klassischen Anbietern auch nach Car-Sharing – für mehr Optionen und eventuell bessere Preise.
• Erfahre, wenn sich Preise ändern: Beobachte Suchergebnisse für deinen Trip und lass dich bei Preisänderungen benachrichtigen.
• Suche innerhalb deines Budgets: Du kannst nur 300 € ausgeben? checkfelix Explore zeigt dir deine Flugoptionen – passend zu jedem Budget.
NUR IN DER CHECKFELIX APP.
• Flugstatus: Erhalte einen Alarm, wenn sich an deinem Flug etwas ändert, oder beobachte Flüge, um zu sehen, ob du es zu deinem Anschlussflug schaffst.
• Trips offline: Alle deine in Trips geladenen Ticketbestätigungen und Reservierungen sind zugänglich – egal, ob du gerade WLAN hast oder nicht.
• Miss dein Gepäck: Richte deine Kamera auf deine Tasche oder deinen Handgepäckkoffer. Wir teilen dir dann mit, ob das Gepäck die richtige Größe hat, sodass keine Gebühr anfällt.
WIR LIEBEN FEEDBACK.
Du hast eine Frage und brauchst Unterstützung? Schicke uns unter https://www.checkfelix.com/help eine Nachricht und wir helfen dir gerne weiter.
MEHR ZUM ANGEBOT VON CHECKFELIX.
Finde Flüge, Hotels, Ferienunterkünfte, Mietwagen und mehr – filtere dann anhand der für dich wichtigsten Kriterien. Wie etwa ein haustierfreundliches Boutique-Hotel mit Pool. Oder eine 4-türige Limousine mit Anmietung am Flughafen, mit der du sofort mobil bist. Wir bringen tolle Angebote von deinen bevorzugten Reise-Websites an einem Ort zusammen.
DUCHSUCHE HUNDERTE FLUG-WEBSITES AUF EINMAL.
Dank Optionen zum Filtern und für Flexibilität kannst du schnell suchen und buchen, was am besten zu deinem Trip passt.
MEHR OPTIONEN, MEHR ERSPARNISSE.
Finde Mobile Deals und weitere exklusive Angebote in der App. Richte Preisalarme ein, um zu erfahren, wenn Preise für Flüge, Mietwagen und Hotels fallen, an denen du interessiert bist.
ERSTELLE DEN REISEVERLAUF SCHON BEIM PLANEN.
Unser Trips-Tool sammelt alle deine Pläne an einem Ort. Lass dich über Flug- und Gate-Änderungen benachrichtigen, greife on- oder offline auf Bordkarten zu und teile deinen Reiseverlauf im Freundeskreis – alles an einem Ort. Du kannst deinen Posteingang synchronisieren oder manuell beliebige Bestandteile deines Trips hinzufügen – von Bestätigungen für Ausflüge und Restaurants bis zu Notizen zu Sehenswürdigkeiten.
MIETWAGENANGEBOTE.
Suche für über 70.000 Stationen, um den perfekten Mietwagen zu finden. Buche ohne Risiko, indem du nach Richtlinien mit kostenloser Stornierung filterst.
BUCHE EIN HOTEL … ODER EIN ZUHAUSE.
Schau dir deine Unterkunftsoptionen von großen Hotelketten und Resorts bis hin zu lokalen Boutique-Hotels, Apartments, Hütten, Strandhäusern und mehr an. Filtere nach kostenloser Stornierung, falls du Sorge hast, dass sich deine Pläne ändern.
Plane deinen nächsten Trip mit checkfelix. Lade jetzt die App herunter, um mit der Planung eines tollen Trips zu beginnen.

bluejetty:00155445:ios.description:
HEDERA GUILD GAME - Slime World Major Update
Slime World is back with an exciting new look! With this major rebranding update, explore a broader world, enjoy diverse features, and experience a user-friendly interface that enhances gameplay.
We’ve also prepared welcome events for new, returning, and existing users, along with community and game-based events. Join us and dive into the fun!
◈ SlimeWorld Major Update Highlights
 ● MAIN UI
 ● Two New Minigames (Super Jump, Road Crossing)
 ● Roulette
 ● Profile System
 ● Friends Feature
 ● Chat Function
 ● Multi-Staking
 ● Three New Languages (Vietnamese, Filipino, Indonesian)
 ● Transition to HGG (Hedera Guild Games) Token
◈ Game Overview
HGG (Hedera Guild Game) Token
 ● Earn Orichalcum through gameplay and exchange it for HGG Tokens, based on Hedera's blockchain! 
 ● The HGG Token is listed on major global exchanges like HTX, MEXC, Poloniex, GOPAX, and INDODAX, allowing for easy trade.
 ● Slime NFTs can be traded in the in-game NFT marketplace.
PVP Arena Mode
 ● If you own an NFT, showcase its power in PvP Arena Mode! Don’t have an NFT? Join with our rental system to get started.
Infinite Mode
 ● Battle waves of enemies in this strategic random defense game! The more enemies you defeat, the more Orichalcum you earn. Exchange Orichalcum for HGG Tokens and boost your gameplay!
Mini-Games
 ● Enjoy a range of mini-games in Slime World for extra fun and rewards! Each mini-game is filled with challenges to keep you entertained.
Roulette
 ● Spin the roulette for a chance to win rare items and resources! Become the hero of Slime World and strengthen your gameplay with these exciting rewards.
HGG Token Staking
 ● Experience innovation with our "Multi-Staking" service. Stake multiple assets simultaneously for diverse rewards, enjoying enhanced benefits through Slime World’s unique multi-staking offerings.
Profile, Chat, and Friends
 ● Customize your profile with your NFT, flags, and emblems, and express yourself in Slime World! Connect with friends and enjoy real-time chat to share strategies and build teamwork.
◈ Official Community Links
 ● Brand Page: https://hguild.io/
 ● Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hederaguildgame
 ● Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hederaguildgame
 ● Twitter: https://x.com/HederaGuildGame
 ● Telegram: https://t.me/HederaGuildGameCommunity
◈ Customer Support Email
 ● slimeworldCS@gmail.com
◈ Terms and Conditions
 ● https://hguild.io/front/policy/terms
◈ Privacy Policy
 ● https://hguild.io/front/policy/privacy
Embark on an exciting adventure with the latest Slime World update and enjoy endless fun!

bluejetty:00074113:ios.summary:
Period Tracker, the easiest way to track your health! 
*Now supports HealthKit, 3DTouch, TouchID, portrait charts, Advanced TTC Mode (the easiest way to get pregnant by following the homepage timeline’s simple prompted instructions!), and
bluejetty:00074113:ios.description:
Period Tracker, the easiest way to track your health! 
*Now supports HealthKit, 3DTouch, TouchID, portrait charts, Advanced TTC Mode (the easiest way to get pregnant by following the homepage timeline’s simple prompted instructions!), and Pregnancy Mode with articles and week-by-week images.
Period Tracker is SIMPLE and CUTE. 
* Press a button at the start of your period every month. Period Tracker logs your dates and calculates the average of your past 3 months' menstrual cycles to predict the start date of your next period. 
* View your current and future period dates, ovulation and fertile days, moods, symptoms, weight, temp, and fertility notes in a simple month-view calendar. 
* Discreet iPhone icon simply reads "PTracker." 
Period Tracker is FILLED WITH FEATURES. 
* Take daily notes of menstrual symptoms including Spotting, Flow, Cramps, Headaches, Backaches, Bloating, Tender Breasts, and Body Aches! 
* Track your weight, temperature and moods (over 30+ moods to choose from!) 
* Add custom symptoms and moods 
* Charts! Beautiful, comprehensive and handy. Charts show weight, temp, symptoms, period length, cycle length, and more.
* Backup/Restore your data with your online backup and restore account. (works across platforms)
* Homescreen shows your predicted ovulation, eight day "fertile window,” and your cycle day. Great for trying to conceive.
* Pregnancy mode activates countdown to baby's due date and week-by-week articles.
* Protect your privacy with TOUCH ID or with a passcode option that is fast and easy. 
* Export your period dates and notes to email for doctor's visits. 
Period Tracker is loved by millions of users.
MommaRed - "I really like this application. It is easy to use, easy to track and plan for upcoming events. The recent updates have made it even better. One of my favorite iPhone apps." 
Blanczz226 - "This is one of my favorite apps. I use it every month and it's extremely accurate. Worth the $ for sure"
GeekSugar.com - "Period Tracker is the ultimate menstrual mentor. You enter in your info, and it tracks your cycles, letting you keep notes about your activities and well being, all the while using twee 'lil hearts .and flowers to denote important days." 
Celstemc - "One of my first apps and I am completely in love with it! Won't use another one like it!! Cute and easy to use!" 
Subscription Details
By subscribing to the Period Tracker Patron program you receive additional features. Subscription purchased through the app will be charged to your iTunes account. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of $9.99. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Terms of service: https://gpapps.com/support/eula/
Privacy policy: https://gpapps.com/support/privacy-policy/
Disclaimer: Period Tracker period and fertility forecasts may not be accurate and should not be used to prevent unwanted pregnancy. To forecast ovulation Period Tracker calculates 14 days before the projected start date of one's next period. Forecast accuracy depends on a number of factors including how regular one's cycle length is, when one actually ovulates during the cycle, and how many periods have been logged in the app. Anxiety, stress, diet, nutrition, exercise, environment, medications, age and other factors can also affect one's cycle from month to month. 
Please email comments and suggestions to supportgpa@gmail.com.

Bored with being the boss of the diners and farms? Don’t be idle, it’s time to think bigger, airport big! Click, click and tap, tap your way to building a corporate empire, and become
bluejetty:00019153:ios.description:
GET OUT OF TOWN AND TAKE FLIGHT - IT’S ADVENTURE TIME!
Bored with being the boss of the diners and farms? Don’t be idle, it’s time to think bigger, airport big! Click, click and tap, tap your way to building a corporate empire, and become a business idol - the ultimate boss. 
Construct and earn as you build your airport, constantly adding more planes to your empire that will take flight around the world. There’s no medieval market town or aqua park here. A little market, farm or diner are small cheese, it’s time to build an empire. The mile-high adventure flight awaits you in this addictive simulator madness.
Earn fame and fortune being an Airport tycoon with this clicker simulator. Amongst the madness, market your empire for crazy adventures for everyone who is ready to get out of town and take flight.
Get out of the village, leave the farm behind, let the diners feed themselves, and head for the skies. No puzzles or shops, just addictive fun and simulator madness for a family-friendly rollercoaster of exciting fun - It’s crazy how addictive this clicker simulator game is. Just click click and tap tap, and you can take flight.
Earn a profit, be cool and fun on the airport run. No miner themes, just an addictive game of business and fortune. 
Be as idle as you like, because you’ll always be the adventurer’s idol in your own airport.
Are you an empire hero in the market for a new challenge, ready to play with the business of adventures?
Play the game around the world seeking magic and madness without a farm in sight.
Easy, fun airport simulator
Simulated magic without a farm, market, mall, or town, this is capitalism baby. Be the crazy cool investor, the hero of flight.
It’s your airport and they’re your planes, so it’s up to you where your planes fly to. You are even the boss of who gets to fly in one of your adventure-ready planes. 
Upgrade your planes in this idle game, for silly fun or corporate profit. Be the tycoon you’ve always wanted to be. 
Invest, earn, enjoy the profit. This is no time to be idle; be an idol! 
Leave the mines behind and head for the skies. Your choice, send the world on adventures, or head to the farm and pick carrots. You now have air hostesses to serve the diners; hang up the apron and become an investor; your own boss and run the worlds’ craziest airport.
If you’re looking for a new challenge, this is the idle clicker game for you. Highly addictive, family-friendly fun. If you want to be a mining tycoon, then head underground, but if you want to take on the world, become the ultimate airport tycoon. Be THE tycoon; THE boss of the skies, not the mayor of a little town.
The airport madness awaits you. Are you ready for the summer craziness, because at your airport, it’s always summer!!

bluejetty:00037270:ios.name: Super Flappy Golf
bluejetty:00037270:ios.summary: Flap. Glide. Dive. The easiest "golf" game to pick up and the hardest to put down. It's sort of golf anyway - if golf involved a bird, a lot of frantic flapping, and 40 gloriously silly courses. Master them solo, or flap circles around your
bluejetty:00037270:ios.description:
Flap. Glide. Dive. The easiest "golf" game to pick up and the hardest to put down. It's sort of golf anyway - if golf involved a bird, a lot of frantic flapping, and 40 gloriously silly courses. Master them solo, or flap circles around your friends.
• Two buttons. One on each side of the screen. Tap one to flap in that direction. Hold it to glide. Hold both to dive bomb straight down. Now you know how to play! Easy peasy.
• Glide and dive. Two new moves to the Flappy Golf series that let you sail across gaps and thread the perfect line to the cup. Simple controls get anyone playing, but you'll need to master these skills to prove you're a Superstar.
• Solo or online. Dive into single player to unlock new courses and hone your skills. Then jump into online multiplayer to vibe out with friends - or get competitive in ranked matchmaking.
• Two ways to play. Time your moves carefully to reach the cup in the fewest flaps, or get feathers flying in a race to the hole where you can flap as much as you want!
• Show off your wings. Hatch eggs to get all kinds of birdies, from adorable to utterly cursed. Hunt for rare birdies or just fly your favorite. With over a billion combinations, you can be sure your most epic birdie is unlike anyone else's.
• Keep coming back. Climb the ranks to Superstar, compete on the Weekly Course Challenge leaderboards, and save replays of your finest (or most disastrous) moments to share.
• No Wi-Fi? No problem. Single player works offline so you can keep flapping in subway tunnels, on planes, and in the middle of the forest.
• Cross-platform. Play with your friends on mobile, tablet, and Mac - and pick up right where you left off on any device.
• Free to play. You can't buy a skill advantage, just legendary birdies and more ways to show off your style. And a one-time Premium Unlock kills the ads for good and throws in a few extra goodies.
Try out the latest Flappy Golf now! With over 17 million downloads across the series and counting, you know it's going to be hard to put down. Happy Flapping!

bluejetty:00121259:ios.description:
Ed Euromaus and Snorri welcome you to the new app of Europa-Park and the indoor water world Rulantica. Whether you are planning your visit, buy tickets, check queue times of attractions during your visit, look at showtimes, navigate through the park or want to stay up do date on the news around Europa-Park, Rulantica, the hotel resort, or our events – the app is your ideal companion before, during and after your stay at the Europa-Park Theme Park and Resort.
MackOne
The centralised log-in service for the digital world of the Europa-Park Theme Park and Resort.
VirtualLine
Simply queue digitally in the app and discover Europa-Park while you wait. You will be notified as soon as it is your turn.
Detailed park map
Discover quickly and easily what is near you or navigate to your next adventure. You have to agree to using GPS in order to use this service.
Overview of current queueing times and showtimes
During your visit in the park you can see the current queueing times and start times of our shows. Don’t forget: You have to agree to using GPS in order to be located.
Buy tickets quickly and easily
Buy your entry tickets, event tickets or parking tickets directly in the app via our online ticket shop and safe having to queue on site.
Individual filters
Delicious paella in Spain, nicely smelling crêpes in France or vegetarian curry in the restaurant Spices – Cuisines of the World? Set the filters to your taste and see the matching results directly in the park map.
VEEJOY, the streaming platform of the Europa-Park Resort
Look forward to exciting background information about different resort attractions, as well as emotionally told stories, exciting movies and series and entertaining podcasts, directly in the app.
And much more is waiting for you…
See for yourself and discover all the features the app has to offer!
If you have any questions or feedback how we can improve the app even further, please send an email to gaesteservice@europapark.de. We look forward to your reviews!

bluejetty:00126689:ios.summary: Access the American College of Cardiology’s clinical guideline recommendations and use interactive tools such as risk scores, dosing calculators, and algorithms through the ACC’s Guideline Clinical App. The App also includes features such a
bluejetty:00126689:ios.description:
Access the American College of Cardiology’s clinical guideline recommendations and use interactive tools such as risk scores, dosing calculators, and algorithms through the ACC’s Guideline Clinical App. The App also includes features such as customizable bookmarks, note-taking, and emailable pdfs. ACC’s Guideline App is free to both members and nonmembers. 
This app is the ACC’s mobile home for clinical guideline content and tools for clinicians caring for patients with cardiovascular disease. Current guidelines in the App include: 
• Atrial Fibrillation (AF) 
• Cardiovascular Risk (CV Risk) 
• Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) 
• Cholesterol (Chol) 
• Device-Based Therapy (DBT) 
• Dual Antiplatelet Therapy Update (DAPT) 
• Heart Failure (HF)
• High Blood Pressure (BP) 
• Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) 
• Lifestyle (Lstyle) 
• Non–ST-Elevation Acute Coronary Syndromes (NSTEMI) 
• Obesity 
• Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI)
• Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD) 
• Perioperative Management for Noncardiac Surgery (Periop) 
• Stable Ischemic Heart Disease (SIHD) 
• ST-Elevated Myocardial Infarction (STEMI) 
• Supraventricular Tachycardia (SVT)
• Syncope 
• Valvular Heart Disease (VHD)
• Ventricular Arrhythmias and the Prevention of Sudden Cardiac Death (VA/SCD) 
Stay tuned for ongoing updates, more guideline content, and tools. 
Send feedback to the ACC directly from the App Information page or post a review in the App Store. Help us find new and better ways to deliver guideline content to clinicians.

While the Content in the App is about specific medical and health care issues, the Content is not a substitute for or replacement of personalized medical advice and is not intended to be used as the sole basis for making individualized medical or health-related decisions.
The views and opinions expressed in the App are those of the contributing authors and editors and do not necessarily represent the views of the ACCF. The Content is not intended to present the only, or necessarily best, methods or procedures for the medical situations addressed, but rather is intended to represent an approach, view, statement, or opinion. bluejetty:00168828:ios.description:
Palette – AI Color Analysis, Color Quiz & Virtual Wardrobe
Discover your seasonal colors for outfits, makeup, and fashion — powered by AI color analysis, a personal color quiz, and a virtual dressing room in your pocket.
Palette is the fastest way to find your personal color season. Take one selfie and our AI determines your undertone (warm or cool, cold or soft), value (light or deep), and chroma (bright or muted), then maps you to one of the 12 seasonal color types — Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter — with a full personal color palette built for your skin tone, eye color, and hair color.
If you're searching for:
Seasonal color analysis and personal color analysis
A 12 season color quiz or color test
Your perfect seasonal color palette
Warm vs. cool (or cold) undertone answers
What colors, makeup, and outfits suit your season
A virtual wardrobe and fashion styling assistant
Palette was built for you.
Automatic AI Color Analysis
Skip the long questionnaires. Palette runs an automatic color analysis from a single selfie and returns:
Your season: Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter
Your 12-season sub-type: Light Summer, Soft Autumn, Deep Winter, Bright Spring, and more
A complete personal color palette with seasonal colors for clothing and makeup
Clear recommendations on fashion shades, lipstick, blush, eyeshadow, and gold vs. silver jewelry
Prefer the classic approach? Walk through seasonal color theory step by step and confirm your result.
The full 12 season color system
Palette supports every seasonal color type used in professional seasonal color analysis:
Light Spring · Warm Spring · Bright Spring
Light Summer · Cool Summer · Soft Summer
Soft Autumn · Warm Autumn · Deep Autumn
Bright Winter · Cool Winter · Deep Winter
Each result comes with a curated seasonal color palette you can reference while shopping, dressing, or planning outfits.
Virtual wardrobe and outfit builder
Snap any clothing item and Palette will:
Identify the color, category, material, and style
Score how well it combines with your seasonal color palette
Suggest how to style and combine it with other pieces
Generate perfect outfits for work, events, travel, or everyday fashion
Build a digital wardrobe, save outfit combinations, and get AI-powered styling tips — all personalized to your color season. Think of it as a virtual dressing room and personal stylist that already knows your colors.
Designed for shopping, styling, and everyday fashion
Use Palette:
While shopping in-store or online
When selecting makeup and lipstick shades
When combining outfits from your closet
When building a capsule wardrobe around seasonal colors
When exploring personal style and fashion trends
Seasonal color analysis isn't just theory — it's a practical shortcut to dressing well in colors that flatter you.
Why Palette?
Most color analysis quizzes rely on subjective answers about whether your veins look blue or your jewelry looks better in gold. Palette uses AI-based image analysis to read your natural coloring directly from your photo, so your personal color analysis is fast, objective, and repeatable. No long forms. No guessing. Just your colors, your palette, your style.
Personal color analysis results and full seasonal color palettes require a paid subscription.
Terms: https://blanklabs.io/palette/terms
Questions: help@blanklabs.io

bluejetty:00141805:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00141805:ios.description:
► Get ready for some brutal shooting action! 
Rain down fiery vengeance from above in this fast-paced third-person helicopter shooter where you’re on a mission to rescue the hostage from hordes of zombies, gangsters, henchmen, and enemy combatants. Keep your eyes peeled and your wits about you, and don’t stop shooting till she leaps to safety in this easy-to-play all-action game where only the fastest and the deadliest survive. Hyper-brutal, hyper-entertaining helicopter mayhem that will keep you coming back for more time after time.
► RESCUE ME!
• Help the hostage escape by gunning down the endless stream of pursuers behind her. Use explosives and other in-game objects to take out multiple enemies or rely on fancy shooting to eliminate as many bad guys as you can. Hurl down destruction on the enemy, but just make sure you don’t hit the hostage by mistake.
• When the going gets tough, the tough go slow-mo. When zombies are breathing down the neck of the hapless hostage at critical moments in the game, time slows down to help you cope. Take your time, smash your enemies, and rescue the hostage!
•Varied and exciting gameplay action: levels alternate between rooftop zombie pursuits and building attacks with multiple armed enemies attempting to take you down. Only the sharpest shooters will survive, so watch your angles and get blasting to destroy floor after floor of bad guys.
• There’s a whole exciting range of enemies to destroy, and some of them even shoot back, so shield up before your start to make sure you can survive and save the hostage.
• Complete levels to upgrade your guns, outfit, and helicopter, and advance through the districts of the city to reach awesome boss levels with extra rewards. Try out pistols, shotguns, assault rifles, SMGs, and even rocket launchers to find the gun that helps you put an end to most zombies.
• Extra-special crazy levels offer a riotous alternative to regular gameplay, with guns that shoot cats, sheep, paint, and a whole heap of other weird and wonderful options to brighten up your play.
• Cool graphics, exotic settings, a tension-building soundtrack, and stylish camera angles give the game an exciting, cinematic feel. Keep the enemy hordes at bay and watch the hostage leap to the safety of your helicopter in beautifully satisfying slow motion.
► WHIRLING BLADES AND BLAZING GUNS
Looking for fast and casual shooting fun? Helicopter Escape 3D combines the best of exciting action gameplay and easy accessibility. Got five minutes for shooting? How about destroying some zombies and rescuing a damsel in distress? 
Download Helicopter Escape 3D now and revel in endlessly entertaining 3D shooter pandemonium that’s guaranteed to dispel boredom and brighten up your day!

Tileverse Matching - Your relaxing puzzle journey starts here!
Welcome to Tileverse Matching, the ultimate tile puzzle game designed to refresh your mind and soothe your senses. With thousands of uniquely crafted levels, this matching game brings a perfect blend of calm, challenge, and satisfaction.
===== Why you’ll love Tileverse Matching =====
* Classic match-3 tile puzzle mechanics with a calming twist
* Thousands of handcrafted levels for endless focus and relaxation
* Brain-teasing puzzles that stimulate your mind without pressure
* Beautiful animations, smooth haptics, and zen-like audio
* Visually rich and vibrant tiles that enhance hand-eye coordination
* User-friendly interface optimized for smooth mobile performance
* Suitable for all ages, no timers, no stress, just satisfying gameplay
===== How to play =====
* Match 3 identical tiles to clear them from the board
* Use logic and memory to solve each level efficiently
* Trigger smooth combos for a more satisfying gameplay experience
* Advance through levels to unlock new visual themes and challenges
===== Feel the benefits =====
* Train your brain through focused, pattern-based play
* Relieve daily stress with soothing visuals, sounds, and gentle feedback
* Enjoy a relaxing, immersive experience that boosts mindfulness and clarity
* Strengthen your focus and coordination in a calm, distraction-free space
===== Designed for peaceful play =====
* High-quality graphics and fluid animations create a premium look and feel
* Smooth touch controls and responsive UI tailored for mobile
* A stress-relieving casual puzzle game perfect for winding down anytime
===== Why choose Tileverse Matching =====
* Uniquely crafted levels that combine logic, calmness, and satisfaction

bluejetty:00186633:ios.description:
If you were seduced by sudoku, prepare for futoshiki fever - The Guardian
Futoshiki may look straightforward, but the experienced puzzler knows not to be fooled by appearances.
------------------------------
A simple and challenging puzzle game that will enhance your mental flexibility! With beautiful graphics and killer features, Futoshiki Free is the best brain-teaser puzzle for iPhones and iPads. 
DUAL KEYPAD ENTRY 
Two separate keypads, one for entries and one for notes, allow you to enter values quickly and easily. No more tedious switching between entry mode and note mode to complete your puzzle.
MULTIPLE PUZZLE SIZES AND DIFFICULTY LEVELS
Six puzzle size, from 4x4 to 9x9, Four difficulty levels, from easy to extreme, ensure that you will be able to find a puzzle that matches your skill level. Top class puzzles with selectable level of difficulty. With 6,000 total puzzles, you won't run out of puzzles any time soon.
ONLINE LEADERBOARDS
Thanks to Game Center, you can now rank and compare futoshiki scores against friends and other puzzle lovers.
ERROR CHECKING
The error checker tells you when you have entered an illogical value, allowing you to catch errors early and preventing needless frustration. 
GAME FEATURES
- Thousands of puzzles in 4 different difficulty settings.
- Six different puzzle size, from 4x4 to 9x9.
- Game Center support for leaderboards.
- Great statistics that help track your progress.
TECHNICAL FEATURES
- Futoshiki is a universal app, it works on iPhones, iPods and iPads seamlessly.
- Futoshiki has graphics for Normal, Retina and even Retina-HD displays. No blurry graphics. Everything is crystal clear. Download now to see it with your own eyes.
WHAT IS FUTOSHIKI
- Futoshiki is a grid puzzle similar to Sudoku in that each column and row must contain exactly one instance of each number.
- The only difference being that in between some squares there are less-than and greater-than symbols that act as clues.
- At the beginning only some squares are revealed, the player must discover the rest.
- Each puzzle has an unique solution and no guessing is required to discover it.
- It is very popular in Japan, England, China and several other countries.
Download Futoshiki for Free!

If you were seduced by sudoku, prepare for futoshiki fever - The Guardian

Futoshiki may look straightforward, but the experienced puzzler knows not to be fooled by appearances.

------------------------------

A simple and challenging puzzle game that will enhance your mental flexibility! With beautiful graphics and killer features, Futoshiki Free is the best brain-teaser puzzle for iPhones and iPads. 

DUAL KEYPAD ENTRY 

Two separate keypads, one for entries and one for notes, allow you to enter values quickly and easily. No more tedious switching between entry mode and note mode to complete your puzzle.

MULTIPLE PUZZLE SIZES AND DIFFICULTY LEVELS

Six puzzle size, from 4x4 to 9x9, Four difficulty levels, from easy to extreme, ensure that you will be able to find a puzzle that matches your skill level. Top class puzzles with selectable level of difficulty. With 6,000 total puzzles, you won't run out of puzzles any time soon.

ONLINE LEADERBOARDS

Thanks to Game Center, you can now rank and compare futoshiki scores against friends and other puzzle lovers.

ERROR CHECKING

The error checker tells you when you have entered an illogical value, allowing you to catch errors early and preventing needless frustration. 

GAME FEATURES

- Thousands of puzzles in 4 different difficulty settings.
- Six different puzzle size, from 4x4 to 9x9.
- Game Center support for leaderboards.
- Great statistics that help track your progress.

TECHNICAL FEATURES
- Futoshiki is a universal app, it works on iPhones, iPods and iPads seamlessly.
- Futoshiki has graphics for Normal, Retina and even Retina-HD displays. No blurry graphics. Everything is crystal clear. Download now to see it with your own eyes.

WHAT IS FUTOSHIKI
- Futoshiki is a grid puzzle similar to Sudoku in that each column and row must contain exactly one instance of each number.
- The only difference being that in between some squares there are less-than and greater-than symbols that act as clues.
- At the beginning only some squares are revealed, the player must discover the rest.
- Each puzzle has an unique solution and no guessing is required to discover it.
- It is very popular in Japan, England, China and several other countries.


Download Futoshiki for Free!

bluejetty:00130815:ios.description:
AiMOR App — The Smart Hub for Every Family
AiMOR App is your all-in-one smart home companion, designed to work seamlessly with AiMOR smart calendar displays, digital photo frames, and lyric speakers — making family life more connected, organized, and enjoyable.
Key Features:
Smart Digital Calendar
● All-in-one family time management tool that combines schedule syncing, photo sharing, meal planning, household task tracking, and AI-assisted importing.Syncs with Google, Outlook,iCloud, Cozi, and other popular calendar platforms
●Share schedules across all family members and devices
●Flexible reminders through voice, screen notifications, or light effects
 Smart Digital Photo Frame
 Share your favorite memories in an instant.
 Simply enter the pairing code shown on the frame to send photos directly from your phone to any connected frame — no matter where your loved ones are.
 Smart Lyric Speaker
● An AI-powered speaker that brings music to life.Displays lyrics in real time
●Ambient lights change with rhythm or can be customized
●Doubles as a digital clock or photo frame
●Includes soothing white noise and ambient scene modes for relaxation
AiMOR connects your moments, enhances your routines, and brings warmth to your smart home life.

bluejetty:00016664:ios.name: Lifeline: Bloodline
bluejetty:00016664:ios.summary: The original Lifeline took the App Store by storm, reaching #1 Top Paid Game on iPhone and Apple Watch in 55 countries. Its compelling mix of real-time storytelling and Dave Justus’s suspenseful writing continues to capture the imaginations
bluejetty:00016664:ios.description:
The original Lifeline took the App Store by storm, reaching #1 Top Paid Game on iPhone and Apple Watch in 55 countries. Its compelling mix of real-time storytelling and Dave Justus’s suspenseful writing continues to capture the imaginations of countless players worldwide. 
Lifeline: Bloodline raises the bar with a new story almost twice as long as the original, with many more choices and paths to explore.
The second story in the Lifeline series connects you with Arika, a young woman on a deadly quest to avenge her parents and rescue her long-lost brother. Your choices will keep her alive and help her succeed as she faces mortal danger on her way to a final, fateful showdown against the forces that threaten all of humanity.
Lifeline stories play out in real time. As Arika travels to complete her quest, notifications deliver new messages throughout your day. Keep up as they come in, or catch up later when you’re free. You can even respond to Arika directly from your Apple Watch or your iPhone lock screen, without launching into the app on your phone.
After completing any story branch, you can rewind to earlier parts of the story, or speed through parts you’ve already read. See what happens when you make a different choice: will you guide Arika virtuously, or cut corners to gain an edge? Seemingly simple actions can deeply affect the outcome. 
Arika’s story, and the fate of the world, depend on your judgment. You will face the consequences together, because Arika is relying on YOU. 
Lifeline: Bloodline features no in-app purchases and no ads. An Internet connection is not required.
Praise for the original Lifeline:
“[A] surprising iPhone and Apple Watch bestseller is pushing the boundaries of fiction” - boingboing.net
“This is the best game on the Apple Watch” - Time.com
“I’ve played many games that I find engrossing, but Lifeline may be one of the first that changed the way I thought about my daily routine, which leapt off the screen and became a part of my lived experience.” - Eli Cymet, Gamezebo
“For a few brief hours I cared – really cared – about the fate of a completely fictional character. I don’t think any other game I’ve played has made me feel that way before.” - Matt Thrower, PocketGamer
Lifeline: Bloodline was created by:
Dave Justus
Matthew Sturges
Colin Liotta
Dan Selleck
Mars Jokela
Benjamin Ellebracht
Original music composed by Norman Fairbanks.

bluejetty:00092105:ios.summary: Calm any worries after a hard day with sacred Hindu stories in the Nidrana app. Play dozens of beautifully narrated stories from Hinduism’s rich mythology to enjoy spiritual reflection. Add background sound effects such as piano or rain to
bluejetty:00092105:ios.description:
Calm any worries after a hard day with sacred Hindu stories in the Nidrana app. Play dozens of beautifully narrated stories from Hinduism’s rich mythology to enjoy spiritual reflection. Add background sound effects such as piano or rain to fully immerse yourself in a story, grasp the divine wisdom, and relax for a good night’s sleep. 
- 20+ narrated stories from Hindu scriptures
- Sorted by faith, love, peace, and more 
- Selected library of bedtime Hindu stories for kids
- Short Hindu stories 7 to 10 minutes long 
- 5 background sounds for more immersive experiences 
- Minimized mode and high-quality audio 
- Adaptive light and dark mode available
Rediscover peace and inner balance 
Find your perfect escape no matter how tiring your day. Turn to Hindu scriptures to find guidance. Listen to ancient stories from the Vedas, Ramayana, Mahabharata, Puranas, and other sacred texts of Hinduism in the Nidrana app. 
Relax and learn moral lessons 
Nidrana helps you strengthen your faith with uplifting Hindu narrations, each of which carries deep wisdom and values. Both children and adults can find them insightful and connect with their timeless narratives. 
Easily unwind before bedtime 
Drift into a goodnight rest with calming bedtime stories designed to ease your mind and calm anxiety. Add some natural background sounds to enjoy soothing moments of relaxation, find comfort, and end your day in peace.
Premium features
You will need a paid subscription to fully access and experience the narrated content with playback and soothing background sounds.
PAYMENT AND SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
Choose between the below to access the best Nidrana features:
• Monthly Subscription
• Annual Subscription
Your subscription will automatically renew at the same price unless you cancel. You can turn the auto-renewal off at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period. You can also cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple account settings.
Support: support@nidrana.app
Terms of Use: https://nidrana.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://nidrana.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00146716:ios.description:
Superheroes Mod for Minecraft is the ultimate companion app for Minecraft players who love superheroes. With this app, you can explore a wide range of superhero mods, each designed to bring your favorite heroes into the Minecraft world. Whether you want to wield powerful abilities, wear iconic superhero suits, or experience thrilling new gameplay mechanics, this app makes it easy to enhance your Minecraft adventure. 
### Features: 
- Extensive Collection of Superhero Mods – Browse through a carefully curated list of superhero mods, each featuring unique abilities, costumes, and enhancements to make your Minecraft experience more exciting. 
- High-Quality Images for Reference – Each mod comes with high-quality preview images, allowing you to see exactly what you are downloading before adding it to your game. 
- Easy Download Process – Simply choose the superhero mod you like, download it directly through the app, and integrate it into your Minecraft game. 
- Regular Updates – Stay up to date with the latest superhero mods as new content is added regularly to keep your Minecraft experience fresh and engaging. 
This app is designed to provide a seamless and user-friendly experience for Minecraft players who want to bring superheroes into their gameplay. Whether you prefer classic comic book heroes, movie characters, or custom superhero designs, you will find a variety of mods to choose from. 
How It Works: 
1. Open the app and explore the list of available superhero mods. 
2. Browse through the images and details to find the perfect mod for your game. 
3. Download the mod with a single tap and follow the simple instructions to integrate it into Minecraft. 
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy your superhero adventure. 
This app is perfect for players who want to expand their Minecraft experience with exciting superhero-themed content. Whether you enjoy battling villains, exploring the world with enhanced powers, or simply dressing your character in legendary superhero suits, this app provides everything you need to make it happen. 
Download Superheroes Mod for Minecraft now and start your superhero journey in Minecraft today.

bluejetty:00146332:ios.description:
Future Fortune: Build Your Path to Prosperity!
Embark on an epic journey from survival to unmatched prosperity in Future Fortune—the ultimate incremental/idle game experience! Begin with the basics in the Survival industry, where fire and gathering are your humble beginnings. As you master the art of survival, you'll unlock new industries like Property, Assets, Science, and Tech, each offering unique challenges and rewards.
Grow and manage five distinct industries, each with its own set of resources and time-based production cycles that fuel the growth of other resources and generate industry-specific currency. Watch your empire expand as you upgrade resources, innovate to rank up, and prestige industries for massive boosts. Automation features allow your industries to thrive even while you're away, ensuring your progress never stops!
Collect and upgrade powerful cards to boost your production and unlock game-changing abilities. Complete daily and weekly quests, achieve milestones, and earn exclusive rewards through the Season Pass. Are you ready to rise through the ranks and ascend for even more powerful upgrades? In Future Fortune, fortune truly favors the bold!
Key Features:
-Multi-Layered Progression: Upgrade, prestige, innovate, and ascend across five unique industries.
-Card System: Collect and upgrade cards for powerful boosts and abilities.
-Automation: Unlock and upgrade automation features to enhance your gameplay.
-Milestones & Quests: Achieve milestones and complete quests for valuable rewards.
-Season Pass: Earn exclusive rewards through daily and weekly quests.
Your journey to endless wealth begins now in Future Fortune!

bluejetty:00066176:ios.description:
Omega Vanitas is a free post-apocalyptic open world online MMORPG game.
Isometric pixel graphic brings back the old spirit of the classic top-view games.
This old school 2D game with retro graphic and open world is inspired by some of the best role-playing games from the past decades.
* Wander and scavenge the vast post apocalyptic world.
* Fight against enemy gangs and mutated monsters.
* Make new friends and work together on your survival.
* Customize your character with many different skills.
* Gain experience and levels, solve addictive quests and improve your character attributes to stay alive in that survival game.
* Enhance your hero with hundreds of different items which you can find searching the massive world, crafting from garbage or trading with other players.
* Get pet or hire companion to help you survive in world covered in radioactive fallout.
* Challenge other players to real-time PvP duels.
* Join or create a faction to dominate the others.
* Build new structures to strengthen your faction’s domination.
The game offers many hours of classic online RPG gameplay including exciting quests and tons of different maps, enemies, items and dungeons.

bluejetty:00024642:ios.description:
Bilgi, eğlence ve rekabet bir arada! Üstelik reklamsız ve ücretsiz!
Türkiye’nin en eğlenceli bilgi yarışması ile bilgini test edebilir, ailenle, arkadaşlarınla ve rakiplerle yarışmanın keyfini sürebilirsin. Güncel ve kaliteli binlerce soru ile rakiplerine meydan oku, karakterini en güzel jokerlerle taçlandır ve liderlik sıralamasında yerini al!
Genel kültür, spor, bilim, tarih, coğrafya, sanat ve sinema gibi pek çok kategoriden oluşan zengin soru havuzu ile eğlenirken öğrenmenin en eğlenceli halini keşfedeceksin.
Jokerler, günlük ödüller, can ve altınlar! Canın tükendiğinde topladığın günlük ödüller ve altınlarla zorlandığın soruları “çift cevap jokeri”, “soruyu atlama” ve “yarı yarıya” haklarınla kolayca geçebilirsin. Sorulara doğru cevap verdikçe kazanacağın unvanlar ile bilgi seviyeni rakiplerine gösterebilir, elde edeceğin rozetlerle karakterini özelleştirebilirsin. 
Kısa süreli açılan ve her gün yenilenen dinamik “Etkinlikler” ile birbirinden farklı alanlarda bilgini test edebilir ve özel rozetlerin sahibi olabilirsin. 
Yabancı dil öğrenmek istiyorsan tam yerindesin! İngilizce, Arapça, Almanca, İspanyolca ve Fransızca kategorileriyle yeni kelimeler öğrenebilir, yabancı dil bilgini test edebilirsin.
Bil Bakalım; matematik, fen bilimleri, genel kültür, Türkçe dil bilgisi, dört işlem, edebiyat ve çok daha fazla kategori ile TYT, TEOG, KPSS gibi sınavlara hazırlanırken sana çok yardımcı olacak.
TRT Bil Bakalım Neden Faydalı?
Güncel ve kaliteli içeriklerden oluşan soru havuzu.
Aile, arkadaşlar ve farklı rakiplerle yarışma.
Kazanabileceğin birbirinden özel unvan ve rozetler.
Her kategoriye özel sıralama ve liderlik tablosu.
Kişiye özel altın, gümüş ve bronz çerçeve ve avatarlar.

bluejetty:00153456:ios.description:
Deepen your daily walk with God. Let His Word be the lamp unto your feet. Whether you seek a moment of peace with a Daily Verse, want to grow through Scripture Trivia, or surround yourself with Jesus Wallpapers, we are here to support your spiritual journey.
Join thousands of Christians transforming their screen time into scripture time. Our app is free to download and offers optional premium subscriptions to unlock full access to all features.
TOP FEATURES:
AESTHETIC BIBLE VERSE WIDGET
Customize your iPhone with the most beautiful collection of widgets.

• Categories: Select widgets for Anxiety, Faith, Love, or Daily Affirmations.

Make your walk with God consistent and fun.

• Streaks & Tracking: Build a lasting habit of devotion. Track your daily progress.
DEEP BIBLE STUDY & KJV SUPPORT
Go deeper into the Holy Bible with comprehensive tools.
• Multi-Version Support: Read the classic King James Version (KJV) and other translations.
• Memorization Tools: Use word games and practice tools to memorize key verses effortlessly.
• Personal Notes: Highlight, bookmark, and journal your thoughts alongside the scripture.
DAILY DEVOTIONAL & MENTAL HEALTH

• Unlimited Access to All Home & Lock Screen Widgets

• Ad-Free Experience & Offline Mode
• Advanced Note-Taking & Reflection Tools
TUTORIAL: HOW TO ADD A BIBLE WIDGET ON IPHONE

2. Tap the (+): Click the plus button in the top-left corner.
3. Search & Add: Type "Bible Widget" (or our app name), select your preferred size, and tap "Add Widget.”
Download now and let the Holy Bible guide your every step!

bluejetty:00017613:ios.description:
The Bank of Lake Mills App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Bank of Lake Mills customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Bank of Lake Mills App, you must be enrolled as a Bank of Lake Mills Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00069222:ios.name: Trax Scrobbler
bluejetty:00069222:ios.summary:
Trax is a Last.fm app to scrobble your local listens, browse and manage your Last.fm Library. Works offline and online.
Trax is connected in real time with Last.fm but you can use it independently from your Last.fm profile: your scrobbles
bluejetty:00069222:ios.description:
Trax is a Last.fm app to scrobble your local listens, browse and manage your Last.fm Library. Works offline and online.
Trax is connected in real time with Last.fm but you can use it independently from your Last.fm profile: your scrobbles are downloaded and saved in your device and all stats are generated by the app from your local Library.
iCLOUD SUPPORT
Last.fm doesn't allow to edit or delete your scrobbles to third party apps, so actions like Edit or Delete scrobbles, albums or artists are uploaded to your iCloud account (if available) and are always available, even if you remove and reinstall the app.
SILENT LOCAL SCROBBLING
+ Your local and remote listens are added periodically in background to your Library even with the app is in background.
RECENT ITEMS AND CHARTS
 + Trax Scrobbler displays your recent listens and your charts by track, artist, or album.
CHARTS BY TIME SPENT LISTENING OR PLAYCOUNT
+ You can choose how to display your charts, by Playcount or Playtime.
SEARCH
+ It has a powerful search section to find any item you scrobbled in the past.
STATS
+ All your listening stats are avaible for every item in your scrobbled Library.
SHARE
+ You can share your recent or your charted listens by track, album or artist in custom tiled images.
Also, you can:
- Edit your Scrobbles (name, album, artist).
- Merge similar tracks, albums or artist. For instance, you can combine two versions of a track (for example, the "usual" one and the remastered version).
- Delete/Bulk Delete Scrobbles, Albums or Artists.
...And it's dark mode compatible.
Enjoy!

bluejetty:00131452:ios.summary: At DuckDuckGo, we believe the best way to protect your personal information from hackers, scammers, and privacy-invasive companies is to stop it from being collected at all. That's why millions of people choose DuckDuckGo over Chrome and ot
bluejetty:00131452:ios.description:
At DuckDuckGo, we believe the best way to protect your personal information from hackers, scammers, and privacy-invasive companies is to stop it from being collected at all. That's why millions of people choose DuckDuckGo over Chrome and other browsers to search and browse online. Our built-in search engine is like Google but never tracks your searches. Our browser blocks YouTube ads, invasive web ads, and cookie pop-ups, reducing distractions and helping to stop other companies from collecting your data. While our optional integrated AI features, Search Assist and Duck.ai, are private and never use your data to train AI. Oh, and our browser is free. We make money from privacy-respecting search ads, not by exploiting your data. Take back control of your personal information with the browser designed for data protection, not data collection. 
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS 
Protect Your Searches by Default: DuckDuckGo Search comes built-in, so you can easily search online without being tracked.  
Shield Your Browsing History: Our 3rd-Party Tracker Loading Protection blocks most trackers before they load, greatly exceeding what most popular browsers offer by default.  
Chat Privately With AI: Duck.ai lets you have private conversations with 3rd-party AI models, anonymized by us and never used to train AI. 
Secure Your Email (Optional): Use Email Protection to block most email trackers and hide your existing email address with @duck.com addresses.   
Block Ads: Our browser blocks YouTube Ads, and stops invasive trackers from loading on sites, effectively eliminating targeted ads.
Automatically Enforce Encryption: Shield your data from network and Wi-Fi snoopers by forcing many sites to use an HTTPS connection.  
Escape Fingerprinting: Make it harder for companies to create a unique identifier for you by blocking attempts to combine info about your browser and device.  
Sync and Back Up Securely (Optional): Sync encrypted bookmarks and passwords across your devices. 
Clear your tabs and browsing data in a flash with the Fire Button. 
Banish cookie pop-ups and automatically set your preferences to minimize cookies and maximize privacy. 
And many more protections not available on most browsers, even in private browsing mode, including protection from link tracking, Global Privacy Control (GPC), and more. 
DUCKDUCKGO SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribers get
• Our VPN: Secure your connection on up to 5 devices.     
• Access to advanced AI Models in Duck.ai: Chat privately with AI models built for complex tasks. 
• Personal Information Removal: Find and remove personal info from sites that store and sell it.   
• Identity Theft Restoration: If your identity is stolen, we’ll help restore it.   
DuckDuckGo Subscription Pricing & Terms   
Payment will be charged automatically to your Apple Account until you cancel, which you can do in app settings. You have the option to provide an email address to activate your subscription on other devices, and we will only use that email address to verify your subscription. For terms of service and privacy policy, visit https://duckduckgo.com/pro/privacy-terms 
Read more about our free Tracking Protections at https://help.duckduckgo.com/privacy/web-tracking-protections 
Privacy Policy: https://duckduckgo.com/privacy/  
Terms of Service: https://duckduckgo.com/terms 
Note about 3rd-Party Tracker Protection and Search Ads: while there are some limitations following search ad clicks, viewing ads on DuckDuckGo search is anonymous. Learn more here https://help.duckduckgo.com/privacy/web-tracking-protections 
Privacy. Simplified. ™

“The most addictive and challenging word game so far!”, AppEggs.
“Wordz is definitely fun and is colorfully presented.”, Appyzilla.
“This one is perfect for long car rides and even just sitting on the couch relaxing on a Saturday afternoon when it’s raining outside!”, Monsterfreeapps.
Features:
* Online Multiplayer Gaming 
* 3 Different Challenge Mode
* Leveling System
* Detailed Gaming Statistics

* Pass'n Play Game Mode
