Are you confident with your English skills? 
Prepare to be challenged with our addictive game - WORDZ!
Game play is simple: Just drag your finger over the letters on the board and connect them to create words. Find as many of the words as possible in the given time. The person with the highest score wins. Bragging rights belong to all who end up on the best players score board.
This is not your typical laid-back word puzzle game. The game board is never the same, so each game is a different and unique challenge. Wordz will require your reaction time as well as your wits in order to succeed against the clock and your online opponents. 
You can choose to play alone in order to hone your skills, then go online and compete against people from all over the world. All this for free!

bluejetty:00098819:ios.description:
This app is an unofficial informational tool for finding BBC Original Release dates, quickly and easily. You can not watch or stream shows or movies in this app, this app is an informational tool. 
Quickly find all scheduled BBC Original release dates, then get notified about changes and updates to the show or movie, including notifications about your favourite actors.
With Originals you can be the first person to know about a new season announcement and release date!
Set reminders for your favorite series release dates.
- Notifications about new seasons and episodes, and production changes,
- Follow actors and get notified about new shows and movies they are in,
- Smart Subscriptions to help you save on streaming services,
- Track your shows/movies watched,
- Track watched progress,
- Follow actors and get updated on changes,
- Filter by Series, Movies or Documentaries,
- Notifications for new seasons, or part seasons,
- Notification when show is released,
- List of favourite shows, movies,
- Browse and Search for Original Shows/Movies,
- Browse by popular, rating, date, show or movie,
- Watch Trailers,
- Filter upcoming by date, title, media type,
- Filter by Release date,
Originals is funded by ads, if you choose to purchase Originals Pro to hide these ads, unlock Smart Subscriptions, Premium notifications, and unlimited favorites and follows, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
Purchasing Originals Pro will not allow you to stream or watch any content, shows, or movies.

bluejetty:00172497:ios.description:
Learn Korean has never been this easy!
HeyKorea is the all-in-one app to learn Korean for beginners to advanced learners! If you are looking for an effective way to learn Korean, improve your Korean speaking naturally, and master Korean vocabulary by topic, HeyKorea is your ideal learning solution.
3 reasons to learn Korean with HeyKorea:
- A structured learning path: Hangeul alphabet, communication, Korean vocabulary, grammar, and real-life topics
- Speak confidently with AI-powered HeySpeak for Korean speaking practice
- Fully develop 4 essential skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing – aim for TOPIK level 4
Spend just 20 minutes a day to cover everything you need: Korean vocabulary, grammar, communication, and writing. Stick with it for 3 months and watch your Korean improve dramatically.
Start by mastering 1,000+ Korean words
- Topic-based Korean vocabulary designed to help you memorize faster and easier
- Boost your learning with flashcards and illustrated images
- Learn grammar alongside vocabulary, with clear and practical examples
Practice Korean speaking with AI
- Thematic conversations based on real-life situations
- Role-play with instant feedback to refine your pronunciation
- Free conversation mode with HeyKorea AI to practice Korean speaking anytime
Prepare for your TOPIK certification
- Train with TOPIK test simulations, complete with answers and detailed explanations
- Access a bank of updated TOPIK mock tests designed just like the official exam
Personalized learning journey: Complete daily tasks, earn cute badges, and stay motivated! Every badge rewards your hard work and helps build a consistent learn Korean habit.
Korean is simple and fun when you have HeyKorea by your side!

HeyKorea is dedicated to providing the best experience to help you learn Korean. We value your feedback to make the app even better! Please share your thoughts with us at: heykorea@eupgroup.net.

bluejetty:00061662:ios.summary:

Ther
bluejetty:00061662:ios.description:
There's no more need to walk around with a shift schedule table.
This single app lets you manage both your shift work and private schedules.
SHIFTAR is committed to offering an easy-to-understand app that anybody can use with ease.
There are absolutely no complicated actions.
Using the app is intuitive for anyone, as easily as entering a schedule on a paper calendar with a pen.
■ Shift entry features
Filling in shift information, item by item, into a calendar is a big job.
Using SHIFTAR's shift entry features, you just touch the buttons labeled with early shift, late shift, day shift, night shift, and other shift schedule information.
Just like that, you can fill in your calendar with shift schedule information as quickly as a whole month's shifts in just 30 seconds.
■ Salary calculation
How much will you get on your next payday?
How much salary have you earned through today?
SHIFTAR will let you know.
Knowing the amount of your next paycheck may let you increase your shifts, decrease your shifts to have fun, or determine your budget for presents.
Your running total of salary through the current date is updated every day.
Seeing the amount rise day by day may boost your motivation!
■ Sync iCloud Calendar
Do you have schedules entered into other calendar apps?
SHIFTAR supports iPhone's standard calendar (iCloud Calendar).
No settings at all are required to migrate data. You can get started right away.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
◇◆ SHIFTAR Premium ◆◇
■ Widgets
Our new widget allows you to quickly check your daily / weekly schedule without having to launch the app.
■ Back up important data
The app's data will be automatically backed up. You will always be able to revert to the last saved data when you encounter an issue.
No need to worry even if:
• your smartphone suddenly dies!
• your data suddenly disappears!
• you delete the app by mistake!
• you get a new smartphone.
■ Add bonus colors
You will be able to choose from a much wider variety of colors that you can set for your events. Enjoy a more colorful and convenient calendar screen with more colors for color coding.
Great for you if:
• you have many shift patterns and are running out of colors...
• you are worried that you may run out of colors in the future...
• you want to use your favorite colors
■ Remove ads
Once you remove ads, you will have more space on the screen to display more events per day, and it will be easier to tap the menu button. No more distraction on the screen means that you will be able to focus on what you are doing, and the UI of SHIFTAR will perform at its best.
＜Period＞
SHIFTAR Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. It is available for yearly periods.
It is automatically updated on a yearly basis, counting from the application date.
＜Free trial＞
You will get one free trial per iTunes account when you first use it. Your remaining trial period will expire if you cancel SHIFTAR Premium during your free trial period.
＜Automatic updates＞
SHIFTAR Premium will be automatically billed to your iTunes account within 24 hours prior to expiration. If you wish to cancel, please cancel the automatic updates in your iTunes account settings.
＜Privacy Policy＞
https://ozumah256.wixsite.com/leaderbike-policy
＜Terms of Use＞
https://ozumah256.wixsite.com/leaderbike-use
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
SHIFTAR believes in valuing the voice of every user.
SHIFTAR will work to offer ongoing updates to make the app more convenient and easier to use for all.
We look forward to your feedback. (Menu in the app > Other > Comments and requests)
# When we're tired, we get power from everyone's positive reviews

bluejetty:00040224:ios.description:
Oh my goodness! How on earth did my life take such a wild turn?!
After losing everything, I was summoned back to this little island I grew up on. It's like stepping into a world full of challenges and mysteries.
Where on earth is Dad? Why won't he answer my calls, leaving me with this run-down resort to handle? How do I even manage a resort? Cleaning, renovation, attracting guests, grocery shopping, delving into the world of gourmet cuisine... Gosh, I'm becoming a jack of all trades!
Jacob, well, he's different now, and I can sense something between us! That goofball, it's about time we take the next step! But there's this feeling that he's hiding something, Jacob, maybe there's another side to him that I don't know about...
Then out of the blue, John shows up on the island! Remember that guy? Oh, you could hardly call him a bad boyfriend, I mean, he didn't exactly cheat, but he did forget the times we had together. Being chased by wild beasts, freezing, searching for food, encountering the natives, getting poisoned, and almost leaving this beautiful world... Crazy, right? Thinking back, it's unforgettable. But hold on, what about Jacob? Who should I choose? John seems different now, should I trust him again?
But here's the real kicker, Faye's boyfriend is cheating on her! Now, that's a real scumbag move! And he's hiding the truth about Dad from me too. Should I spill the beans to Faye and get rid of him? Secrets, secrets everywhere!
The island is filled with conspiracy, danger, cutthroat competition, mysterious forces, and crippling debt. It's a mess!
All I have are these shattered photos, journals, mysterious notes, and a purchase agreement.
What should I do? Please help me out!
Game Features:
Explore the beautiful Okara Island.
Solve challenging puzzles and tasks.
Uncover hidden secrets and treasures.
Fix the resort with your friends.
Immerse yourself in a plot full of suspense and surprises.
Join our FB community for more information:https://www.facebook.com/groups/okaraescape
For any questions or assistance, feel free to email us : chuanyinggame@gmail.com.
Download Okara Escape now and dive into an unforgettable suspense-filled island adventure!

bluejetty:00115124:ios.description:
【Files Transfer】is an efficient file transfer tool dedicated to making sharing simpler and more efficient than ever before. Whether your friends are nearby or far away, you can easily achieve instant file sharing, completely saying goodbye to the troubles of data cables, email attachments, and complicated settings.
【Core Feature Highlights】
1.Ultra-Fast Face-to-Face Transfer
 * No data usage, no network required! Achieve ultra-high-speed file transfer by establishing a direct connection with nearby devices.
 * The transfer speed is a hundred times faster than Bluetooth. Sharing photos, videos, and large documents can be completed in the blink of an eye.
 * Complete privacy protection: All data is transmitted only between devices and will not be uploaded to the cloud, ensuring security and peace of mind.
2.Remote Link Generation for Sharing
 * Is the recipient not around? Generate an encrypted download link with one click, and share it with friends or colleagues far away through any means.
 * Customizable link validity period and password to ensure the security and controllability of your private files, preventing malicious downloads by others.
 * Supports files in any format—work PPTs, design drafts, video collections, etc. One link handles it all.
3.All-Round and Convenient
 * Zero-compression transfer: Original quality videos, lossless audio files, and original documents are transmitted as they are, guaranteeing quality.
 * Simple interface: An intuitive operation interface that requires no learning; you can use the app easily as soon as you open it.
Say goodbye to transfer limitations and embrace efficient sharing.【Files Transfer】redefines the way of file transfer and is an indispensable efficiency tool in your daily life.
Download now and experience the smoothness of seamless sharing!

Simple Habit is the #1 app for your wellness & sleep recommended by top mental health experts.
Try Simple Habit for free today and join over 5 million people on this life-changing journey. Sleep better and be happier in your life, marriage, parenthood, work, and health.
Our wellness & sleep therapy sessions offer guided mindfulness & meditation, daily motivation, guided sleep sessions and coaching by world-renowned experts, personalized for the way you live your life. We’ll help you feel less stressed, get better sleep and be your best self whether you have 5 minutes in the morning, 20 minutes during your commute or need to fall asleep quickly. Start your Simple Habit today and live better every day.
FEATURED ON
* Shark Tank Season Premiere 2017
* #1 in Apple’s "New Apps We Love” 2016
* #1 in Apple's "Health & Fitness - Meditation & Mindfulness" 2016
WHY SIMPLE HABIT?
MINDFULNESS AND MEDITATION
• Just 5-minutes of mindfulness and meditation per day can improve your life through stress relief and improved sleep
• New meditation guided by the world’s best experts, from mindfulness experts at Google to former monks
• Track your progress and stay motivated with Mindful Minutes
• Access meditations offline with our Premium subscription so you can meditate at any time
WELLNESS FOR YOUR BUSY LIFESTYLE
• Perfect for busy lifestyles— listen when you wake up, drive, or go to sleep
• Sessions designed for life’s daily problems
• Use Simple Habit's On-the-Go feature to quickly calm your anxiety to achieve a sense of mindfulness
HEALTH AND RELAXATION
• Sleep better
• Relieve stress
• Manage anxiety and depression
• And more
FIND MOTIVATION
• Coaching content
• Motivational talks
• Streak tracking and mindful minutes to track your progress
BENEFITS OF USING SIMPLE HABIT
• Build a meditation habit
• Get a better night’s sleep
• Motivation in your pocket
• Improve focus
• Reduce stress and anxiety
• Stay calm and relaxed
• Increased self-awareness
• Be an effective leader
• Breathe deeper and easier
• Increased sense of perspective
• Achieve mindfulness on the go
• Calm down and relax at the end of a long day
• Tackle different life challenges in a calm, focused manner
• Improve relationships
• Be happier, more relaxed, and calm
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
• Optionally integrate your meditations with Apple Health by connecting your meditations with Mindful Minutes!
• Accept the prompt to allow Simple Habit to record your mindful minutes in Apple Health, or manually turn it on in Settings.
GET UNLIMITED ACCESS WITH PREMIUM
Simple Habit offers two auto-renewing subscription options to help you achieve mindfulness and breathe easier. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased. These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

bluejetty:00179827:ios.name: The Self Compassion App
bluejetty:00179827:ios.summary: The Self-Compassion App is for you if you want to feel happier, calmer & more connected. Whether you get caught up in cycles of stress and anxiety, regularly give yourself a hard time or struggle to relax and enjoy the moment – this app can
bluejetty:00179827:ios.description:
The Self-Compassion App is for you if you want to feel happier, calmer & more connected. Whether you get caught up in cycles of stress and anxiety, regularly give yourself a hard time or struggle to relax and enjoy the moment – this app can help.
The app includes scientifically-validated practices from Compassion Focused Therapy (CFT), with 50+ tools to help you when life gets hard. Be guided by Drs Chris Irons and Elaine Beaumont – leading authorities on self-compassion, who collectively have 40+ years of experience as therapists and have helped tens of thousands of people.
This app has undergone a nationwide study, with participants showing significant reductions in stress, anxiety, self criticism, and increases in wellbeing. Anyone can develop self-compassion and enjoy all its benefits – we look forward to showing you how.
Why self-compassion?
We are often our own harshest critic, talking to ourselves in ways that we would never do our close friends. Given that we spend more time with ourselves than anyone else, isn’t it strange that many of us don’t treat ourselves with the same level of kindness, care and support as we do our close friends? Now is your time to start. 
With evidence based ideas and exercises from CFT, this app will teach you how to cultivate compassion for yourself and others. Through the course, you’ll learn how to strike a balance between self improvement & self acceptance: teaching you how to have a realistic but kind view of difficulties that arise in life, and giving you the confidence you need to achieve your goals in life, work and relationships.
A toolkit for managing the ups and downs of life.
Reduce anxiety, stress & depression
Improve mood & wellbeing
Reduce feelings of shame & low self-esteem
Better understand yourself
Increase your confidence
Improve your productivity
Appreciate the good in every day
Develop your relationships
Feel calm & grounded
Be kinder to yourself
And more...
There’s something for everyone:
Visual breathing tools to bring you back to the present
Sleep stories & meditations
HIIT and yoga videos to get you moving
Mindfulness audio guides
Cutting-edge tools to measure & improve your heart rate variability
Journaling to create habits of positivity
Step-by-step reflective exercises to help you manage difficult emotions
Surveys to measure your progress
And more!
About Chris Irons & Elaine Beaumont
Dr Chris Irons and Dr Elaine Beaumont are leading therapists and researchers in the field of CFT and compassionate mind training. They have written extensively about the topic, publishing the best seller The Compassionate Mind Workbook: A Step by Step Guide to Cultivating your Compassionate self.
Join our community
We’re so excited to see you all loving the app – we’re passionate about the benefits of self-compassion
and feel very lucky to be able to share the joys of it with others.
"I've had a problem with low self-esteem, always thinking that I'm not good enough and this app has helped me immensely." Stacey Hodkinson
"It's been really helpful and made me much more aware of my negative thought patterns ... I'm feeling more confident and more courageous." Patricia Quinn
"It's almost like 28 therapy sessions, but with tools to support you when you need." Dan Stone
We know how tricky it can be on your own to turn advice into action. That’s why we’ve created this app – to guide you into applying the best insights from CFT to your own life in daily, actionable steps so that you can create meaningful change. We know therapy isn’t an option for everyone – our mission is to create an app that is more effective than a book, and more accessible than therapy.
Terms of use
https://www.psyt.co.uk/terms-and-conditions/

Your companions will join you in battle. You can interact with them, give gifts, and learn more about their stories through exclusive storylines. Deepen your friendships and build trust through your shared adventures!

[Player Community – Share and Connect!]
Welcome to "Attack on Time"! The game features a convenient in-game chat function, making it easy for players to share experiences, discuss strategies, and connect with like-minded friends!

bluejetty:00126179:ios.name: Save2PDF for iPhone
bluejetty:00126179:ios.summary: Create professional, great looking PDFs simply and easily right on your iPhone without having to go near a computer! Save2PDF will convert most file formats into a PDF including Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Pages, Numbers, Keynote, Photos, Web
bluejetty:00126179:ios.description:
Create professional, great looking PDFs simply and easily right on your iPhone without having to go near a computer! Save2PDF will convert most file formats into a PDF including Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Pages, Numbers, Keynote, Photos, Web Pages, Contacts and many more formats.
What the Press Say:
Macworld: "Save2PDF is a superb app that provides a fairly unique function"
iAppSin: "Save2PDF is a practical app dedicated to converting and merging PDF files"
iPad.net: "It is definitely a must-have app for professionals who use their iPad for business purposes"
TouchMyApps: "There’s currently nothing like it at the App Store and iDevice users who’ve always wanted to create their own PDF files should definitely check it out." 
Save2PDF also enables easy merging of several documents into a single PDF, even if the files are completely different formats (i.e. create a single PDF by combining a document with a spreadsheet, or a Pages document with a Word file). It is also just as easy to merge multiple PDFs into a single PDF file.
One of the other powerful features of Save2PDF is the ability to select a few pages from a file (i.e. a document or PDF) and a few from one or multiple other files - creating a new PDF containing only the pages required from those files.
The PDF creation, arrangement and preview screen is intuitive and easy to use. Rearranging document order, selecting page ranges and adding further documents is all contained within one single area; there is no complicated file structure or hierarchy to learn!
Save2PDF can easily be used in conjunction with other apps like Pages, Numbers or Keynote, simply use Open in.....Save2PDF to transfer any file from another app and convert it into a PDF - all done in only 2 steps! Providing the other app supports Open in... file sharing, transferring documents into Save2PDF is easy.
FULL PDF CONVERTER
• Convert common file formats into a PDF right on your iPhone or iPod Touch without using a computer
• View/Convert/Merge Microsoft Office files, iWork files, Photos, PDFs, Contacts, Web Pages, Email attachments as well as many more file formats
• Create a single PDF from multiple files even if they are a different format (i.e. merge a Word file with a Pages document etc)
• Email and print finished PDF directly from within Save2PDF
MERGE or APPEND PDF FILES
• Merge multiple PDF files together
• Add a page to an existing PDF file (i.e. a cover letter or fax cover)
• Quickly and easily add further appendices to an existing PDF document
CREATE PDFs FROM OTHER APPS
• Import files from other apps using the Open in... file sharing to transfer into Save2PDF and convert into a PDF
• Works with any app that has the Open in file Sharing built in (i.e. Mail attachments, like Pages, Numbers or Keynote & many more)
• Transfer documents and files from a computer into Save2PDF either via iTunes or by mounting the iPhone as a disk or using the free file transfer software, WePrint
FULL CLOUD SERVICES SUPPORT
• Fully integrated with iCloud, CloudMe, Dropbox, GoogleDocs, Box.net, WebDAV 
• Convert documents & files in the cloud to PDF without downloading them first
• Move or Print documents on your iPhone/iPod Touch from your Cloud account 
FULLY FUNCTIONAL PRINTING
• Print to ALL printers (Network/WiFi/USB/Bluetooth) via your Mac or PC or direct to most WiFi printers without additional software. Also print to Apple AirPrint printers
• Print from Pages, Numbers or Keynote extremely quickly & easily without the need for an AirPrint printer using Open in
• Print from other apps using Open in
• USB & Bluetooth printers can be used with free print server software (Windows & Mac)
• Print remotely via 3G/4G/EDGE 
WEB PAGE PRINTING 
• Convert web pages to PDF documents for sharing
• Browse and print web pages to ALL printers 
• Store passwords and clear history/cache 
• Multiple tabs for splitting up browsing
QUICK HELP - if you need it

Open and print label files created in Epson’s PC software Label Editor
Easily sync and edit designs across PC and mobile devices

bluejetty:00163205:ios.description:
Your personal running coach, from 5K to ultra trail. RunMotion Coach builds a training plan made for you and adapts it every week to your fitness and your schedule.
88% of our runners reach their goal.
A TRAINING PLAN BUILT AROUND YOU
• Every goal: 5K, 10K, half marathon, marathon, trail, ultra, triathlon
• Every level: start running, get fitter, set a new PR
• Your plan takes into account your level, race times, availability and tune-up races
• Edit your current week and the next one: your plan reorganizes itself automatically
• Adapts to your injuries, vacations and menstrual cycle
VARIED WORKOUTS, PRECISE PACES
• Intervals, VO2max, threshold, long runs, hills, marathon pace, easy runs
• Paces calculated from your race times and target, using a scientific model co-published with MIT
• Race time predictions based on your latest races and workouts
• Find out your VO2max speed and Endurance Index
YOUR WATCH, YOUR COACH ON YOUR WRIST
• Send your workouts to Apple Watch, Garmin, Coros, Suunto and Polar, and follow them live
• Add your workouts to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar
• Automatically sync your activities from Apple Health, Strava, Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Coros, Wahoo, Fitbit, adidas Running, Decathlon and Huawei Health
• Track your distance, elevation, pace and training load
• Your coach analyzes every workout with AI and adjusts the rest of your plan
MORE THAN A PLAN: COMPLETE COACHING
• Choose your coach's tone: encouraging, strict or philosophical
• Tips on running technique, recovery, nutrition and well-being
• Strength training, conditioning and stretching
• Mental preparation and mindfulness
• Cross-training with cycling and swimming
• Weight loss program
PREMIUM
Try Premium for free during the trial period, then choose a monthly, quarterly or yearly subscription.
WHO WE ARE
A team of coaches and elite runners based in the French Alps.
• Guillaume Adam, certified coach and engineer, 2:23 marathoner and UTMB finisher. As co-author of a scientific paper with MIT on running performance prediction, he created the AI that builds your plan.
• Romain Adam, UTMB finisher, 2:32 marathoner.
Questions or ideas? Write to us: app@run-motion.com
SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is an auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00178946:ios.description:
Start playing Chrono Travelers today! Step into a near-futuristic open world, where the convergence of ancient celestial spirits and cutting-edge technology paints a realm of wonder and enigma. Venture forth with your companions to explore this vast realm, challenge bosses powered by futuristic tech and the essence of the stars, and uncover the hidden mysteries.
A World Without Boundaries
From bustling metropolises to ancient relics, traverse every corner of this expansive realm at will. Encounters with various celestial beings and mysterious tech may pave the way for new, exhilarating adventures.
Spirit Combat Dynamics
Harness the powers of the spirits. Each spirit boasts unique skills and attributes. Using them strategically will be your ticket to triumph in combat.
Summon the Gods
Call upon gods to boost your strength in battle. Each god brings unique powers and a cool look. They'll stand by you to overcome tough challenges.
Tailor Your Persona
In this futuristic setting, battles aren't the only allure. Personalize your character with bespoke attire and gear, showcasing your distinct style and flair.
Socialize & Conquer
Team up with players globally to challenge formidable bosses and share in the joys of exploration. In this boundless realm, camaraderie extends beyond the battlefield; forge profound bonds and cherish the deep connections you build.
As you stand atop the peaks of the world, gazing over a land where the old meets the new, its allure may captivate you indefinitely. But remember, your quest to unravel every enigma and stand united with your companions against all odds is paramount.
Forge ahead, chrono travelers, for your adventure has just begun!

bluejetty:00087652:ios.description:
World Reborn is a blended-reality story game featuring graphic novel-style visuals and irl quests. 
Protect them. Save us. 
You’re their greatest hope… ours too.
After a cataclysmic event fractures the world into many fragile realities, you've been recruited to save a reality full of lovable (and love to hate) characters from an ancient evil. But nothing and no one are what they seem, so it's up to you to find answers. 
Spend energy saving their world. Gain energy through irl training missions from irl people. The paths you'll explore both on Earth and in your assigned reality will determine where your strengths lie.
Your choices will either save or destroy their reality, so….
Play to your strengths ;) 
World Reborn is the first game ever that will reveal your real-life “character strengths” and help you use them to better your reality. Backed by behavioral science, positive psychology, and designed to boost your self-belief—this game will prove that you’re already strong. 
A journey to self-discovery and being strong AF – play a little every day to find your power. Fantasy narrative gameplay meets real-life changemakers to provide bite-sized ways to improve your wellbeing, relationships, and the world around you. 
Made for humans by humans to help humans.
#RidersRiseAgain #NoFaintHearts
---------------------------------
NOTE - As of May 11, 2025
• World Reborn is always evolving! Enjoy now and stay tuned for major updates to the game.
• In-app purchases are not currently available.
• Please report crashes, flag bugs, and submit feedback to the developers on the official World Reborn Discord: https://discord.gg/5DH3PDjRkJ
• World Reborn's visual elements are also ever-expanding! Artwork and animations are subject to change.
• World Reborn is officially supported on iPhone 8 Plus and above. Earlier iPhone devices and iPad may not be compatible.
• Support for devices is subject to change.
• Please visit https://www.wickedsaints.studio for more information.

bluejetty:00161431:ios.description:
The tasbih is a ring of beads strung on a string, used after prayer to count the Asmaul Husna (99 names of Allah), to commemorate his greatness, and to help dhikr. The name Tasbih is derived from the Arabic word sebh and is used as misbaha ( مِسْبَحَة‎), subha ( سُبْحَة‎), tasbih ( تَسْبِيح‎), tesbih or tespih in different languages. Download the Real Tasbih Counter app free for tasbihat and dhikr on the phone! 
The digital tasbih application which is designed in the form of islamic prayer beads, is very useful for daily prayer tasbihat with actual experience. The mobile tasbih counter gives warnings such as sound and vibration every time the beads are dragged, so you don’t need to constantly look at the phone screen to pray. You can also receive warnings at multiples of the target value you set with the limit feature. Even if the digital tasbih application is closed, the online tally counter value is not reset and continues from the value left before. 
The tasbih prayer beads and the application interface can be personalized with themes in different colors. Real Tasbih Counter supports night mode (dark theme) feature to save phone battery and for a more comfortable user experience in long-term use.

listings.name: Real Tasbih Counter: Misbaha
listings.description:
The tasbih is a ring of beads strung on a string, used after prayer to count the Asmaul Husna (99 names of Allah), to commemorate his greatness, and to help dhikr. The name Tasbih is derived from the Arabic word sebh and is used as misbaha ( مِسْبَحَة‎), subha ( سُبْحَة‎), tasbih ( تَسْبِيح‎), tesbih or tespih in different languages. Download the Real Tasbih Counter app free for tasbihat and dhikr on the phone! 

The digital tasbih application which is designed in the form of islamic prayer beads, is very useful for daily prayer tasbihat with actual experience. The mobile tasbih counter gives warnings such as sound and vibration every time the beads are dragged, so you don’t need to constantly look at the phone screen to pray. You can also receive warnings at multiples of the target value you set with the limit feature. Even if the digital tasbih application is closed, the online tally counter value is not reset and continues from the value left before. 

The tasbih prayer beads and the application interface can be personalized with themes in different colors. Real Tasbih Counter supports night mode (dark theme) feature to save phone battery and for a more comfortable user experience in long-term use.

bluejetty:00159289:ios.description:
Welcome to Tower Yoga, your home for community, movement, and wellness! Immerse yourself in the practice of yoga and discover a path to inner peace, flexibility, and strength with the Tower Yoga app!
Elevate Your Practice: Explore a wide range of yoga classes suitable for all levels. Whether you're seeking relaxation through Gentle Yoga, a well-though out practice in Vinyasa Yoga, or a dynamic workout with Power Yoga, Tower Yoga has a class for you.
Your Yoga Calendar: Stay in the loop with our easy-to-use class schedule. Plan your week, reserve your spot, and receive notifications so you never miss a class. Flexibility meets convenience
Achieve Your Goals: Track your progress with our in-app achievements system. You can monitor how many classes you've participated in, and celebrate your yoga journey as you grow stronger and more centered.
Exclusive Workshops: Take a deep dive into your practice with our exclusive workshops guided by our amazing teaching team. Workshops are designed to support community by connecting members with each other in a specialized setting. Jump into yogic philosophy, join us for movie night, shake your booty at ecstatic dance, and discuss current events and books through current clubs.
Expert Instructors: Meet our team of experienced yoga instructors who are here to guide you on your journey. You can learn about class and workshop instructors through their personal bios, and see who you want to take class with.
Mission: At Tower Yoga, we believe the power of community is a co-created phenomenon that brings together individuals in a safe and welcoming space. Our studio embraces the beauty of the human spectrum, fostering a friendly, loving, and accessible atmosphere for all. The practice of yoga serves as our medium of connection and is the glue strengthening these bonds. We invite you to join us at Tower Yoga, where you are welcome to participate in the fullness of our inclusive and thriving yoga community. Together, we build bridges of connection, growth, and wellbeing for everyone involved.

Turn your steps into progress, your workouts into wins, and your goals into a game. Motion is the fitness app that makes staying active fun, consistent, and motivating - no matter your starting point.
Whether you're walking to lose weight, building better habits, or just looking for a more rewarding way to track workouts, Motion helps you stay on track with weekly goals, smart tracking, and gamified fitness challenges.
Consistency is everything, so Motion have built the first motivational AI fitness friend, imagine your most enthusiastic friend, always ready to hype you up, keep you pumped, get you back on track, and super-charge your motivation, so you stay consistent for longer than ever!
# Designed for Everyone, Walkers, Beginners & Busy People
 • Personalised weekly goals that adapt to your fitness level
 • Supports all workouts: walking, running, gym, home, yoga, hiking... if you're moving, it counts!

 • Crush weekly goals, win head-to-head activity battles, and join in monthly challenges
# Why Motion Works
 • Personalised, effort-based goals = fair and fun for all fitness levels
 • Weekly goals = rest days without guilt
 • Social accountability = let your friends cheer you on and boost your success
 • Build and emotional connection to your fitness pet, and work hard to keep it happy and healthy
Start moving with Motion today—and fall in love with your fitness routine. Perfect for walking, weight loss, motivation, and making fitness fun again.

bluejetty:00028224:ios.description:
-Picture books help children develop literacy skills by pairing images with text, making it easier for them to understand and follow a narrative.
-Our unique books have pictures displayed with every paragraph, encouraging children to make connections between ideas and concepts.
- Speech recognition: the app follows the child’s reading, highlighting each word in real time.
-ReadingBuddy is a prize-winning reading app that grows with your child
-Age: 2 to 12 years
-ReadingBuddy reads children books aloud and teaches reading skills at the same time 
-ReadingBuddy includes simple rhyming books for beginning readers
-Fairy tales: The Three Little Pigs, Little Red Riding Hood, Goldilocks and the Three Bears, Cinderella, and more
-Rhymebooks for learning sizes, colors, numbers, spatial prepositions, possessive pronouns, and more
-Rhymebooks for learning animals, vegetables, fruits, and more
-Interactive books about science, cooking, birds, and more for older children
-ReadingBuddy not only reads stories aloud, but also enhances understanding with immersive sound effects. From chirping birds to musical instruments, we make learning fun and interactive.
-ReadingBuddy offers multiple illustrations of the same concept for deeper understanding and fostering abstraction skills. Learning has never been this interactive and fun.
-Special needs kids will find a variety of rhymebooks preparing them for daily activities: Bedtime Routine, Restaurant Manners, Dressing Up, Playground, and more 
TECHNICAL
-Five reading speeds: beginner to expert
-Words are highlighted in-sync with read-aloud
-Large letter size simplify reading
-Every book is brightly illustrated
-No ads
-No registration
SCIENCE
Studies have shown that ImagiRation apps can significantly accelerate children’s development of language and math skills!
See all research articles at http://imagiration.com/science/
TESTIMONIALS
“We use ImagiRation apps for developing language, math, speech, and reading skills in all of our children!”
“My kids absolutely LOVE ImagiRation!!! My kids actually look forward to reading books on the ImagiRation app!”
"Perfect. I am really pleased to see how well my special needs child is doing with this app."

bluejetty:00069964:ios.name: Cleanup: Phone Storage Cleaner
bluejetty:00069964:ios.summary:
Clean up your iPhone and optimize storage in seconds. 
Remove duplicate photos, videos, and junk emails. Cleanup helps you clear your camera roll, merge duplicate contacts, compress videos, and organize storage — all in one app.
OPTIMIZE
bluejetty:00069964:ios.description:
Clean up your iPhone and optimize storage in seconds. 
Remove duplicate photos, videos, and junk emails. Cleanup helps you clear your camera roll, merge duplicate contacts, compress videos, and organize storage — all in one app.
OPTIMIZE STORAGE – FREE UP SPACE WITH ONE TAP
Running low on space? Cleanup gives you powerful tools to take control:
- Delete duplicate photos and videos
- Remove similar screenshots and lookalike videos
- Compress large files without losing quality
- Clean up spam and promotional emails
- Delete unused contacts and tidy up your address book
- Free up storage instantly with one tap.
CLEAN YOUR GALLERY FAST - DELETE DUPLICATE PHOTOS
No more manual browsing. Cleanup makes it easy:
- Instantly detect and delete duplicate photos
- Smart grouping for similar photos, with “Best” marked
- Remove large, lookalike videos
- Identify and delete screenshots in bulk
EMAIL CLEANER - DECLUTTER YOUR INBOX
Declutter your inbox in seconds:
- Highlight and remove promo, spam, and unread emails
- Clear out junk with one tap
CONTACTS CLEANUP
Keep your contacts organized and up to date:
- Merge duplicates
- Remove incomplete or unused entries
- View and edit from one place
COMPRESS VIDEOS - SAVE SPACE, KEEP QUALITY
Save storage without deleting memories:
- Compress large files with minimal quality loss
- Select exactly which videos to compress
CHARGING ANIMATIONS
Turn charging into a personal moment with vivid, customizable animations.
SECRET SPACE – HIDE WHAT’S PERSONAL
Hide personal content in a secure, PIN-protected vault only you can access.
WIDGETS
Add instant cleanup tools to your Home and Lock Screens:
- Battery and storage widgets
- Tap to launch cleanup features quickly
REVIEW BEFORE YOU DELETE
Nothing is removed without your approval. After each cleaning session, you get a final review screen to double-check your selections.
 No accidental deletions, no surprises — you're always in control.
OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
Your data stays private:
- No internet connection needed
- No files leave your phone
- No tracking or data misuse
Your privacy is fully protected — even we can’t access your photos.
Payment & Subscription Terms:
Choose between the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
• Weekly Subscription
• Lifetime Subscription
FREE TRIAL FOR 7 DAYS - OFFERING UNLIMITED GALLERY CLEANING FOR A LIMITED TIME
***You may cancel your subscription at any time***
Cleanup’s free trial allows you unlimited access to all features for the duration of 7 days. Your account will be automatically charged for renewal, based on the annual subscription plan, within 24 hours before the end of the 7 days free trial period.
You can cancel auto-renewal at any time, given that the cancellation is at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when making a purchase of an auto-renewing subscription.
***Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone***
Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the Account Settings:
- Open the Settings app.
- Tap your name.
- Tap Subscriptions.
- Tap the subscription that you want to manage.
Privacy policy: https://cleanup.photos/privacy
Terms of use: https://cleanup.photos/terms

- Prière du matin, prière du soir et prières liturgiques guidées
- Évangile du jour et homélie commentée par des experts
- Méditation biblique quotidienne et examen de conscience
- Chapelet, rosaire, neuvaines et prières dévotionnelles
- Messe du jour, temps liturgiques et calendrier catholique
- Podcasts spirituels et enseignements de la foi chrétienne
- Musique sacrée, louange et chants liturgiques
PODCASTS CATHOLIQUES, LECTURES BIBLIQUES ET MÉDITATION AUDIO GUIDÉE
Vivez la parole de Dieu grâce à des formats audio pensés pour la méditation profonde et la prière contemplative. 
Des narrateurs de renom comme Noam Morgensztern de la Comédie-Française donnent vie aux textes bibliques, tandis que des experts spirituels comme le père Sylvain Gasser en dévoilent toute la richesse théologique.
Explorez un catalogue spirituel unique et enrichi en continu :
- Plus de 500 podcasts religieux, homélies et méditations guidées pour débutant et confirmé
- Retraites spirituelles guidées pour structurer votre routine de prière et méditation biblique
- Chants liturgiques, musique sacrée et prières chantées
- Contenus issus de la presse catholique française pour rester connecté à l'Église
- Prière guidée pour chaque temps fort : Avent, Noël, Carême, Pâques
ESSAI GRATUIT 2 SEMAINES : COMMENCEZ VOTRE ROUTINE DE PRIÈRE DÈS AUJOURD'HUI

Profitez d'une année complète de spiritualité catholique au meilleur tarif.
Quelques minutes de prière guidée et de méditation biblique quotidienne suffisent à transformer votre vie intérieure.

bluejetty:00031563:ios.name: onTime : MNR - MetroNorth Rail
bluejetty:00031563:ios.summary: onTime™ is fast and easy to use, designed with commuters in mind. With onTime, you can look up schedules anytime, anywhere without the need to carry and dig through paper schedules. Simply opening the app displays the schedules and countdow
bluejetty:00031563:ios.description:
onTime™ is fast and easy to use, designed with commuters in mind. With onTime, you can look up schedules anytime, anywhere without the need to carry and dig through paper schedules. Simply opening the app displays the schedules and countdown of the next trains. Sign up for commuter notifications to receive the latest outages, delays, and service changes. Be on time and environmentally friendly simultaneously.
MAJOR FEATURES:
- Countdown to the next train
- Track information
- Commuter Notification Service
- Automatic Schedule Updates
- Real-time updates and track information (where available)
- Online and Offline Schedules
- Paperless
- Trip duration
- Maps
SUPPORTED AGENCIES:
Metro North Rail (MNR), Long Island Rail Road (LIRR), Chicago Metra, Chicago Transit Authority (CTA), New Jersey Transit (NJ Transit), Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority (SEPTA), San Francisco Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART), Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA), Boston Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority (MBTA), Seattle Sound Transit, Utah Transportation Authority, Virginia Railway Express, Shore Line East, SunRail Central Florida, South Florida Regional Transportation Authority, Caltrain, and more will be added.
onTime is ad-supported. If you choose to purchase onTime Premium to remove ads, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
onTime Premium:
- $4.99 USD (or equivalent) per year and may vary from country to country.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Service:
http://www.mobilewareinc.com/legal/ontime_tos.html
* Note: The onTime App uses transit agencies' schedule data but is not affiliated with any of the agencies.

bluejetty:00157407:ios.description:
Are you ready for a thrilling rescue mission? In Princess Rescue: SnakeOut, you must act fast and use strategy to stop the dangerous snake before it reaches the princess!
Simple to play but challenging to master! Tap the cannons that match the snake's colors to attack and slow it down. Time your moves carefully, destroy the snake, and complete the rescue!
*How to Play:
- Tap the cannon with the same color as the approaching snake parts.
- Destroy matching sections to weaken and slow down the snake.
- Stop the snake before it reaches the princess to win the level.
*Game Features:
- Exciting & fast-paced gameplay – Every second counts in this rescue mission!
- Smooth animations & easy controls – Fun for players of all ages.
- Multiple levels with increasing difficulty – Test your skills and strategy.
- Play offline anytime, anywhere – No internet needed!
Can you save the princess in time? Download Princess Rescue: SnakeOut now and start your adventure!

bluejetty:00096895:ios.summary: Imagine you could get access to a cheat sheet that adjusts to fit your league settings AND allows you to mark off players during your draft. That’s exactly what the RotoWire Fantasy Baseball Draft Kit '26 can do for you. It’s a one-stop sho
bluejetty:00096895:ios.description:
Imagine you could get access to a cheat sheet that adjusts to fit your league settings AND allows you to mark off players during your draft. That’s exactly what the RotoWire Fantasy Baseball Draft Kit '26 can do for you. It’s a one-stop shop for everything you need to dominate during your draft. 
► THOUSANDS OF PEOPLE TRUST ROTOWIRE’S FANTASY BASEBALL COVERAGE 
RotoWire.com has been the leading source of premium fantasy sports information on the internet for over 20 years. Over the past few years, our writers have won three times as many awards as the next closest competitor. We talk fantasy sports daily on our Sirius-XM radio show and also provide fantasy news to many of the leading online sports sites. 
► ABOUT THE FANTASY BASEBALL DRAFT KIT '26
Simply enter your league's scoring and roster settings and the app creates rankings from a value-based calculation that uses RotoWire's 2026 stat projections. Here are some of the features: 
- A cheat sheet that ranks players based on projected stats for 2026 using your league's settings.
- Ability to import league settings that you exported from the 2025 version of this Fantasy Baseball Draft Kit app.
- For auctions: Projected dollar values.

bluejetty:00114889:ios.description:
Welcome to Imposter Universe — the ultimate party deception game!
Think you can outsmart your friends? In Imposter Universe, one (or more) of you is the imposter — pretending to know the secret word while everyone else tries to expose them!
Why You’ll Love It
 • Expanded to 1,000 categories — Pick your favorite theme and get words only from that world!
 • Think fast, talk smart — Give clever clues without giving away too much.
 • Perfect for any group — Great for family nights, parties, classrooms, or video calls.
 • Quick and easy setup — No cards, no prep, just tap and play.
 • Endless variety — From Marvel to Minecraft, Harry Potter to Clash Royale, Animals to Movies — every round feels fresh!
How to Play
 1. Set Up: Add your players, choose a category, number of imposters, and tap Start Game.
 2. Reveal Roles: Each player taps their name to reveal their word — except the imposter(s), who see nothing!
 3. Play the Round: Go around in a circle saying clues related to the word. The imposter’s job? Blend in without getting caught.
 4. Vote: After one or two rounds, everyone votes on who they think the imposter is. Then comes the big reveal!
Play Your Universe
Whether you’re a Disney fanatic, a gamer, a movie buff, or just love outsmarting your friends, Imposter Universe has a category for you.
Discover who’s the best at bluffing — and who cracks under pressure.
Download Imposter Universe now and start uncovering the fakes among your friends!

bluejetty:00177491:ios.name: ■ Minesweeper
bluejetty:00177491:ios.developer: ADIOS YAZILIM BILISIM SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
bluejetty:00177491:ios.summary:
Classic Minesweeper game ready for you. Standard game rules with best and easy use.
The goal of Minesweeper is to uncover all the squares on a grid that do not contain mines without being "blown up" by clicking on a square with a mine unde
bluejetty:00177491:ios.description:
Classic Minesweeper game ready for you. Standard game rules with best and easy use.
The goal of Minesweeper is to uncover all the squares on a grid that do not contain mines without being "blown up" by clicking on a square with a mine underneath. The location of the mines is discovered through a logical process (but that sometimes results in ambiguity). Clicking on the game board will reveal what is hidden underneath the chosen square or squares (a large number of blank squares [bordering 0 mines] may be revealed in one go if they are adjacent to each other). Some squares are blank while others contain numbers (from 1 to 8), with each number being the number of mines adjacent to the uncovered square.
To help the player avoid hitting a mine, the location of a suspected mine can be marked by flagging it with the flag button. The game is won once all blank or numbered squares have been uncovered by the player without hitting a mine; any remaining mines not identified by flags are automatically flagged by the computer. However, in the event that a game is lost and the player had mistakenly flagged a safe square, that square will either appear with a red X, or else a red X covering the mine (both denoting the square as safe). The game board comes in three set sizes with a predetermined number of mines: "Beginner", "Intermediate", and "Expert" option is available as well.

bluejetty:00141514:ios.description:
Create custom printable labels, stickers, tags, QR codes, and barcodes in minutes. Labelr is an easy label maker for jars, packaging, address labels, gifts, events, home organization, and small business branding.
Start with ready-made templates or design from scratch. Add text, photos, shapes, logos, QR codes, and barcodes, remove photo backgrounds, add shadows, glows and outlines, then export your design as a high-quality PDF, PNG, or JPEG for printing at home or at a print shop.
Key Features:
- Choose from beautifully designed label, sticker, and card templates — or start from scratch with full customization
- Select your layout: round, square, rectangle, or custom sizes to fit your specific needs
- Easily drag, drop, resize, and rotate shapes and elements
- Add fully customizable text — choose from various fonts, sizes, colors, and styles to make your design unique
- Import photos directly from your device’s gallery and remove backgrounds for clean product cut-outs
- Add shadows, glows, and outlines to text, shapes, and images
- Upload and add your own logo to your designs — perfect for branding and professional labels
- Generate QR codes and barcodes for product labeling, event passes, or business branding
- Export your design as a high-quality PDF or image file (JPEG, PNG), perfect for printing at home or at professional print shops
Labelr is ideal for:
- Creating custom labels for products, jars, and packaging
- Designing personalized stickers for events, gifts, or crafts
- Making tags for organizing home, office, or school items
- Printing business cards, logos, and promotional materials
- Branding and labeling for small businesses and handmade products
Get creative, customize your designs, and print with confidence — Labelr makes label and sticker creation simple and fun!

Truth Finder helps you uncover the truth faster with AI-powered scan, search, and deep search.
Wondering what’s behind a partner’s online presence, activity, or public profiles?
Truth Finder brings together publicly available information from multiple sources and organizes it into clear, structured results — all in one easy-to-use app.
Instead of manually jumping between websites, profiles, and social accounts, Truth Finder helps you see how information connects. With deep search, it’s easier to spot patterns, references, and potential inconsistencies around a partner or acquaintance.

- Scan & Search Public Information
- Search and scan publicly available data across multiple sources in one place.
- Deep Search for Better Context
Use deep search to explore connections across sources and get a clearer, more structured view of what you find.
- People, Partner & Profile Lookup
- Explore profiles, linked pages, and connected social accounts to better understand a partner’s digital footprint.
- Catch a Cheater / Bust Inconsistencies
- Review public signals and online traces that may help bust inconsistencies, reveal potential red flags, or add clarity when checking a partner.
- Relationship Expert
- Ask AI-assisted questions focused on relationships, partners, and personal concerns.
- Astro Affinity
Explore zodiac compatibility and astrological connections as an additional perspective.
Clear, Structured Results
AI organizes findings and highlights what matters most, helping you cut through noise and confusion.
What you can do with Truth Finder:
- Search and scan public information more efficiently
- Run deep search to explore profiles, partners, and social accounts in one structured view
- Identify connections, references, and signals that may help bust doubts
- Get AI-assisted insights for relationship and partner-related questions
Stay informed with updated public data

Boston is steeped in Revolutionary War era history, from the Tea Party to the Battle of Bunker Hill. Join me, as we start this narrated walking tour at the site of the original Liberty Tree, then follow the well-marked Freedom Trail.
See Boston the way it was meant to be seen: on foot. The tour includes 18 sites and is about 2.5 miles long. Rain? Take a break and resume later. It's like having your own personal guide, at a fraction of the price. Good for tourists and locals of all ages.
All Two Buck Tours include maps with GPS, directions, photos, interesting information about each site, and are narrated in English. No schedules, no crowds, no worries. 
Not visiting Boston anytime soon? The history and photos will let you experience the city from your town.

bluejetty:00123903:ios.name: Golf Solitaire Mobile
bluejetty:00123903:ios.summary: You will start with a board of 7 columns, each with 5 cards, all face up. At the bottom you will find a stack of cards and a foundation pile. The goal of the game is to clear as many boards as possible by tapping cards that are one lower or
bluejetty:00123903:ios.description:
You will start with a board of 7 columns, each with 5 cards, all face up. At the bottom you will find a stack of cards and a foundation pile. The goal of the game is to clear as many boards as possible by tapping cards that are one lower or one higher than the one in the foundation pile. You can match any uncovered card from any column.
FEATURES
- Advanced Hint option
- Unlimited Undo
- Natural animations and relaxing graphics 
- Intuitive interface
- Daily/monthly/all time highscores
TIPS
- You can match a queen with a king or jack, or you can match a 2 with an ace or a 3. The king can be matched with an ace or a queen. A jack matches with a 10 or a queen and so on.
- If there are no matches available you can tap on the stack for a new card. 
- Once you draw all the cards and no matches are available you are dealt a new set of cards. 
- You are dealt new cards only 4 times and after that the game ends. If you clear a board you receive a free deal.
- Each match earns you 10 points. The first column you clear earns you 100 points, the next column earns you 200 points and so on. The last column earns you 10000 points.
- Plan your moves in advance to achieve the best results.
If you have any technical problems, please email us directly at support@gsoftteam.com. Please, don’t leave support problems in our comments – we don’t check those regularly and it will take longer to fix any issues that you might encounter. Thank you for your understanding!

bluejetty:00086391:ios.name: Moja Gazetka: Leaflets & Deals
bluejetty:00086391:ios.summary:
Moja Gazetka brings you current promotional leaflets from practically every store in Poland, a handy shopping list, price comparison and a digital wallet for loyalty cards and bottle deposit vouchers. All in one free app.
NEW: VOUCHERS FR
bluejetty:00086391:ios.description:
Moja Gazetka brings you current promotional leaflets from practically every store in Poland, a handy shopping list, price comparison and a digital wallet for loyalty cards and bottle deposit vouchers. All in one free app.
NEW: VOUCHERS FROM BOTTLE RETURN MACHINES
Every bottle return machine prints a paper voucher that is easy to lose or leave at home. Scan it in seconds, assign it to a store and show the code at the checkout. Your deposit will never go to waste.
PROMOTIONAL LEAFLETS IN ONE PLACE
• Leaflets from supermarkets, discount stores, drugstores, DIY, electronics and home stores - updated daily.
• Current deals and upcoming ones, e.g. the leaflet valid from Thursday.
• Daily Hits: every day we pick the most interesting deals and discounts.
• Add stores to your favorites and turn on notifications - we'll let you know when a new leaflet is out.
SEARCH AND PRICE COMPARISON
• Type in a product, e.g. butter, coffee or diapers, and see deals from all leaflets at once.
• Compare prices across stores before you leave home.
SHOPPING LIST
• Add products straight from the leaflet - one tap, no retyping.
• Create separate lists for different occasions, e.g. "BBQ" or "Christmas".
• Share your list with family - changes are visible to everyone instantly.
PRODUCT RECALLS AND WARNINGS
• Public warnings from the Polish Chief Sanitary Inspectorate (GIS) and store announcements about recalled products, all in one place.
• Turn on alerts - we'll notify you whenever a new warning appears.
LOYALTY CARDS ON YOUR PHONE
• Moja Biedronka, Kaufland Card, Klub Rossmann, Auchan Skarbonka, IKEA Family, PAYBACK and many more - leave your plastic cards at home.
• Once you log in, your cards are safely stored in your account.
NEARBY STORES AND TRADING SUNDAYS
• Store map with addresses and opening hours.
• Calendar of trading Sundays in Poland - closed stores won't catch you by surprise.
RECIPES WITH PRODUCTS ON SALE
• Cook for less - every recipe comes with a ready-made shopping list.
STORES IN THE APP
Biedronka, Lidl, Dino, Kaufland, Netto, Aldi, Auchan, Carrefour, Stokrotka, POLOmarket, Intermarché, Delikatesy Centrum, Lewiatan, Żabka, Rossmann, Hebe, Super-Pharm, Pepco, Action, Dealz, Castorama, Jysk, MediaMarkt and hundreds of other chains.
Moja Gazetka - shop smart!

Can you merge everything into better and more useful items to solve thrilling puzzles? In Mystery Town, every match counts! Uncover hidden secrets and discover that here, the right merge can change everything.
Welcome to Mystery Town, where you can unlock new themed adventures every week—experience cooking delicious food, hunt for clues, catch culprits in new cases, and rebuild parts of the town you'll love.
Step into a world where your merge skills help you restore a broken town, uncover hidden truths, and perhaps even find love. Join Aurora on an exciting quest and discover the truth about her uncle's sudden disappearance.
MATCH & MERGE

bluejetty:00119159:ios.description:
Control for GitLab is the best way to manage your GitLab projects on any iPhone and iPad device, anywhere at any time!
Control for GitLab helps you to easily keep track of your GitLab projects while you are sitting on the train on your way back home, or when you are trapped inside a meeting with no chances of getting out! 
Features:
- View and add Projects
- View, add, edit and share Issues
- Issue, Milestone and Merge Requests Transition Workflow
- Search Issues by ID, title or labels
- View and add Comments
- Style any comment or description with markdown, HTML and emoji smileys
- Calendar and Address Book Integration
- Browse your Source Code
- Full Team Management (add and remove team members)
- View your Commits
- View your Commit Diffs
- View, protect and unprotect your Branches
- View your Tags
- View and add Labels
- View, add, edit and share Milestones
- View, add, edit and share Merge Requests
- View, add, edit and share Code Snippets
- View and use Favourite Filters
- View and add Groups
- View, add, edit, share SSH Keys
- View, add, edit, share Hooks
- Explore, fork and favourite public projects
- Full Core Spotlight support
- Full access the projects' Wiki
- Protect your data with a personal Passcode
- Connect to HTTP or HTTPS server
GitLab is a growing community and as their API expands so will this app!
We work extensively with the GitLab team to refine and expand the API in order to provide you the best GitLab mobile user experience ever.
You will have everything under control!
Follow the project on twitter: @gitlabcontrol
For info on new releases, to suggest new features and to report bugs send an email to support@gitlabcontrol.com.
Restrictions:
Control for GitLab currently supports GitLab server version 9.x and higher.
Disclaimer:
Control for GitLab is not affiliated, endorsed, sponsored, or approved with or by GitLab Inc.

bluejetty:00064432:ios.description:
Stay effortlessly connected wherever your travels take you with Yesim. Our eSIM solution offers perfect mobile internet and a virtual second line, providing you with seamless connectivity across the globe. Forget about roaming fees and unreliable public Wi-Fi - Yesim brings you fast, reliable, and affordable mobile data.
Why Choose Yesim?
1. Global Coverage: Yesim's coverage extends to over 200 countries and regions worldwide. From bustling cities to remote destinations, you’ll always have access to a stable network.
2. Flexible Data Plans: Choose from fixed or unlimited data plans valid for up to 30 days. Whether you're traveling for a few days or a month, Yesim has a plan that suits your needs.
3. Virtual Phone Numbers & Calls: Get a virtual phone number and make and receive international calls through Yesim. Incoming calls are delivered directly in the Yesim app, including when the app is running in the background. Choose a minutes package, track your usage, and top up when needed. Availability depends on the country, destination, and applicable local regulations. Emergency calls are not supported.
4. Cost-Effective: Enjoy data plans that are cheaper than traditional roaming charges. Yesim offers incredible value for money.
5. Unlimited Plans: Stay connected without limits. Yesim offers unlimited data plans, allowing you to enjoy seamless connectivity during your travels without worrying about running out of data.
6. Flexible Payment Options: Pay for your plan easily with a variety of payment methods. Manage your subscriptions with convenience and flexibility.
7. Universal Compatibility: Yesim is compatible with all modern mobile devices. Whether you have the latest smartphone or a tablet, our eSIM works seamlessly with your device.
8. Hassle-Free Activation: No need for physical SIM cards. Enjoy instant activation and easy installation. Simply download the Yesim app, choose your plan, and start using data immediately.
9. 24/7 Support: Our dedicated support team is available around the clock via live chat. Get help whenever you need it, ensuring a smooth and stress-free experience.
How It Works:
Check Device Compatibility: Ensure your phone supports eSIM technology. Yesim works with all modern devices capable of handling eSIM.
Download the App: Get the Yesim app from your app store.
Select Your Plan: Browse our extensive list of available destinations and choose the data plan that best fits your travel itinerary.
Install and Connect: Purchase and install your eSIM with a single tap. Connect to local networks and enjoy seamless internet access upon arrival.
Travel with Confidence
With Yesim, you can travel globally without the stress of hidden fees or connectivity issues. Our eSIM plans offer you the freedom to stay connected, manage your data, and enjoy your journey with ease. Say goodbye to physical SIM cards and hello to hassle-free digital connectivity.
Why Travelers Love Yesim
- Instant Connectivity: Get online within minutes with our digital eSIM.
- No Roaming Fees: Save on roaming charges by choosing from our affordable data plans tailored to your travel needs.
- No Physical SIM Required: Enjoy the convenience of digital activation.
- Flexible Plans: Choose from a variety of options to suit your travel needs.
- Seamless Experience: Manage your data and virtual phone number in one app.
Experience the Future of Mobile Connectivity
Embrace the convenience and efficiency of Yesim’s eSIM technology. Stay connected wherever you go and optimize your travel expenses with our global mobile network solutions.
Learn more about eSIMs and Yesim:
Yesim Website: https://yesim.app/
Join the Yesim Community!
Follow us @yesim.app on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitter, and LinkedIn.
Privacy Policy: https://yesim.app/privacy-policy/
Terms & Conditions: https://yesim.app/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00142076:ios.summary: Animal lovers, puzzle enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys hidden object games or just needs a relaxing yet engaging activity, Peek a Pet: Find the Cat is designed for you. Dive into captivating scenes and discover hidden animals in this addi
bluejetty:00142076:ios.description:
Animal lovers, puzzle enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys hidden object games or just needs a relaxing yet engaging activity, Peek a Pet: Find the Cat is designed for you. Dive into captivating scenes and discover hidden animals in this addictive seek-and-find adventure! Test your observation skills and attention to detail! with this free, fun, relaxing, brain-challenging puzzle game.
Find It Out—Spot them all 
Dive into mesmerizing black-and-white maps where adorable cats, playful dogs, or lively birds await discovery. Each level challenges you to spot pets cleverly hidden in intricate designs. Feeling stuck? Unlock powerful boosters to reveal the location of hidden animals and keep the excitement alive! With increasing challenges, charming visuals, and endless fun, this game will test your observation skills like never before. Can you complete every map?
Breathtaking Levels, Hidden Treasures
Embark on an unforgettable adventure! With Peek a Pet: Find the cat game, wander through the serene Lotus Gardens, unravel mysteries in the bustling Metropolis, and soak up the sun on Tropical Islands. Discover the magic of Fairy Tales, stroll along the romantic streets of Paris and London, and delve into the secrets of the enchanted Mushroom Plains. From the relaxing vibes of Sunny Beaches to the thrills of Fairgrounds, the eerie charm of Stinky Swamps, and the grandeur of Mansions, each level brings a new world to life in this scavenger hunt. Find out all the hidden pets. 
The cutest and coolest animals.
Get ready to find adorable Hidden Pets! From lazy and fluffy cats to royal and fierce dogs, quirky axolotls, playful frogs, and even majestic octopi! 
Dive into the ultimate scavenger hunt experience. Step into a world of mystery and discovery with Peek a Pet: Find the Cat. Developed by the creators of the fan-favorite brain-boosting, tricky puzzle games such as Brain Test and Who is? 
Download Now and join the hunt! Perfect for fans of search-and-find games! Let’s see how many hidden animals you can find.

World Clock

bluejetty:00165991:ios.description:
Clock helps you manage your time on iOS, iPadOS and macOS. Check the current time anywhere with World Clock, make sure you wake up on time with Alarms, or keep track of passing time with Stopwatch and Timers.
World Clock
Check the current time in cities around the world. Or quickly see the time difference compared to your local time to make coordinating across time zones easy.
Alarms
Set regular alarms for any time of day. Choose to set them to repeat on specific days, give them a label and select the sound that plays with each. When your alarm goes off, you can choose to play from a selection of sounds, or pick a song from your Apple Music library.
You can also adjust your wake up alarm and sleep schedule from Health right in the Clock app so you can wind down with a Sleep Focus and make sure you always wake up on time.
Stopwatch
Measure the duration of an event. You can see how much time has lapsed with either a digital or analog stopwatch face, and you can quickly record laps or splits throughout the time.
Timers
Count down seconds, minutes or hours. Or count down using multiple timers, and add labels and distinct sounds to each. You can also choose to set a timer that stops any music playing in the background—perfect for getting to sleep with your favorite playlist.

bluejetty:00149494:ios.description:
Stay connected as your child grows more independent.
The TickTalk app is the companion app for parents and approved family members using compatible TickTalk kids’ smartwatches, including TickTalk 6. Connect with your child, check their watch’s location, and manage parental controls from your phone.
STAY CONNECTED
Keep in touch through voice calling, FaceTalk video calling, and messaging. Share everyday moments and stay part of your child’s day.
CHECK THEIR LOCATION
View your child’s watch location and review location history to help coordinate pickups and everyday routines.
MANAGE CONTACTS AND SETTINGS
Manage approved contacts, configure unknown-number blocking, and adjust supported watch settings from the app.
SUPPORT EVERYDAY ROUTINES
Set reminders, manage School Mode, and view activity information to help support healthy habits and time to focus.
DISCOVER MORE WITH TICKTALK 6
Explore more ways to connect with TickTalkie and manage your child’s listening experience with TickTalk Radio™, featuring music and wellness content curated for kids.
A compatible TickTalk smartwatch is required and sold separately. Cellular features require an active wireless plan. Features and availability vary by watch model, software version, region, and subscription. TickTalk Radio requires an eligible subscription. Location availability and accuracy depend on connectivity and surrounding conditions.

bluejetty:00028194:ios.description:
Forge Your Own Destiny! Choose a character, equip your best spells, and sail from island to island in your quest for fame and fortune. Level up and improve your strategy in this cross-platform online RPG with unique and vibrant artistic direction.
SET SAIL FOR AN EPIC ADVENTURE
Only a few islands have survived the rising waters of a flooded world and you are an adventurer on a quest for solutions to this horrible disaster. Long ago, gods and dragons ruled over this world.
Today, the magic remains but what about the mythical beings of yesteryear?
TAKE PART IN TACTICAL COMBAT
Master the elements, cast powerful spells, summon mythical companions to your side, each with their own mechanics. Battle your enemies in close combat or from a distance in fast-paced, turn-based tactical fights solo or as a duo or trio to win all kinds of rewards.
UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER
Explore an open world RPG. Complete epic quests by battling fearsome monsters in their dungeons. Level up, collect valuable items to gain power, upgrade your hero, and hone your strategy.
Each battle will be more intense than the last – unleash your powers!
YOUR CHARACTER, YOUR STRATEGY
Choose your class and hero from among more than 30 possible combinations, choose from among 300 available spells, and choose the equipment and companions to bring with you to each fight.
There is enough strategic depth that you can shape your character and adventure entirely according to your preferences. Choose your allies carefully to defeat the creatures' tactics and beware of your opponents if you want to foil their plans.
PLAY WITH STYLE
Collect spells, equipment and companions through your in-game achievements and earn rewards regularly.
Show off your epic and exceptional style thanks to the various accessories and skins you can unlock.
The fate of each game depends solely on each player's talent.

bluejetty:00124086:ios.name: NFL Fantasy Football
bluejetty:00124086:ios.summary: This season, there's a new NFL team competing for a chance in the Super Bowl — yours! With NFL Fantasy, the official fantasy football game of the NFL, you're in control of your very own NFL team. Are you ready to build the next football dyn
bluejetty:00124086:ios.description:
This season, there's a new NFL team competing for a chance in the Super Bowl — yours! With NFL Fantasy, the official fantasy football game of the NFL, you're in control of your very own NFL team. Are you ready to build the next football dynasty?
Start your season by drafting a roster of real NFL players to join your team. Then, prepare for a new head-to-head matchup every week by setting your lineup and tuning in to NFL games to watch your player's action on the field turn into fantasy points for your team.
In a work league with a real hotshot? NFL Fantasy comes equipped with the tools you need to make it to the top, including NFL Fantasy-exclusive features like Next Gen Stats and all-new player comparison tools.
Looking to be the next Commissioner? Start your very own league and customize the rules however you want. Invite friends and family to compete with you and start your own football tradition.
Get closer to the game than ever before with the official fantasy football game of the NFL. Always 100% free.
There’s a lot to look forward to in 2025:
+ Our draft client makes drafting easy and fun. 
+ Track your fantasy scores while streaming the NFL Network and live local and primetime games. It's the ultimate fantasy game day experience.*
+ Fantasy Stories - See a ring around a player’s headshot? Click to watch exclusive player analysis, news, and sideline footage.
+ Use Compare Players to quickly find the best player for your roster.
+ Waiver Report - learn the outcome of all of your waiver claims.
+ A weekly Matchup Recap gives you a customized report of your and your opponent's performance.
+ Celebrate your league's history and achievements in Hall of Fame.
Plus, all of the fantasy football features you expect from the NFL:
+ Create a league in minutes to start your own fantasy football tradition, or compete against other NFL fans in a public league.
+ Draft players live in-app.
+ Perfect your draft strategy by participating in a Mock Draft.
+ The NFL Fantasy-exclusive Optimize Lineup feature makes fantasy football approachable for players of all skill levels.
+ Best in class Player Profiles include all of the data and expert analysis fans need to make informed roster decisions, including NFL Fantasy-exclusive features like Next Gen Stats and game video recaps.
+ Catch up with official stats, news, and injury updates direct from NFL experts.
+ The same great features and design on your iPhone and your iPad.
…and more!
*Geographic and device restrictions apply. Local & primetime games only. Data charges may apply.
Privacy Policy: https://www.nfl.com/help/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.nfl.com/help/terms
This app features Nielsen’s proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen’s TV Ratings. Please see http://priv-policy.imrworldwide.com/priv/mobile/us/en/optout.html for more information.
