bluejetty:00143465:ios.description:
Trainsweateat est l’app de sport, fitness, musculation, nutrition et bien-être pensée pour t’aider à atteindre tes objectifs : perte de poids, renforcement musculaire, abdos, tonification, prise de muscle, entraînement intensif et équilibre alimentaire.
Retrouve en un seul endroit : workout, training, exercices à la maison, fitness online, programme musculation, programme nutrition, séance de sport, conseils sport et nutrition, et des centaines de contenus exclusifs.
Que tu pratiques le sport à la maison, en extérieur ou en salle, l’application s’adapte à tous les niveaux. Plus de 2 millions de personnes utilisent déjà TSE pour leurs exercices de musculation, leurs programmes sportifs, leurs guides nutrition et leurs plans d’entraînement.
ENTRAÎNEMENTS EFFICACES : fitness, musculation, renforcement, abdos
Accède à des entraînements à la maison et en salle :
- musculation avec ou sans matériel
- renforcement musculaire ciblé : abdos, bras, jambes, fessiers
- exercice à la maison & exercice musculation à la salle
- carnet de musculation intégré pour suivre chaque workout
- entraînement intensif (HIIT, cardio, circuits)
- programme sport à emporter partout
Chaque workout est guidé par un coach personnel qui t’aide à progresser grâce à une approche motivationnelle et accessible.
EXERCICES À LA MAISON & APPLICATION D’ENTRAÎNEMENT
Si tu cherches une application d’entraînement à la maison ou encore une appli sport, TSE regroupe toutes les fonctionnalités dont tu as besoin :
- entraînement à la maison simple et efficace
- workouts routines & fitness routines courtes ou longues selon ton emploi du temps
- planification de tes séances
- suivi complet dans ton carnet de musculation
Idéal pour progresser en fitness, en musculation maison, en renforcement ou en mobilité.
NUTRITION : programme nutrition & recettes healthy
Pour optimiser ton training jusque dans l’assiette, TSE est l’application nutrition qu’il te faut ! Retrouve des outils complets :
- définition de tes besoins journaliers
- scan de tes plats et des codes barres
- menus équilibrés
- programme nutrition sur-mesure
- programme nutrition pour perte de poids
- programme nutrition pour prise de masse
- nutrition orientée musculation
- nutrition orientée fitness
Une vraie appli nutrition qui t’accompagne au quotidien.
ATTEINS TES OBJECTIFS : perte de poids, tonification, motivation
TSE t’aide à rester motivé grâce à :
- des programmes musculation personnalisés
- des conseils adaptés pour la perte de poids
- des outils de suivi avancés
- du contenu “sport motivation” pour garder le rythme
Ton training évolue en fonction de tes résultats.
UNE COMMUNAUTÉ FITNESS MOTIVANTE & ENTHOUSIASTE
Rejoins une communauté de passionnés qui partagent leurs workouts, leurs transformations et leurs conseils. Participe à nos challenges pour rester engagé et améliorer tes performances.
BEST FITNESS EXPERIENCE – ESSAI GRATUIT
Trainsweateat combine le meilleur du fitness, de la musculation, du sport, de la nutrition, du workout, du training et du bien-être.
Télécharge maintenant l’app officielle de Sissy Mua et commence ton programme sport, ton programme musculation, ta perte de poids ou ton entraînement à la maison.
Inscris-toi dès maintenant et bénéficie d'un essai gratuit !
Abonnements résiliable à tout moment jusqu'à 24h avant la date de renouvellement depuis le compte Apple ou depuis les réglages de ton compte sur l'Apple store.
Nos conditions générales : https://app.trainsweateat.com/terms-and-conditions

Instantly transcribe audio to text, transcribe video to text, and turn voice recordings into smart AI meeting notes. Notee is the best AI note taker for meetings, lectures, and inte
bluejetty:00095068:ios.description:
Notee: AI Note Taker — Transcribe Audio and Video to Text
Instantly transcribe audio to text, transcribe video to text, and turn voice recordings into smart AI meeting notes. Notee is the best AI note taker for meetings, lectures, and interviews — combining a powerful voice recorder with automatic speech to text conversion.
TRANSCRIBE AUDIO & VIDEO TO TEXT
- Transcribe audio to text — record voice and watch transcription appear instantly on screen.
- Transcribe video to text — upload any MP4, MP3, or audio file and get an accurate text transcript in seconds.
- Video transcriber for YouTube, interviews, and recorded meetings — paste a link or import a file to generate a full transcript automatically.
- Audio to text transcription with speaker identification — know exactly who said what in every meeting or lecture.
- Voice recording transcription — transform voice memos and recorded calls into searchable, editable text.
AI NOTE TAKER & MEETING MINUTES
- AI note taker for Zoom and Google Meet — automatically generate clean meeting notes without lifting a finger.
- Meeting minutes generator — get structured meeting summaries with key decisions and action items right after every call.
- AI meeting note taker with smart summarization — condense hours of audio into concise, shareable meeting notes.
- AI notetaker for lectures — record classes and let the AI create study guides and key concept summaries instantly.
SPEECH TO TEXT & VOICE RECORDER
- Speech to text app — accurate voice dictation converts spoken words into structured text without manual effort.
- Voice to text for iPhone — high-quality voice recorder with instant transcription in multiple languages.
- Audio transcription app — upload MP3, MP4, M4A, or WAV files for fast, accurate audio to text conversion.
- Voice memo transcription — turn quick personal recordings into readable, searchable notes in seconds.
- Free audio transcription for new users — try the AI note taker and transcription features at no cost.
WHO IS IT FOR?
BUSINESS PROFESSIONALS — Turn every call or team sync into documented meeting minutes. The AI meeting note taker captures action items so nothing falls through the cracks.
STUDENTS & EDUCATORS — Use the lecture recorder and speech to text app to convert classes into structured notes. Focus on learning while the AI note taker handles the writing.
JOURNALISTS & CONTENT CREATORS — Transcribe interviews and recorded audio to text instantly. Pull accurate quotes and build articles faster with the built-in audio transcription app.
ENTERPRISE GRADE SECURITY AND PRIVACY
Your ideas belong entirely to you. We prioritize absolute data safety. Every audio note, voice dictation, and transcribed text is processed utilizing highly secure protocols. We guarantee strict privacy standards, meaning your sensitive meeting minutes and personal voice memos are never shared with unauthorized parties. 
Information about subscription auto-renewal: 
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user. 
Auto-renewal may be turned off by navigating to iTunes Account Settings after purchase. 
After canceling a subscription, it will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled. 
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be discarded when the user purchases a subscription. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation. 
An account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan. 
Terms of Service: https://noteeapp.com/hub/legal/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://noteeapp.com/hub/legal/privacy-policy
Billing terms: https://noteeapp.com/hub/legal/subscription-terms

bluejetty:00122277:ios.description:
Breathe life into your photos with our multiple award-winning tool! VIMAGE is a cinemagraph creator app that lets you animate your image and add hundreds of moving photo effects, presets, filters, and overlays onto your photos and turn them into creative living pictures, wallpapers and save them as videos or GIFs. Share your art and get instant exposure!
WHY VIMAGE?
Cinemagraphs are the latest trend for telling engaging animation stories about your life and sharing it with friends and loved ones. VIMAGE is an amazing tool to put creative, eye-catching overlays with blur, brightness, contrast on your pictures, slideshows and visual marketing content. Create moving photos and live pictures with ease, while having fun. Whether you are a photographer or just a casual storyteller taking pictures in nature, VIMAGE will up your photography skills in no time.
ANIMATE
Harness the power of our sky replacement tool! Selecting, animating and changing skies was never this easy. Let the AI handle the hard work of selecting the sky, all you have to do is choose from the 100 presets which sky fits your image best! Make it move with our presets and animations and create a living wallpaper!
FEATURES
- New AI-Sky feature: Sky replacement! Select, change, animate skies in seconds. 
- Use the Stretch animator to bring life to your pictures! Create the effect of a moving background. Start with the area you want to animate, decide on the direction and intensity and you are done!
- Add custom sounds to your creations. Nature sound effects or music? It's up to you what you include in your live image!
- Tell your story with the text tool. Add custom texts to your motion photo
- Add up to 10* different fully customizable effects, filters or photo overlays onto a single picture
- Feel free to rotate your image or edit the color, hue, brightness, and contrast of every graphic element to blend it in your original photo and create more realistic cinemagraph after effects
- Choose a picture from the built in stock photo library or choose one of your own and create an animated picture
Looking for the perfect tool to animate photos effortlessly? VIMAGE empowers creators to transform still images into dynamic visuals using a powerful motion app interface. This all-in-one animated photo maker is designed for those who want to create eye-catching content quickly and easily. Whether you're a hobbyist or a professional, you’ll love how easy it is to animate photos with precision and style. VIMAGE is not just another motion app—it’s a fully-featured animated photo maker that brings your creative ideas to life. Start exploring new ways to animate photos, experiment with effects, and share your vision through a stunning motion app experience crafted for the modern creator.
Our live photo animator app is free to use. However, we offer different Premium packages for those who would like to take their art to the next level:
– 1 Month PRO Subscription
– 12 Month PRO Subscription
– Lifelong premium package
WHY BECOME PRO?
With the upgrade:
– Access all the vfx 
– Remove the watermark
– Render in high quality
– *You can add up to 10 photo effects
– No ads
– Save videoimages as video or as GIF
– You support us and the development of the app
For tech support or any questions or suggestions, email us: help@vimageapp.com
VIMAGE PRO Subscription:
The purchase will be charged to your iTunes account. An account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Manage your subscription from User Settings in iTunes after purchase. Cancel the auto-renewing subscription from there at any time. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Use: https://zipoapps.com/vimagephotoios/terms
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/vimagephotoios/privacy

Fourteen years in the market, no ads, and
bluejetty:00014768:ios.description:
Turn your portfolio into a dividend paycheck. Stocks Live projects your income for the year ahead — with confidence scores and a month-by-month payment calendar — so you always know what's coming.
Fourteen years in the market, no ads, and the deepest toolset on the App Store. Track what you own, discover what's next, and manage unlimited portfolios across every major market — securely synced to all your devices.
DIVIDEND INCOME, PROJECTED
• See your projected annual dividend income, with Low / Medium / High confidence based on each stock's payment history.
• A payment calendar by month or by holding — declared and estimated payouts, a year ahead.
• Automatic suspended-dividend detection, so a cut never surprises you.
• Full dividend history per holding, plus an ex-dividend and earnings calendar.
PORTFOLIOS WITHOUT THE HASSLE
Skip the transaction logging. Enter your current positions, update them when they change — that's it.
• Unlimited multi-currency portfolios and watch lists, aggregated to your home currency.
• Stocks, ETFs, funds, options, RSUs, DRIP, shorts and 10,000+ cryptocurrencies.
• Bulk-paste holdings, adjust splits across every portfolio, benchmark against any ticker.
• Allocation by sector, industry, region or any metric; tag portfolios for family or groups.
• What-if scenarios, threshold alerts, and short- vs long-term performance with annualized returns.
PRICE ALERTS THAT LIVE ON YOUR DEVICE
• Set above / below alerts on any ticker — checked privately on device, no account required.
• Local notifications the moment they fire.
• Peek at Community Alerts: anonymous levels other investors are watching, for crowd-sourced support and resistance.
RESEARCH & DISCOVERY
• 1,000+ market scanners, scans and filters for stocks, ETFs and crypto — find your next idea.
• Real-time quotes* with extended hours, auto-refreshing every 15 seconds.
• Global coverage rivaling Yahoo! Finance — US, China, Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong and more.
• IPO center, earnings estimates, curated gurus, and 140+ trusted news feeds.
• A company card for every ticker: quote, charts, events, notes, social and news in one place.
CHARTS WORTH FRAMING
• Full-screen charts from intraday to inception — line, bar or candle, log or linear.
• Moving averages, Bollinger Bands, Parabolic SAR, volume and split overlays.
• Compare any group side by side across 70+ data points.
• A signature heat map with dancing tiles, in dark or light.
EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for day performance, value and top holdings.
• An Apple Watch app for your portfolios at a glance.
• Built-in StockTwits — read the feed, post with charts, follow the sentiment.
• Rich notes per company: text, charts, photos or voice memos.
PRIVATE & SYNCED
• iCloud keeps portfolios, watch lists, alerts and notes in sync across all your devices.
• Passcode and Face ID / Touch ID protection. No ads, ever.
“The Best Stock Market App for iPhone and iPad.” — TheBalance.com
“Best Stock Market App for iPhone.” — About.com
Stocks Live is free to download, with unlimited portfolios, quotes, charts and scanners. A subscription unlocks dividend forecasting, price alerts, StockTwits, company notes, widgets and the Apple Watch app.
Subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://stocksliveapp.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.stocksliveapp.com/termsofuse.html
* Real-time quotes cover Nasdaq, NYSE and select UK, German, French and Netherland listings; subscription required for some markets.

bluejetty:00147425:ios.description:
A world where everyone has their people.
Krew Social helps you find your people in the communities you belong to, like your workplace, campus or unit. See in-person hangouts near you, know who's going, and walk in with something to talk about.
HOW IT WORKS
Browse hangouts: see what's happening across your community and request to join.
Know who's going: view attendee profiles and the interests you share before you go.
Meet your people: Krew suggests hangouts with members of your Krew and new people who have things in common with you.
Build your Krew: add friends for any activity or interest.
Keep it going: stay in touch with your group in group chat.
WHY IT WORKS
The U.S. Surgeon General's 2023 advisory, Our Epidemic of Loneliness and Isolation, calls for strengthening social connection in our communities, workplaces and schools. Krew does it the way that works: small groups of people with a lot in common, doing what they love together, in person.
JOIN YOUR COMMUNITY
Join the community your organization set up for you, or join the public community near you.
People stay where they have their people.

bluejetty:00146324:ios.description:
Transme is a safe, inclusive, and welcoming transgender dating app designed especially for transgender, transsexual, crossdresser,non-binary, queer and LGBTQ singles who want to meet open-minded people and build meaningful connections. It's free to join our personals app to chat with other trans singles.
Many dating platforms do not fully understand transgender identity or diversity within the LGBTQ community, and that’s why Transme focuses on creating a respectful, identity-affirming environment where users can connect without judgment or pressure.
This app allows transgender singles and LGBTQ people to meet others who truly respect their identity, gender expression, and personal journey. Whether you are looking for genuine conversations, friendship, long-term relationships or something new in your dating experience, Transme gives you a space where you can express yourself openly and safely.
Instead of spending time on mainstream dating apps that may not be inclusive, here you can connect with people who understand the unique experiences of transgender and LGBTQ individuals. Transme supports users during every step of their dating journey, offering a positive community built around emotional intelligence, respect, and mutual understanding for MTF, FTM, Tgirls, Non-binary.
Every user is encouraged to be themselves and discover new connections at their own pace. This platform is also ideal for those who are transitioning, exploring identity, or simply wanting to meet supportive LGBTQ singles.
Transme lets you:
Connect with transgender singles
Explore LGBTQ dating opportunities
Meet new queer people and allies
Build honest and real connections
We believe dating should feel inclusive, respectful, and safe. That’s why Transme prioritizes identity-friendly options, encourages respectful behavior, and emphasizes profile quality instead of random matching.
Unlike traditional dating apps that often overlook the needs of trans people, our approach is built around safety, acceptance, and community support. Whether you’re a transgender woman, transgender man, non-binary person, or part of the LGBTQ community, Transme gives you access to real people who want real connection.
The platform allows you to browse profiles, start conversations, explore potential matches, and decide how you want to connect. We also provide safety-focused community moderation, ensuring a positive experience for everyone. 
For more information, please check our 
Terms of Use: https://myeasydating.com/tou 
and 
Privacy Policy: https://myeasydating.com/pp

bluejetty:00123658:ios.name: iDousyn Lite
bluejetty:00123658:ios.summary: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful virtual synthesizer and sample-based instrument. Play authentic pianos, basses, guitars, drums, leads, pads, and synths with high-quality samples. Perfect for creating melodies, performing live, or e
bluejetty:00123658:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful virtual synthesizer and sample-based instrument. Play authentic pianos, basses, guitars, drums, leads, pads, and synths with high-quality samples. Perfect for creating melodies, performing live, or exploring musical ideas on the go.
At the core of iDousyn Lite is the innovative Chord Pads system. Build rich harmonies from the virtual keyboard — from simple triads to complex chord stacks. Colored keys highlight every note so you can clearly see how chords are constructed. Shape rhythm with Strum Options (Normal, Up, Down, Up/Down, Down/Up) and fine-tune timing with Rate and Delay controls, or loop chords for continuous play.
Key Features
• 8-Octave Virtual Keyboard – Expandable key sizes with low-latency external MIDI controller support.
• Chord Pads – 5 programmable pads per channel for fast visual chord building and harmonic exploration.
• High-Fidelity Oscillators – Craft vivid synth leads, punchy basses, and electronic tones.
• Professional Filters – Low-Pass, High-Pass, Band-Pass, High Shelf, and Low Shelf with full Cutoff & Resonance control.
• Studio Effects – Reverb, Delay, Parametric EQ, Compressor, and Peak Limiter.
• Dual-Channel Engine – 2 independent layers with Octave, Semitone, Cents, Pan, and Level controls.
• Full MIDI Support – Connect external MIDI controllers with custom key mapping.
• Export & Share – Record in high-quality WAV, AIFF, CAF, or M4A with full AudioShare compatibility.
Sound Library
• 77 carefully crafted presets across 11 categories: Bass, Chords, Drums, Guitars, Instruments, Leads, Pads, Orchestral, SFX, Plucked, and Synth (7 unique presets per category).
Download iDousyn Lite today and turn your mobile device into a portable music production studio!

bluejetty:00080721:ios.name: Self Therapy: Mental Care
bluejetty:00080721:ios.developer: TANOS YAZILIM VE BILISIM HIZMETLERI SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
bluejetty:00080721:ios.summary: Self Therapy is a Mental Health app built around educational self-assessment and structured reflection. It helps you build Self Awareness through Mental Tests that organize what you notice day to day, especially around trauma and depression
bluejetty:00080721:ios.description:
Self Therapy is a Mental Health app built around educational self-assessment and structured reflection. It helps you build Self Awareness through Mental Tests that organize what you notice day to day, especially around trauma and depression. Self Therapy keeps the experience focused on a single backbone: Mental Health Test check-in → reflection → tracking → review.
Self Therapy includes a Mental Health Test library with Mental Tests for educational insight, including a Depression Test and a Trauma Test. You can also explore PTSD Disorder educational check-ins designed to support Self Awareness around PTSD Disorder themes, trauma patterns, and depression patterns. This app does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment. It is for education and personal insight only.
One clear backbone for Mental Health
Use a Mental Health Test to check in, then repeat Mental Tests to compare changes over time. This routine supports Self Awareness by keeping Mental Health notes consistent, readable, and easy to review when trauma or depression feels more intense.
Mental Tests and Mental Health Test library
Self Therapy offers Mental Tests that stay inside a Mental Health self-assessment context while covering common awareness topics:
• Mental Health Test categories for emotional well-being and Self Awareness
• Depression Test for depression check-ins, depression patterns, and depression awareness
• Trauma Test for trauma reflection, trauma triggers, trauma stress, and trauma patterns
• PTSD Disorder educational check-ins for PTSD Disorder awareness and PTSD Disorder themes
• ADHD tendency evaluation, Bipolar trait indicators, BPD and OCD awareness tests
• Visual tests that support Self Awareness through perception-based prompts
Trauma and depression focus with educational language
Self Therapy is designed to help you name what repeats without making clinical claims. Trauma can show up as trauma reminders, trauma stress, trauma triggers, or trauma patterns; the Trauma Test supports trauma reflection and trauma tracking in an educational way. Depression can show up as depression dips, depression cycles, depression-related low drive, or depression patterns; the Depression Test supports depression awareness and depression tracking in an educational way. When trauma and depression notes are captured consistently, Self Awareness becomes easier to maintain inside a Mental Health routine.
Tracking that supports Mental Health patterns
Use the Daily Diary to write short entries and tag emotions. Use the Mood Tracker to log daily states and review trends connected to trauma moments and depression dips. Reviewing Mood Tracker history can help you see trauma trends and depression trends across weeks while keeping the focus on Mental Health self-assessment and Self Awareness.
Review and progress that stays focused
Self Therapy provides simple weekly and monthly summaries of Mood Tracker logs and journaling consistency so you can review Mental Health patterns with clarity. This helps you compare trauma-heavy periods with steadier periods and notice how depression patterns shift with daily routines, without labels and without medical conclusions.
Self Therapy brings together Mental Tests, a Mental Health Test library, a Depression Test, a Trauma Test, Self Awareness practices, and PTSD Disorder educational check-ins—plus a Daily Diary and Mood Tracker—so you can explore trauma and depression in a structured, practical Mental Health routine.

bluejetty:00166434:ios.description:
Follow the sites you care about with NewsBlur, a personal RSS news reader that brings your reading together. Keep up with news, blogs, newsletters, and more, with your subscriptions and reading progress synced across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.
READ YOUR WAY
Browse stories from individual sites or bring a folder together in one reading list. Choose a comfortable theme, adjust the text, and use gestures to move through your stories. Download stories for offline reading and pick up where you left off.
STORIES AT A GLANCE
Add widgets to your Home Screen. Each widget can show All Site Stories, a folder, or one site. Choose its source with Edit Widget.
FIND YOUR FOCUS
Train NewsBlur on authors, tags, and words in headlines to highlight stories you want and hide ones you don't. You decide what matters.
DISCOVER AND KEEP
Find new sites, preview their latest stories, and try reading before subscribing. Save stories for later, organize them with tags, and search your reading. Share stories with comments on your NewsBlur blurblog and follow what friends are reading.
LISTEN TO YOUR STORIES
Turn articles into audio with voices in 21 languages. Follow highlighted paragraphs, tap to jump ahead, adjust playback speed, and queue stories in Up Next. Keep listening with the screen locked. Full listening is included with Premium Archive and Premium Pro. Free and Premium accounts can try 30-second previews.
GO DEEPER
Use Text view to read an extracted article. Ask AI for a summary, background, or answers to questions about a story. Availability and usage limits depend on your account plan.
IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Use NewsBlur's interface in 21 languages, including right-to-left layouts for Arabic and Hebrew. Choose your language in Preferences or follow your device settings. Stories stay in the language they were published in.
A NewsBlur account is required. Free accounts and optional paid subscriptions are available. Some features require a paid plan.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
If you purchase a subscription through the App Store, payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of use: https://www.newsblur.com/tos
Privacy policy: https://www.newsblur.com/privacy

bluejetty:00016044:ios.description:
Bid Whist is a popular book (or trick) taking game in which two teams of two players try to win the bid or set their opponents. If you're familiar with spades, bridge or hearts, or if you just like a very strategic challenge, you will love this game.
Options include:
- Deuce of Spades as third joker
- Low bid beating High bid
- Board of 4 instead of 3
- Register to compare scores with other players
Notes:
- Ace is always the high card in non-trump suits, whether uptown or downtown.
- Your hand is automatically arranged based on an uptown/downtown bid and the trump suit
- The kitty is not sported
- Over books are not counted
- To be credited for a Boston, you must bid and win 7. Simply getting all the books will not count for a Boston if you bid less than 7.

3. Browse our selection

Handy

Top your weekly shop with an array of fruit and veggies (organic too!), stock your pantry with snacks and essentials, replenish your cleaning cupboards, or drink your way through our wide selection of white wine and red wine, and beers from international and small local breweries.

Popular
Are you more into Ben & Jerry's, or maybe Coca-Cola, M&M's, Haribo, Pringles, Alpro, Oatly, and others? We have them all!
Comfy

The better ratings bring better prizes and better prizes let you buy more clothes. It is all up to you! Get prize tiaras and gifts from your fans. You have a whole room for your presents in this fashion show and you can always watch your girls games progress. Make your way to beauty queen’s title in the coolest fashion competition games for girls.

- Choose makeup and hair for fashion show 
- Dress up model girls using various clothes items
- Get rates from fashion experts in fashion competition
- Collect points to get new clothes and new awards
- Became miss world and beauty queen in dressing contest
- Pump up your fashion stylist skills and fell the atmosphere of beauty pageant

bluejetty:00177539:ios.description:
Welcome to Jumanji!
Once again, Jumanji is in peril. The sacred Falcon Jewel has been stolen, and it’s up to you to recover it.
Run from howling hyenas, climb mountains, avoid avalanches, free fall from deadly waterfalls, and defeat anyone in your way.
Avoid dangerous animals from the game, including rhinos, vultures, jaguars, and more ... watch out at all times!
Play this all-new 4D Runner Game and save JUMANJI!
Now… GO!
4 WAYS TO PLAY THE GAME: A whole new kind of runner with 4 epic, next-level game modes: charge forward and fight your enemies, run from animal stampedes, climb perilous cliffs, and dive off massive waterfalls. Jump, duck, dash, slide - do anything to reclaim the sacred jewel!
SELECT YOUR AVATAR: Become the character of your choice: Dr. Smolder Bravestone, Franklin “Mouse” Finbar, Ruby Roundhouse, or Professor Shelly Oberon.
MAD SKILLS: Take advantage of each character’s special skills: hurl boomerangs, dance fight with nunchucks, trailblaze with geometric calculations, or ride animals like a boss.
DEADLY BATTLES: Defeat giant brutes and other fearsome enemies. Don’t let anyone get in your way!
ENDLESS TREASURES: Collect power-ups along your journey:
Magnetic field - collects all nearby coins.
Shield bubble - protects you from obstacles
x2 - double your coin pickups to get ahead in the game 
STYLE UP: You can’t run without the right look! Unlock new environments and get amazing outfits. Each outfit grants you a bonus for each power-up you collect in the game. 
Are you ready for the Next Level?!

**** Mizo Dictionary Offline And Translator *****
Welcome to Mizo Dictionary and Translator - the easiest way to learn and translate Mizo language fastly within your iPhones and iPads.
Our new English to Mizo Dictionary and Translator app is a light weight and elegant tool. You can find over 20,000+ english words with their Mizo meanings for 
Mizo Dictionary And Translator provide Mizo keyboard to write the message, store, emails, Facebook post in Mizo. 
Mizo Dictionary And Translator provide translator. So you can translate Mizo text, message, emails ... etc to any other language.
Mizo language is spoken by over 50 million people around the world and we know that learning it will not be too easy without a powerful and free tool to let you learn it in a fast and fun way. 
*********Features ********

- Speech to Text functionality in to searching words.
- You can translate your Mizo message into any language.
- Mizo Dictionary and Translator is free. No other hidden charges.
- We will keep you updated with latest words in this language.
- It's Offline. So user need not any internet connection more.
- Perfect app for travellers! This, will help you to learn and talk Mizo language with people easily!
- We developed a new quiz inside Mizo dictionary! To take the quiz, you can easily tap the option icon in the top left side of the screen and choose quiz. - You can see your real-time results in the top of the screen. If your answer is wrong, then we will show you the right one. Do not forget to keep it in mind.
- Want to save a word meaning in the favourites? Tap the heart button and we will add this word automatically in your favourites. You can easily access to it anytime within the favourites choice in the options menu.
- We have a integrated a text to speech feature to let you hear the english words that you are looking for.
- Share any word and its meaning easily with your friends on other social media apps with the share word button in the bottom right side of the screen.
- We will automatically save any word that you searched. You can easily access to it later within the history choice in the options menu.
So, What are you waiting for ? Download Mizo Dictionary and Translator now and enjoy learning Mizo language in a very easy way!

bluejetty:00132006:ios.name: Wyze Car
bluejetty:00132006:ios.summary:
[Control Wyze Car from the safety of your HQ]
We’ve enlisted our top engineers to discreetly hide Wyze Car’s remote directly in a classified app on your phone. With the app, you’ll be able to live-stream your mission straight to your phone
bluejetty:00132006:ios.description:
[Control Wyze Car from the safety of your HQ]
We’ve enlisted our top engineers to discreetly hide Wyze Car’s remote directly in a classified app on your phone. With the app, you’ll be able to live-stream your mission straight to your phone and drive Wyze Car at a safe distance away from the action. I think it goes without saying, but we absolutely cannot have another blown cover like last year when a joystick fell out of Jimmy from Wyze’s pocket during cocktail hour.
And remember, never forget the 3 R’s taught in spy bootcamp: Record. Retrieve. Recover.
Record, capture, and save video of your mission for debriefing.
Retrieve critical information about your targets by getting up close and personal.
Recover the apparatus by navigating it home remotely with the app.
[Get out of dodge when things get sticky]
We can’t have our highly classified apparatus captured by the target. When in danger, or when you’ve successfully completed your mission, bolt back to base. Eco-mode lets you conserve battery usage as you approach your target while
Sports mode kicks it into high gear so you make it back to HQ quickly.
[Light up night missions with LED headlights]
Parts of your mission will require clandestine operations at night. To safely navigate the dark and capture clear video, quickly activate and deactivate your headlights from the app. But do it quickly! You need to remain undetected.
[2-hours of nonstop action]
Don’t worry about getting caught with low fuel during your escape. We’ve packed Wyze Car with a 10,000mAh power bank that will keep you running during the whole mission.
[All-wheel drive takes you from hardwoods to backwoods]
Your targets rarely operate out in the open - traversing all types of terrain is a requirement. Massive off-road tires climb over rocks, carpets, branches, and more with ease. Shock-absorbing suspension withstands vertical impact after flying through the air. And a high-density, all-plastic roll cage protects against nasty spills.

bluejetty:00123750:ios.description:
Put your engineering skills, intuition and smarts to test in this brand new Bridge Construction Simulator. You will need to plan, improvise and – most of all – adapt to the task at hand. Use your resources to construct structures able to hold the weight of different vehicles. 
You will design and construct increasingly elaborate bridges across four varied locations. Things may seem easy when you start out in a city, but once you move to the canyon, valley and finally mountains, the size and resilience of your structures will have to increase substantially.

- Built-in hint system

apple-macos:6819473693.name: Pika Video Messages
apple-macos:6819473693.description:
Pika records short video messages right inside Messages on iPhone and iPad, framed for sign language.
Open Pika from the app drawer in any conversation and you are on the camera, ready to record. Tap once to start. A countdown shows the time left, and recording stops by itself at 60 seconds. Watch it back, then tap Use clip and it lands in the message field. You send it with Messages' own Send button, like any other video.
MADE FOR SIGNING
• Opens on the front camera with a square frame that keeps your face and hands in view
• Clips are compressed so handshapes and fast movement stay sharp while files stay small
• The recording light uses a shape and a label as well as color, and the last ten seconds look different, so the time left is clear without sound
SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no sign-in, and no servers: your clips are sent by iMessage, end-to-end encrypted by Apple
• Nothing is saved to your Photos library
• A hard 60-second cap keeps messages short
ACCESSIBLE
• VoiceOver labels on every control, with announcements for start, stop and time left
• Haptics when recording starts and stops, and at ten seconds left
• Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion supported
The Pika app shows you where to find Pika in Messages and lets you allow the camera and microphone ahead of time.
Pika is on the Mac too: it drops down from the menu bar and shares clips to Messages.
Questions or ideas: hello@pronghornlabs.net

Guide your snake through intricate mazes, pick up every fruit, and sort them into the right crates. One wrong turn and the whole plan unravels. With 300+ handcrafted levels, Snacky Dash is the maze puzzle game with a mechanic no other game offers.
Swipe in any direction to send your snake dashing through corridors. Plan your route carefully — you need to collect every fruit and collectible before heading to the crates. Once all crates are filled, the level is complete! Easy to learn, increasingly challenging to master.
GAME FEATURES:
• Guide your snake through 300+ handcrafted maze levels
• Collect fruits and sort them into the right crates to complete each level
• New obstacles and mechanics introduced as you progress
 • Smooth swipe controls — easy to pick up, hard to put down
 • Play offline — no internet required
 • Free to play
Snacky Dash takes the satisfying experience from vintage Snake and a collection loop from classic games — then adds a delivery-and-sort mechanic that neither game has. Your snake isn't just collecting. It's picking, packing, and delivering. If you've been looking for the next maze puzzle obsession, this is it.
Download Snacky Dash now - the maze puzzle game your snake brain has been waiting for.

apple-macos:1507936451.name: Word Pics - Word Games
apple-macos:1507936451.description:
If you like word games and guessing games with pictures, you'll love Word Pics - Word Games! The idea is simple: guess the single word using just two pics as clues. The images will have some connection, all you have to do is enter the right words!
This simple, free, and addictive word game gives you two pics and challenges you to guess a word or phrase. The images in each puzzle have one word in common. Sometimes the words can be easy to guess, but other times you'll have to stop and think. The more picture puzzles you solve the more levels you will unlock, making this brain teaser game an endless source of fun!
There are 3 fun game modes to play:
1. Classic - Connect two pictures and guess the word, that's it!
2. Expert - Two pictures appear and then disappear after a few seconds. Guess the word quickly, but be ready to challenge your brain!
3. Multiplayer - Engage in a fun one-on-one PvP quiz battle against other people online and in real-time!
Along with all of the above word game modes, Word Pics also includes the features below.
- Hints and clues to help solve tough puzzles
- Zoom in to see picture details
- Online multiplayer with real-time puzzle solving
- Add more fun by customizing your theme's look and feel
- Guess the correct words in over 1000 puzzles!
- Use the speak to word option for added fun. 
Are you looking for fun games to challenge your brain? Play the best picture words game today, experience endless fun, while challenging your brain!
Word Pics - Word Games is super fun to play. There are exciting picture packs, challenging guessing games, incredible words, and tons more to enjoy, all in a free brain teaser format. Expect endless hours of quiz solving fun!
Play the game alone, play the game with friends, play it against strangers. No matter how you play word games, Word Pics is a fantastic twist on a familiar puzzle. Download this addictive new word game today!

apple-itunes:6825867498.name: Vogal Keyboard
apple-itunes:6825867498.description:
Vogal is an iPhone keyboard that sounds and feels mechanical, with smart correction and themes made your way. What you type stays on your iPhone.
SOUND AND FEEL
• 11 sounds, including Red, Brown, Blue and Black switches (Premium)
• Adjustable haptics, from a light tap to a firm click
• Keys that sink like real ones
THEMES YOUR WAY
• 27 themes, each in light and dark (3 free)
• Vogal Glass and the Classic Keyboard, with the look of 2009
• Create your own: colors, key shape, font, texture and gradient (Premium)
• Pull the colors from a photo
COMMUNITY
• Publish your theme and discover others in Trending, Most Downloaded and New
• Find any theme with a short code
• Report inappropriate themes and block people you don't want to see
SMART TYPING
• Autocorrect and suggestions that learn how you write, in over 30 languages
• Swipe typing, emoji search and text shortcuts
• Apple Intelligence: fix, rewrite and summarize, on supported iPhones
• Translate without leaving the app
• Calculator: type 5x5= and see the result
• Clipboard history (Premium)
• Private Mode: nothing is learned while it is on
YOUR PRIVACY
Vogal has no server that receives what you type. Correction, translation and Apple Intelligence run on your iPhone. Backups go only to your own iCloud. Only the themes you choose to publish become public.
VOGAL PREMIUM
Free with 3 themes and the default sound. Premium unlocks all themes, sounds and key shapes, theme creation and clipboard history.
Premium is a yearly subscription with a 1-week free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends and renews every year. Cancel anytime in iPhone Settings, at least 24 hours before renewal.
Terms of Use: https://vogalkeyboard.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://vogalkeyboard.com/privacy
